```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\BrandModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;
use App\Models\SettingModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages catalog brands for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminBrandController extends Controller
{
    private BrandModel $brandModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;
    private SettingModel $settingModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the brand and SEO models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
        $this->settingModel = new SettingModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all brands ordered by name.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $brands = $this->brandModel->findAll('name ASC');

        $this->view('dashboard/brands/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Brands',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage product brands',
            'currentPage' => 'brands',
            'brands' => $brands,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create brand form.
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $this->view('dashboard/brands/create', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Create Brand',
            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product brand',
            'currentPage' => 'brands',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->emptyFormData(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new brand from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput(0);
            $data['created_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['logo']) && $_FILES['logo']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleLogoUpload($_FILES['logo']);
                $data['logo'] = $newFile;
            }

            $newId = $this->brandModel->insert($data);
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('brand', $newId, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Brand created successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteLogoFile($newFile);
            }
            $this->view('dashboard/brands/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Brand',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product brand',
                'currentPage' => 'brands',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->emptyFormData()),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit brand form.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $brand = $this->brandModel->findById($id);

        if (!$brand) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Brand not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('brand', $id);

        $this->view('dashboard/brands/edit', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Edit Brand',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product brand',
            'currentPage' => 'brands',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'brand' => $brand,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->formDataForBrand($brand, $seo),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing brand from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $brand = $this->brandModel->findById($id);

        if (!$brand) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Brand not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput($id);
            $data['updated_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['logo']) && $_FILES['logo']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleLogoUpload($_FILES['logo']);
                $data['logo'] = $newFile;
            }

            $this->brandModel->update($id, $data);
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $oldLogo = '';
                if (isset($brand['logo'])) {
                    $oldLogo = (string) $brand['logo'];
                }
                $this->deleteLogoFile($oldLogo);
            }
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('brand', $id, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Brand updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteLogoFile($newFile);
            }
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('brand', $id);
            $this->view('dashboard/brands/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Brand',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product brand',
                'currentPage' => 'brands',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'brand' => $brand,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->formDataForBrand($brand, $seo)),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a brand and its SEO meta.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $brand = $this->brandModel->findById($id);

        if (!$brand) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Brand not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->brandModel->delete($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Brand deleted successfully.';
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('brand', $id);
            if ($seo) {
                $this->seoMetaModel->delete((int) $seo['id']);
            }

            $oldLogo = '';
            if (isset($brand['logo'])) {
                $oldLogo = (string) $brand['logo'];
            }
            $this->deleteLogoFile($oldLogo);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/brands');
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted form fields and return brand data.
     */
    private function collectInput(int $ignoreId): array
    {
        $rawName = '';
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $rawName = $_POST['name'];
        }
        $name = Validator::sanitize($rawName, 100);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new Exception('Brand name is required.');
        }

        $rawSlug = '';
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $rawSlug = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        $slug = $this->generateSlug($rawSlug);
        if ($slug === '') {
            $slug = $this->generateSlug($name);
        }
        if ($slug === '') {
            throw new Exception('Brand slug is required.');
        }

        if ($this->brandModel->slugExists($slug, $ignoreId)) {
            throw new Exception('Slug is already in use.');
        }

        $rawWebsiteUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['website_url'])) {
            $rawWebsiteUrl = $_POST['website_url'];
        }
        $websiteUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawWebsiteUrl, 255);
        if ($websiteUrl !== '' && !Validator::url($websiteUrl)) {
            throw new Exception('Website URL is not valid.');
        }

        $rawDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $rawDescription = $_POST['description'];
        }
        $description = Validator::sanitize($rawDescription, 5000, true);

        $status = 'draft';
        if (isset($_POST['status']) && $_POST['status'] !== '') {
            $status = Validator::sanitize($_POST['status'], 20);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($status, ['draft', 'published'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid status.');
        }

        return [
            'name' => $name,
            'slug' => $slug,
            'website_url' => $websiteUrl,
            'description' => $description,
            'status' => $status,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted SEO fields and return SEO meta data.
     */
    private function collectSeoInput(string $slug): array
    {
        $rawSeoTitle = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $rawSeoTitle = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        $seoTitle = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoTitle, 255);

        $rawSeoDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $rawSeoDescription = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        $seoDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoDescription, 5000);

        $rawCanonicalUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $rawCanonicalUrl = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        $canonicalUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawCanonicalUrl, 255);

        $robotsTag = 'index, follow';
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag']) && $_POST['robots_tag'] !== '') {
            $robotsTag = Validator::sanitize($_POST['robots_tag'], 50);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($robotsTag, ['index, follow', 'noindex, follow', 'index, nofollow', 'noindex, nofollow'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid robots tag.');
        }

        $rawOgDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $rawOgDescription = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        $ogDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawOgDescription, 5000);

        $rawTwitterDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $rawTwitterDescription = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        $twitterDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawTwitterDescription, 5000);

        $rawSchemaMarkup = '';
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $rawSchemaMarkup = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        $schemaMarkup = Validator::sanitize($rawSchemaMarkup, 5000);

        $rawCustomHeadTags = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $rawCustomHeadTags = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        $customHeadTags = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomHeadTags, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomBody = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $rawCustomBody = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        $customBody = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomBody, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomFooter = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $rawCustomFooter = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }
        $customFooter = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomFooter, 5000, true);

        return [
            'seo_title' => $seoTitle,
            'seo_description' => $seoDescription,
            'canonical_url' => $canonicalUrl,
            'robots_tag' => $robotsTag,
            'og_description' => $ogDescription,
            'twitter_description' => $twitterDescription,
            'schema_markup' => $schemaMarkup,
            'custom_head_tags' => $customHeadTags,
            'custom_body' => $customBody,
            'custom_footer' => $customFooter,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower(trim($value));
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim($slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Return the blank form data used by the create form and as the base for old input.
     */
    private function emptyFormData(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'website_url' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => 'index, follow',
            'og_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_og_desc'),
            'twitter_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_twitter_desc'),
            'schema_markup' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_schema'),
            'custom_head_tags' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_head'),
            'custom_body' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_body'),
            'custom_footer' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_footer'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Copy raw submitted POST values over the base form data for repopulation.
     */
    private function collectOldInput(array $base): array
    {
        $old = $base;

        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $_POST['name'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $_POST['slug'];

        }
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {

        if (isset($_POST['status'])) {

        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $old['seo_title'] = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $old['seo_description'] = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $old['canonical_url'] = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag'])) {
            $old['robots_tag'] = $_POST['robots_tag'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $old['og_description'] = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $old['twitter_description'] = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $old['schema_markup'] = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $old['custom_head_tags'] = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $old['custom_body'] = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $old['custom_footer'] = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Build the old form data for the edit view from a brand and its SEO meta.
     */
    private function formDataForBrand(array $brand, ?array $seo): array
    {
        $old = [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'website_url' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => '',
            'og_description' => '',
            'twitter_description' => '',
            'schema_markup' => '',
            'custom_head_tags' => '',
            'custom_body' => '',
            'custom_footer' => '',
        ];

        if (isset($brand['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $brand['name'];
        }
        if (isset($brand['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $brand['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($brand['website_url'])) {
            $old['website_url'] = $brand['website_url'];
        }
        if (isset($brand['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $brand['description'];
        }
        if (isset($brand['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $brand['status'];
        }

        if ($seo !== null) {
            if (isset($seo['seo_title'])) {
                $old['seo_title'] = $seo['seo_title'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['seo_description'])) {
                $old['seo_description'] = $seo['seo_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['canonical_url'])) {
                $old['canonical_url'] = $seo['canonical_url'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['robots_tag'])) {
                $old['robots_tag'] = $seo['robots_tag'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['og_description'])) {
                $old['og_description'] = $seo['og_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['twitter_description'])) {
                $old['twitter_description'] = $seo['twitter_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['schema_markup'])) {
                $old['schema_markup'] = $seo['schema_markup'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_head_tags'])) {
                $old['custom_head_tags'] = $seo['custom_head_tags'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_body'])) {
                $old['custom_body'] = $seo['custom_body'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_footer'])) {
                $old['custom_footer'] = $seo['custom_footer'];
            }
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored brand logo file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteLogoFile(string $logo): void
    {
        if ($logo === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($logo, '/uploads/brands/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($logo);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/brands/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate and store an uploaded brand logo, returning its public path.
     */
    private function handleLogoUpload(array $file): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/brands/', 'brand');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\CategoryModel;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;
use App\Models\SettingModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages catalog categories for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminCategoryController extends Controller
{
    private CategoryModel $categoryModel;
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;
    private SettingModel $settingModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the category and SEO models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->categoryModel = new CategoryModel($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
        $this->settingModel = new SettingModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all categories ordered by sort order, then name.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $categories = $this->categoryModel->findAllOrdered();

        $this->view('dashboard/categories/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Categories',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage product categories',
            'currentPage' => 'categories',
            'categories' => $categories,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create category form.
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $this->view('dashboard/categories/create', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Create Category',
            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product category',
            'currentPage' => 'categories',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->emptyFormData(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new category from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput(0);

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['image']) && $_FILES['image']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleImageUpload($_FILES['image']);
                $data['image'] = $newFile;
            }

            $id = $this->categoryModel->insert($data);
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('category', $id, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Category created successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteImageFile($newFile);
            }
            $this->view('dashboard/categories/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Category',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product category',
                'currentPage' => 'categories',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->emptyFormData()),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit category form.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $category = $this->categoryModel->findById($id);

        if (!$category) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Category not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('category', $id);

        $this->view('dashboard/categories/edit', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Edit Category',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product category',
            'currentPage' => 'categories',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'category' => $category,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->formDataForCategory($category, $seo),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing category from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $category = $this->categoryModel->findById($id);

        if (!$category) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Category not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput($id);

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['image']) && $_FILES['image']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleImageUpload($_FILES['image']);
                $data['image'] = $newFile;
            }

            $this->categoryModel->update($id, $data);
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $oldImage = '';
                if (isset($category['image'])) {
                    $oldImage = (string) $category['image'];
                }
                $this->deleteImageFile($oldImage);
            }
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('category', $id, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Category updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteImageFile($newFile);
            }
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('category', $id);
            $this->view('dashboard/categories/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Category',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product category',
                'currentPage' => 'categories',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'category' => $category,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->formDataForCategory($category, $seo),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a category.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $category = $this->categoryModel->findById($id);

        if (!$category) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Category not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        if ($this->productModel->countByCategoryId($id) > 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Cannot delete: products still use this category.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->categoryModel->delete($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Category deleted successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
            return;
        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('category', $id);
        if ($seo) {
            $this->seoMetaModel->delete((int) $seo['id']);
        }

        $oldImage = '';
        if (isset($category['image'])) {
            $oldImage = (string) $category['image'];
        }
        $this->deleteImageFile($oldImage);

        $this->redirect('/dashboard/categories');
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted form fields and return category data.
     */
    private function collectInput(int $ignoreId): array
    {
        $rawName = '';
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $rawName = $_POST['name'];
        }
        $name = Validator::sanitize($rawName, 100);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new Exception('Category name is required.');
        }

        $rawSlug = '';
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $rawSlug = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        $slug = $this->generateSlug($rawSlug);
        if ($slug === '') {
            $slug = $this->generateSlug($name);
        }
        if ($slug === '') {
            throw new Exception('Category slug is required.');
        }

        if (Validator::inArray($slug, ['login','logout','register','verify-email','member','dashboard','categories',
        'brands','brand','compare','go','wishlist','csp-report','uploads','assets','favicon','robots','category',
        'product','store','search','auth','sitemap'])) {
            throw new Exception('This slug is reserved. Please choose another.');
        }

        if ($this->categoryModel->slugExists($slug, $ignoreId)) {
            throw new Exception('Slug is already in use.');
        }

        $rawDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $rawDescription = $_POST['description'];
        }
        $description = Validator::sanitize($rawDescription, 5000, true);

        $rawImageAlt = '';
        if (isset($_POST['image_alt'])) {
            $rawImageAlt = $_POST['image_alt'];
        }
        $imageAlt = Validator::sanitize($rawImageAlt, 255);

        $sortOrder = 0;
        if (isset($_POST['sort_order']) && $_POST['sort_order'] !== '') {
            if (!Validator::integer($_POST['sort_order'])) {
                throw new Exception('Sort order must be an integer.');
            }
            $sortOrder = (int) $_POST['sort_order'];
        }

        $status = 'draft';
        if (isset($_POST['status']) && $_POST['status'] !== '') {
            $status = $_POST['status'];
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($status, ['draft', 'published'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid status.');
        }

        return [
            'name' => $name,
            'slug' => $slug,
            'description' => $description,
            'image_alt' => $imageAlt,
            'sort_order' => $sortOrder,
            'status' => $status,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted SEO fields and return SEO meta data.
     */
    private function collectSeoInput(string $slug): array
    {
        $rawSeoTitle = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $rawSeoTitle = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        $seoTitle = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoTitle, 255);

        $rawSeoDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $rawSeoDescription = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        $seoDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoDescription, 5000);

        $rawCanonicalUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $rawCanonicalUrl = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        $canonicalUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawCanonicalUrl, 255);

        $robotsTag = 'index, follow';
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag']) && $_POST['robots_tag'] !== '') {
            $robotsTag = Validator::sanitize($_POST['robots_tag'], 50);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($robotsTag, ['index, follow', 'noindex, follow', 'index, nofollow', 'noindex, nofollow'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid robots tag.');
        }

        $rawOgDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $rawOgDescription = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        $ogDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawOgDescription, 5000);

        $rawTwitterDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $rawTwitterDescription = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        $twitterDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawTwitterDescription, 5000);

        $rawSchemaMarkup = '';
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $rawSchemaMarkup = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        $schemaMarkup = Validator::sanitize($rawSchemaMarkup, 5000);

        $rawCustomHeadTags = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $rawCustomHeadTags = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        $customHeadTags = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomHeadTags, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomBody = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $rawCustomBody = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        $customBody = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomBody, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomFooter = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $rawCustomFooter = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }
        $customFooter = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomFooter, 5000, true);

        return [
            'seo_title' => $seoTitle,
            'seo_description' => $seoDescription,
            'canonical_url' => $canonicalUrl,
            'robots_tag' => $robotsTag,
            'og_description' => $ogDescription,
            'twitter_description' => $twitterDescription,
            'schema_markup' => $schemaMarkup,
            'custom_head_tags' => $customHeadTags,
            'custom_body' => $customBody,
            'custom_footer' => $customFooter,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower(trim($value));
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim($slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Return the blank form data used by the create form and as the base for old input.
     */
    private function emptyFormData(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'image_alt' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => 'index, follow',
            'og_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_og_desc'),
            'twitter_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_twitter_desc'),
            'schema_markup' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_schema'),
            'custom_head_tags' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_head'),
            'custom_body' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_body'),
            'custom_footer' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_footer'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Copy raw submitted POST values over the base form data for repopulation.
     */
    private function collectOldInput(array $base): array
    {
        $old = $base;

        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $_POST['name'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $_POST['description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['image_alt'])) {
            $old['image_alt'] = $_POST['image_alt'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $_POST['status'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $old['seo_title'] = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $old['seo_description'] = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $old['canonical_url'] = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag'])) {
            $old['robots_tag'] = $_POST['robots_tag'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $old['og_description'] = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $old['twitter_description'] = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $old['schema_markup'] = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $old['custom_head_tags'] = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $old['custom_body'] = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $old['custom_footer'] = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Build the old form data for the edit view from a category and its SEO meta.
     */
    private function formDataForCategory(array $category, ?array $seo): array
    {
        $old = [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'image_alt' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => '',
            'og_description' => '',
            'twitter_description' => '',
            'schema_markup' => '',
            'custom_head_tags' => '',
            'custom_body' => '',
            'custom_footer' => '',
        ];

        if (isset($category['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $category['name'];
        }
        if (isset($category['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $category['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($category['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $category['description'];
        }
        if (isset($category['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $category['status'];
        }
        if (isset($category['image_alt'])) {
            $old['image_alt'] = $category['image_alt'];
        }

        if ($seo !== null) {
            if (isset($seo['seo_title'])) {
                $old['seo_title'] = $seo['seo_title'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['seo_description'])) {
                $old['seo_description'] = $seo['seo_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['canonical_url'])) {
                $old['canonical_url'] = $seo['canonical_url'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['robots_tag'])) {
                $old['robots_tag'] = $seo['robots_tag'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['og_description'])) {
                $old['og_description'] = $seo['og_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['twitter_description'])) {
                $old['twitter_description'] = $seo['twitter_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['schema_markup'])) {
                $old['schema_markup'] = $seo['schema_markup'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_head_tags'])) {
                $old['custom_head_tags'] = $seo['custom_head_tags'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_body'])) {
                $old['custom_body'] = $seo['custom_body'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_footer'])) {
                $old['custom_footer'] = $seo['custom_footer'];
            }
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Validate and store an uploaded category image, returning its public path.
     */
    private function handleImageUpload(array $file): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/categories/', 'category');
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored category image file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteImageFile(string $image): void
    {
        if ($image === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($image, '/uploads/categories/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($image);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/categories/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\OfferModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;
use App\Models\CategoryModel;
use App\Models\BrandModel;
use App\Models\StoreModel;
use App\Models\VendorModel;
use App\Models\SettingModel;
use App\Models\ClickModel;
use App\Models\PriceHistoryModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages products and their offers for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminProductController extends Controller
{
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private OfferModel $offerModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;
    private CategoryModel $categoryModel;
    private BrandModel $brandModel;
    private StoreModel $storeModel;
    private VendorModel $vendorModel;
    private SettingModel $settingModel;
    private ClickModel $clickModel;
    private PriceHistoryModel $priceHistoryModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build all required models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->offerModel = new OfferModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
        $this->categoryModel = new CategoryModel($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
        $this->storeModel = new StoreModel($pdo);
        $this->vendorModel = new VendorModel($pdo);
        $this->settingModel = new SettingModel($pdo);
        $this->clickModel = new ClickModel($pdo);
        $this->priceHistoryModel = new PriceHistoryModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all products with their category and brand names.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $search = '';
        if (isset($_GET['search'])) {
            $search = Validator::sanitize($_GET['search'], 100);
        }

        $status = '';
        if (isset($_GET['status'])) {
            $status = Validator::sanitize($_GET['status'], 20);
        }

        $page = 1;
        if (isset($_GET['page'])) {
            if (Validator::integer($_GET['page'], 1)) {
                $page = (int) $_GET['page'];
            }
        }

        $perPage = 20;
        $total = $this->productModel->countAll();
        $totalPages = (int) ceil($total / $perPage);
        if ($totalPages < 1) {
            $totalPages = 1;
        }
        if ($page > $totalPages && $page > 1) {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
        $products = $this->productModel->getAllWithRelationsPaginated($offset, $perPage, $search, $status);

        $statusPublishedSelected = '';
        $statusDraftSelected = '';
        if ($status === 'published') {
            $statusPublishedSelected = 'selected';
        } elseif ($status === 'draft') {
            $statusDraftSelected = 'selected';
        }

        $this->view('dashboard/products/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Products',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage products and offers',
            'currentPage' => 'products',
            'products' => $products,
            'totalPages' => $totalPages,
            'perPage' => $perPage,
            'total' => $total,
            'page' => $page,
            'search' => $search,
            'status' => $status,
            'statusPublishedSelected' => $statusPublishedSelected,
            'statusDraftSelected' => $statusDraftSelected,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create product form.

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $brands = $this->brandModel->findAll('name ASC');
        $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');
        $vendors = $this->vendorModel->findAllWithStore();

        $this->view('dashboard/products/create', [

            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product',
            'currentPage' => 'products',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'brands' => $brands,
            'stores' => $stores,
            'vendors' => $vendors,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->emptyFormData(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new product from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput(0);
            $data['created_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $category = $this->categoryModel->findById((int) $data['category_id']);
            $categorySlug = '';
            if ($category) {
                $categorySlug = (string) $category['slug'];
            }

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug'], $categorySlug);

            if (isset($_FILES['image']) && $_FILES['image']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleImageUpload($_FILES['image']);
                $data['image'] = $newFile;
            }

            $newId = $this->productModel->insert($data);
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('product', $newId, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product created. You can now add offers.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $newId . '/edit');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteImageFile($newFile);
            }
            $categories = $this->categoryModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $brands = $this->brandModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');

            $this->view('dashboard/products/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Product',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new product',
                'currentPage' => 'products',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'categories' => $categories,
                'brands' => $brands,
                'stores' => $stores,
                'vendors' => $vendors,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->emptyFormData()),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit product form with its offers.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {

            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Product not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');

        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('product', $id);

        $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');
        $vendors = $this->vendorModel->findAllWithStore();
        $offers = $this->offerModel->findByProductId($id);

        $this->view('dashboard/products/edit', [

            'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product and its offers',
            'currentPage' => 'products',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'product' => $product,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'brands' => $brands,
            'stores' => $stores,
            'vendors' => $vendors,
            'offers' => $offers,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->formDataForProduct($product, $seo),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing product from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $product = $this->productModel->findById($id);

        if (!$product) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Product not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput($id);
            $data['updated_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $category = $this->categoryModel->findById((int) $data['category_id']);
            $categorySlug = '';
            if ($category) {
                $categorySlug = (string) $category['slug'];
            }

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug'], $categorySlug);

            if (isset($_FILES['image']) && $_FILES['image']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleImageUpload($_FILES['image']);
                $data['image'] = $newFile;
            }

            $this->productModel->update($id, $data);
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $oldImage = '';
                if (isset($product['image'])) {
                    $oldImage = (string) $product['image'];
                }
                $this->deleteImageFile($oldImage);
            }
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('product', $id, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $id . '/edit');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteImageFile($newFile);
            }
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('product', $id);
            $categories = $this->categoryModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $brands = $this->brandModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $vendors = $this->vendorModel->findAllWithStore();
            $offers = $this->offerModel->findByProductId($id);

            $this->view('dashboard/products/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Product',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit a product and its offers',
                'currentPage' => 'products',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'product' => $product,
                'categories' => $categories,
                'brands' => $brands,
                'stores' => $stores,
                'vendors' => $vendors,
                'offers' => $offers,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->formDataForProduct($product, $seo)),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a product, its SEO meta, and its image.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $product = $this->productModel->findById($id);

        if (!$product) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Product not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        if ($this->clickModel->countByProductId($id) > 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'This product has offers with click history. Set it to Draft instead.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->productModel->delete($id);
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('product', $id);
            if ($seo) {
                $this->seoMetaModel->delete((int) $seo['id']);
            }

            $oldImage = '';
            if (isset($product['image'])) {
                $oldImage = (string) $product['image'];
            }
            $this->deleteImageFile($oldImage);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product deleted successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
    }

    /**
     * Add a store offer to a product.
     */
    public function storeOffer(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $productId = (int) $id;
        $product = $this->productModel->findById($productId);

        if (!$product) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Product not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $rawPriceIdr = '';
            if (isset($_POST['price_idr'])) {
                $rawPriceIdr = $_POST['price_idr'];
            }
            if (!Validator::integer($rawPriceIdr, 1)) {
                throw new Exception('Price must be a positive integer.');
            }
            $priceIdr = (int) $rawPriceIdr;

            $rawAffiliateUrl = '';
            if (isset($_POST['affiliate_url'])) {
                $rawAffiliateUrl = $_POST['affiliate_url'];
            }
            $affiliateUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawAffiliateUrl, 5000);
            if ($affiliateUrl === '' || !Validator::url($affiliateUrl)) {
                throw new Exception('Affiliate URL is not valid.');
            }

            $rawVendorId = '';
            if (isset($_POST['vendor_id'])) {
                $rawVendorId = $_POST['vendor_id'];
            }
            $vendorId = 0;
            if ($rawVendorId !== '') {
                if (!Validator::integer($rawVendorId, 1)) {
                    throw new Exception('Invalid vendor.');
                }
                $vendorId = (int) $rawVendorId;
            }
            if ($vendorId === 0) {
                throw new Exception('Vendor is required.');
            }

            $vendor = $this->vendorModel->findById($vendorId);
            if (!$vendor) {
                throw new Exception('Selected vendor does not exist.');
            }

            $storeId = 0;
            if (isset($vendor['store_id'])) {
                $storeId = (int) $vendor['store_id'];
            }
            $store = $this->storeModel->findById($storeId);
            if (!$store) {
                throw new Exception('Selected store does not exist.');
            }

            $existingOffers = $this->offerModel->findByProductId($productId);
            foreach ($existingOffers as $existingOffer) {
                if ($existingOffer['vendor_id'] !== null && (int) $existingOffer['vendor_id'] === $vendorId) {
                    throw new Exception('This vendor already has an offer for this product.');
                }
            }

            $inStock = 1;
            if (!isset($_POST['in_stock'])) {
                $inStock = 0;
            }

            $newOfferId = $this->offerModel->insert([
                'product_id' => $productId,
                'store_id' => $storeId,
                'vendor_id' => $vendorId,
                'price_idr' => $priceIdr,
                'affiliate_url' => $affiliateUrl,
                'in_stock' => $inStock,
                'status' => 'published',
                'last_checked_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ]);
            $this->priceHistoryModel->record($newOfferId, $priceIdr);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Offer added successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }

        $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $productId . '/edit');
    }

    /**
     * Update the editable fields of an offer that belongs to a product.
     */
    public function updateOffer(string $productId, string $offerId): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $productId = (int) $productId;
        $offerId = (int) $offerId;

        $offer = $this->offerModel->findById($offerId);

        if (!$offer || (int) $offer['product_id'] !== $productId) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Offer not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $productId . '/edit');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $rawPriceIdr = '';
            if (isset($_POST['price_idr'])) {
                $rawPriceIdr = $_POST['price_idr'];
            }
            if (!Validator::integer($rawPriceIdr, 1)) {
                throw new Exception('Price must be a positive integer.');
            }
            $priceIdr = (int) $rawPriceIdr;

            $rawAffiliateUrl = '';
            if (isset($_POST['affiliate_url'])) {
                $rawAffiliateUrl = $_POST['affiliate_url'];
            }
            $affiliateUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawAffiliateUrl, 5000);
            if ($affiliateUrl === '' || !Validator::url($affiliateUrl)) {
                throw new Exception('Affiliate URL is not valid.');
            }

            $inStock = 1;
            if (!isset($_POST['in_stock'])) {
                $inStock = 0;
            }

            $this->offerModel->update($offerId, [
                'price_idr' => $priceIdr,
                'affiliate_url' => $affiliateUrl,
                'in_stock' => $inStock,
                'status' => 'published',
                'last_checked_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            ]);
            if ((int) $offer['price_idr'] !== $priceIdr) {
                $this->priceHistoryModel->record($offerId, $priceIdr);
            }
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Offer updated successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }

        $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $productId . '/edit');
    }

    /**
     * Delete an offer that belongs to a product.
     */
    public function deleteOffer(string $productId, string $offerId): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $productId = (int) $productId;
        $offerId = (int) $offerId;

        try {
            $offer = $this->offerModel->findById($offerId);

            if (!$offer || (int) $offer['product_id'] !== $productId) {
                throw new Exception('Offer not found for this product.');
            }

            if ($this->clickModel->countByOfferId($offerId) > 0) {
                $_SESSION['error'] = 'This offer has click history. Set it to Draft or Out of stock instead.';
                $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $productId . '/edit');
                return;
            }

            $this->offerModel->delete($offerId);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Offer deleted successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }

        $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/' . $productId . '/edit');
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted form fields and return product data.
     */
    private function collectInput(int $ignoreId): array
    {
        $rawName = '';
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $rawName = $_POST['name'];
        }
        $name = Validator::sanitize($rawName, 200);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new Exception('Product name is required.');
        }

        $rawSlug = '';
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $rawSlug = Validator::sanitize($_POST['slug'], 220);
        }
        $slug = $this->generateSlug($rawSlug);
        if ($slug === '') {
            $slug = $this->generateSlug($name);
        }
        if ($slug === '') {
            throw new Exception('Product slug is required.');
        }

        if ($this->productModel->slugExists($slug, $ignoreId)) {
            throw new Exception('Slug is already in use.');
        }

        $rawCategoryId = '';
        if (isset($_POST['category_id'])) {
            $rawCategoryId = $_POST['category_id'];
        }
        if (!Validator::integer($rawCategoryId, 1)) {
            throw new Exception('Category is required.');
        }
        $categoryId = (int) $rawCategoryId;

        $category = $this->categoryModel->findById($categoryId);
        if (!$category) {
            throw new Exception('Selected category does not exist.');
        }

        $brandId = null;
        if (isset($_POST['brand_id']) && $_POST['brand_id'] !== '') {
            if (!Validator::integer($_POST['brand_id'], 1)) {
                throw new Exception('Invalid brand.');
            }
            $brandId = (int) $_POST['brand_id'];

            $brand = $this->brandModel->findById($brandId);
            if (!$brand) {
                throw new Exception('Selected brand does not exist.');
            }
        }

        $rawModelNumber = '';
        if (isset($_POST['model_number'])) {
            $rawModelNumber = $_POST['model_number'];
        }
        $modelNumber = Validator::sanitize($rawModelNumber, 100);

        $rawShortDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['short_description'])) {
            $rawShortDescription = $_POST['short_description'];
        }
        $shortDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawShortDescription, 500);

        $rawDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $rawDescription = $_POST['description'];
        }
        $description = \App\Core\RichText::clean(Validator::sanitize($rawDescription, 20000, true));

        $rawImageAlt = '';
        if (isset($_POST['image_alt'])) {
            $rawImageAlt = $_POST['image_alt'];
        }
        $imageAlt = Validator::sanitize($rawImageAlt, 255);

        $status = 'draft';
        if (isset($_POST['status']) && $_POST['status'] !== '') {
            $status = Validator::sanitize($_POST['status'], 20);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($status, ['draft', 'published'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid status.');
        }

        return [
            'category_id' => $categoryId,
            'brand_id' => $brandId,
            'name' => $name,
            'slug' => $slug,
            'model_number' => $modelNumber,
            'short_description' => $shortDescription,
            'description' => $description,
            'image_alt' => $imageAlt,
            'status' => $status,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted SEO fields and return SEO meta data.
     */
    private function collectSeoInput(string $slug, string $categorySlug): array
    {
        $rawSeoTitle = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $rawSeoTitle = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        $seoTitle = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoTitle, 255);

        $rawSeoDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $rawSeoDescription = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        $seoDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoDescription, 5000);

        $rawCanonicalUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $rawCanonicalUrl = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        $canonicalUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawCanonicalUrl, 255);

        $robotsTag = 'index, follow';
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag']) && $_POST['robots_tag'] !== '') {
            $robotsTag = Validator::sanitize($_POST['robots_tag'], 50);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($robotsTag, ['index, follow', 'noindex, follow', 'index, nofollow', 'noindex, nofollow'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid robots tag.');
        }

        $rawOgDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $rawOgDescription = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        $ogDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawOgDescription, 5000);

        $rawTwitterDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $rawTwitterDescription = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        $twitterDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawTwitterDescription, 5000);

        $rawSchemaMarkup = '';
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $rawSchemaMarkup = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        $schemaMarkup = Validator::sanitize($rawSchemaMarkup, 5000);

        $rawCustomHeadTags = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $rawCustomHeadTags = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        $customHeadTags = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomHeadTags, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomBody = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $rawCustomBody = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        $customBody = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomBody, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomFooter = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $rawCustomFooter = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }
        $customFooter = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomFooter, 5000, true);

        return [
            'seo_title' => $seoTitle,
            'seo_description' => $seoDescription,
            'canonical_url' => $canonicalUrl,
            'robots_tag' => $robotsTag,
            'og_description' => $ogDescription,
            'twitter_description' => $twitterDescription,
            'schema_markup' => $schemaMarkup,
            'custom_head_tags' => $customHeadTags,
            'custom_body' => $customBody,
            'custom_footer' => $customFooter,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower(trim($value));
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim($slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored product image file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteImageFile(string $image): void
    {
        if ($image === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($image, '/uploads/products/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($image);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/products/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate and store an uploaded product image, returning its public path.
     */
    private function handleImageUpload(array $file): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/products/', 'product');
    }

    /**
     * Return the blank form data used by the create form and as the base for old input.
     */
    private function emptyFormData(): array
    {
        return [
            'category_id' => '',
            'brand_id' => '',
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'model_number' => '',
            'short_description' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'image_alt' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => 'index, follow',
            'og_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_og_desc'),
            'twitter_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_twitter_desc'),
            'schema_markup' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_schema'),
            'custom_head_tags' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_head'),
            'custom_body' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_body'),
            'custom_footer' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_footer'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Copy raw submitted POST values over the base form data for repopulation.
     */
    private function collectOldInput(array $base): array
    {
        $old = $base;

        if (isset($_POST['category_id'])) {
            $old['category_id'] = $_POST['category_id'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['brand_id'])) {

        }
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $_POST['name'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {

        }
        if (isset($_POST['model_number'])) {

        }
        if (isset($_POST['short_description'])) {
            $old['short_description'] = $_POST['short_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $_POST['description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['image_alt'])) {
            $old['image_alt'] = $_POST['image_alt'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $_POST['status'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $old['seo_title'] = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $old['seo_description'] = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $old['canonical_url'] = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag'])) {
            $old['robots_tag'] = $_POST['robots_tag'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $old['og_description'] = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $old['twitter_description'] = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $old['schema_markup'] = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $old['custom_head_tags'] = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $old['custom_body'] = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $old['custom_footer'] = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\ProductImporter;
use Exception;

/**
 * Lets admins upload a product CSV file and import it into the catalog.
 */
class AdminProductImportController extends Controller
{
    private const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5242880;
    private const ALLOWED_EXTENSION = 'csv';

    /**
     * Show the CSV upload form and the report of the last import.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $report = null;
        if (isset($_SESSION['import_report'])) {
            $report = $_SESSION['import_report'];
            unset($_SESSION['import_report']);
        }

        $this->view('dashboard/products/import', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Import Products',
            'metaDescription' => 'Import products and offers from a CSV file',
            'currentPage' => 'products-import',
            'report' => $report,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Store the uploaded CSV file in the storage folder and run the import.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/import');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $tempPath = '';
        $uploadedName = '';
        $report = null;
        $error = '';

        try {
            $file = $this->uploadedFile();
            $uploadedName = (string) $file['name'];
            $this->cleanOldTempFiles();
            $tempPath = $this->saveUploadedCsv($file);

            $importer = new ProductImporter($this->pdo, false);
            $report = $importer->importFile($tempPath);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $error = $e->getMessage();
            if ($tempPath !== '' && $uploadedName !== '') {
                $error = str_replace($tempPath, $uploadedName, $error);
            }
        } finally {
            if ($tempPath !== '' && is_file($tempPath)) {
                unlink($tempPath);
            }
        }

        if ($error !== '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $error;
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/import');
            return;
        }

        $_SESSION['import_report'] = $report;
        $_SESSION['success'] = 'Import finished: ' . $report['total_rows'] . ' rows read, '
            . $report['created_products'] . ' products created, '
            . $report['created_vendors'] . ' sellers created, '
            . $report['created_offers'] . ' offers created, '
            . $report['updated_offers'] . ' offers updated.';

        $this->redirect('/dashboard/products/import');
    }

    /**
     * Validate the uploaded file and return its details.
     */
    private function uploadedFile(): array
    {
        if (!isset($_FILES['csv_file'])) {
            throw new Exception('Please choose a CSV file.');
        }

        $file = $_FILES['csv_file'];
        if (!is_array($file) || !isset($file['error'])) {
            throw new Exception('The upload did not arrive. Please try again.');
        }

        if ($file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE || $file['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE) {
            throw new Exception('The file is too large. The maximum size is 5 MB.');
        }

        if ($file['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new Exception('The upload failed. Please try again.');
        }

        $size = (int) $file['size'];
        if ($size <= 0) {
            throw new Exception('The uploaded file is empty.');
        }

        if ($size > self::MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
            throw new Exception('The file is too large. The maximum size is 5 MB.');
        }

        $name = (string) $file['name'];
        $extension = strtolower((string) pathinfo($name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if ($extension !== self::ALLOWED_EXTENSION) {
            throw new Exception('Only .csv files are allowed.');
        }

        $temporaryName = (string) $file['tmp_name'];
        if ($temporaryName === '' || !is_readable($temporaryName)) {
            throw new Exception('The uploaded file could not be read.');
        }

        $head = file_get_contents($temporaryName, false, null, 0, 4096);
        if ($head === false) {
            throw new Exception('The uploaded file could not be read.');
        }

        if (strpos($head, "\0") !== false) {
            throw new Exception('The uploaded file is not a text CSV file.');
        }

        return $file;
    }

    /**
     * Save the uploaded CSV file in the storage folder and return its path.
     */
    private function saveUploadedCsv(array $file): string
    {
        $folder = $this->storageFolder();
        $path = $folder . '/import_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.csv';
        $moved = move_uploaded_file((string) $file['tmp_name'], $path);

        if (!$moved) {
            throw new Exception('The uploaded file could not be saved.');
        }

        return $path;
    }

    /**
     * Return the storage folder of the application and create it when needed.
     */
    private function storageFolder(): string
    {
        $folder = dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/storage';
        if (!is_dir($folder)) {
            mkdir($folder, 0755, true);
        }

        return $folder;
    }

    /**
     * Delete the temporary upload files that are left over by an interrupted import.
     */
    private function cleanOldTempFiles(): void
    {
        $files = glob($this->storageFolder() . '/import_*.csv');
        if (!$files) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $modified = @filemtime($file);
            if ($modified === false) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($modified < time() - 3600) {
                @unlink($file);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/AdminSettingController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\SettingModel;

/**
 * Manages global SEO default settings for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminSettingController extends Controller
{
    private SettingModel $settingModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the settings model.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->settingModel = new SettingModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Show the SEO defaults settings form.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $rows = $this->settingModel->findAll('setting_key ASC');

        $settings = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            if (isset($row['setting_key'])) {
                $settings[$row['setting_key']] = $row['setting_value'];
            }
        }

        $this->view('dashboard/settings/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'SEO Defaults',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage SEO Defaults',
            'currentPage' => 'settings',
            'settings' => $settings,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Save the submitted SEO default settings.
     */
    public function update(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/settings');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $fields = [
            'default_schema',
            'default_custom_head',
            'default_custom_body',
            'default_custom_footer',
            'default_og_desc',
            'default_twitter_desc',
        ];

        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            $rawValue = '';
            if (isset($_POST[$field])) {
                $rawValue = $_POST[$field];
            }
            $value = Validator::sanitize($rawValue, 5000, true);
            $this->settingModel->saveSetting($field, $value);
        }

        $_SESSION['success'] = 'SEO Defaults updated successfully.';
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/settings');
    }
}
```
