### app/Controllers/AdminStoreController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\OfferModel;
use App\Models\StoreModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;
use App\Models\SettingModel;
use App\Models\VendorModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages catalog stores for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminStoreController extends Controller
{
    private StoreModel $storeModel;
    private OfferModel $offerModel;
    private VendorModel $vendorModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;
    private SettingModel $settingModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the store and SEO models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->storeModel = new StoreModel($pdo);
        $this->offerModel = new OfferModel($pdo);
        $this->vendorModel = new VendorModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
        $this->settingModel = new SettingModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all stores ordered by name.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');

        $this->view('dashboard/stores/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Stores',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage marketplace stores',
            'currentPage' => 'stores',
            'stores' => $stores,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create store form.
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $this->view('dashboard/stores/create', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Create Store',
            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new marketplace store',
            'currentPage' => 'stores',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->emptyFormData(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new store from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput(0);
            $data['created_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['logo']) && $_FILES['logo']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleLogoUpload($_FILES['logo']);
                $data['logo'] = $newFile;
            }

            $newId = $this->storeModel->insert($data);
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('store', $newId, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Store created successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteLogoFile($newFile);
            }
            $this->view('dashboard/stores/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Store',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new marketplace store',
                'currentPage' => 'stores',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->emptyFormData()),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit store form.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $store = $this->storeModel->findById($id);

        if (!$store) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Store not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('store', $id);

        $this->view('dashboard/stores/edit', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Edit Store',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit a marketplace store',
            'currentPage' => 'stores',
            'loadSummernote' => true,
            'store' => $store,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->formDataForStore($store, $seo),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing store from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $store = $this->storeModel->findById($id);

        if (!$store) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Store not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        $newFile = '';
        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput($id);
            $data['updated_by'] = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];

            $seoData = $this->collectSeoInput($data['slug']);

            if (isset($_FILES['logo']) && $_FILES['logo']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                $newFile = $this->handleLogoUpload($_FILES['logo']);
                $data['logo'] = $newFile;
            }

            $this->storeModel->update($id, $data);
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $oldLogo = '';
                if (isset($store['logo'])) {
                    $oldLogo = (string) $store['logo'];
                }
                $this->deleteLogoFile($oldLogo);
            }
            $this->seoMetaModel->saveMeta('store', $id, $seoData);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Store updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($newFile !== '') {
                $this->deleteLogoFile($newFile);
            }
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('store', $id);
            $this->view('dashboard/stores/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Store',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit a marketplace store',
                'currentPage' => 'stores',
                'loadSummernote' => true,
                'store' => $store,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->formDataForStore($store, $seo)),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a store and its SEO meta.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $store = $this->storeModel->findById($id);

        if (!$store) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Store not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        if ($this->offerModel->countByStoreId($id) > 0 || $this->vendorModel->countByStoreId($id) > 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Cannot delete: offers or vendors still use this store.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->storeModel->delete($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Store deleted successfully.';
            $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('store', $id);
            if ($seo) {
                $this->seoMetaModel->delete((int) $seo['id']);
            }

            $oldLogo = '';
            if (isset($store['logo'])) {
                $oldLogo = (string) $store['logo'];
            }
            $this->deleteLogoFile($oldLogo);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/stores');
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted form fields and return store data.
     */
    private function collectInput(int $ignoreId): array
    {
        $rawName = '';
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $rawName = $_POST['name'];
        }
        $name = Validator::sanitize($rawName, 100);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new Exception('Store name is required.');
        }

        $rawSlug = '';
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $rawSlug = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        $slug = $this->generateSlug($rawSlug);
        if ($slug === '') {
            $slug = $this->generateSlug($name);
        }
        if ($slug === '') {
            throw new Exception('Store slug is required.');
        }

        if ($this->storeModel->slugExists($slug, $ignoreId)) {
            throw new Exception('Slug is already in use.');
        }

        $rawBaseUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['base_url'])) {
            $rawBaseUrl = $_POST['base_url'];
        }
        $baseUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawBaseUrl, 255);
        if ($baseUrl !== '' && !Validator::url($baseUrl)) {
            throw new Exception('Base URL is not valid.');
        }

        $rawAffiliateTemplate = '';
        if (isset($_POST['affiliate_url_template'])) {
            $rawAffiliateTemplate = $_POST['affiliate_url_template'];
        }
        $affiliateUrlTemplate = Validator::sanitize($rawAffiliateTemplate, 500);
        if ($affiliateUrlTemplate !== '') {
            $hasPlaceholder = false;
            if (strpos($affiliateUrlTemplate, '{url}') !== false) {
                $hasPlaceholder = true;
            }
            if (strpos($affiliateUrlTemplate, '{url_encoded}') !== false) {
                $hasPlaceholder = true;
            }
            if (strpos($affiliateUrlTemplate, '{external_id}') !== false) {
                $hasPlaceholder = true;
            }
            if (strpos($affiliateUrlTemplate, 'https://') !== 0 || !$hasPlaceholder) {
                throw new Exception('Template must start with https:// and contain {url}, {url_encoded} or {external_id}.');
            }
        }

        $rawDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $rawDescription = $_POST['description'];
        }
        $description = Validator::sanitize($rawDescription, 5000, true);

        $status = 'draft';
        if (isset($_POST['status']) && $_POST['status'] !== '') {
            $status = Validator::sanitize($_POST['status'], 20);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($status, ['draft', 'published'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid status.');
        }

        return [
            'name' => $name,
            'slug' => $slug,
            'description' => $description,
            'base_url' => $baseUrl,
            'affiliate_url_template' => $affiliateUrlTemplate,
            'status' => $status,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted SEO fields and return SEO meta data.
     */
    private function collectSeoInput(string $slug): array
    {
        $rawSeoTitle = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $rawSeoTitle = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        $seoTitle = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoTitle, 255);

        $rawSeoDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $rawSeoDescription = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        $seoDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawSeoDescription, 5000);

        $rawCanonicalUrl = '';
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $rawCanonicalUrl = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        $canonicalUrl = Validator::sanitize($rawCanonicalUrl, 255);

        $robotsTag = 'index, follow';
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag']) && $_POST['robots_tag'] !== '') {
            $robotsTag = Validator::sanitize($_POST['robots_tag'], 50);
        }
        if (!Validator::inArray($robotsTag, ['index, follow', 'noindex, follow', 'index, nofollow', 'noindex, nofollow'])) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid robots tag.');
        }

        $rawOgDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $rawOgDescription = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        $ogDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawOgDescription, 5000);

        $rawTwitterDescription = '';
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $rawTwitterDescription = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        $twitterDescription = Validator::sanitize($rawTwitterDescription, 5000);

        $rawSchemaMarkup = '';
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $rawSchemaMarkup = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        $schemaMarkup = Validator::sanitize($rawSchemaMarkup, 5000);

        $rawCustomHeadTags = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $rawCustomHeadTags = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        $customHeadTags = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomHeadTags, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomBody = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $rawCustomBody = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        $customBody = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomBody, 5000, true);

        $rawCustomFooter = '';
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $rawCustomFooter = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }
        $customFooter = Validator::sanitize($rawCustomFooter, 5000, true);

        return [
            'seo_title' => $seoTitle,
            'seo_description' => $seoDescription,
            'canonical_url' => $canonicalUrl,
            'robots_tag' => $robotsTag,
            'og_description' => $ogDescription,
            'twitter_description' => $twitterDescription,
            'schema_markup' => $schemaMarkup,
            'custom_head_tags' => $customHeadTags,
            'custom_body' => $customBody,
            'custom_footer' => $customFooter,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower(trim($value));
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim($slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Return the blank form data used by the create form and as the base for old input.
     */
    private function emptyFormData(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'base_url' => '',
            'affiliate_url_template' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => 'index, follow',
            'og_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_og_desc'),
            'twitter_description' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_twitter_desc'),
            'schema_markup' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_schema'),
            'custom_head_tags' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_head'),
            'custom_body' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_body'),
            'custom_footer' => $this->settingModel->getValue('default_custom_footer'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Copy raw submitted POST values over the base form data for repopulation.
     */
    private function collectOldInput(array $base): array
    {
        $old = $base;

        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $_POST['name'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $_POST['description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['base_url'])) {
            $old['base_url'] = $_POST['base_url'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['affiliate_url_template'])) {
            $old['affiliate_url_template'] = $_POST['affiliate_url_template'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $_POST['status'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_title'])) {
            $old['seo_title'] = $_POST['seo_title'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['seo_description'])) {
            $old['seo_description'] = $_POST['seo_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['canonical_url'])) {
            $old['canonical_url'] = $_POST['canonical_url'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['robots_tag'])) {
            $old['robots_tag'] = $_POST['robots_tag'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['og_description'])) {
            $old['og_description'] = $_POST['og_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['twitter_description'])) {
            $old['twitter_description'] = $_POST['twitter_description'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['schema_markup'])) {
            $old['schema_markup'] = $_POST['schema_markup'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_head_tags'])) {
            $old['custom_head_tags'] = $_POST['custom_head_tags'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_body'])) {
            $old['custom_body'] = $_POST['custom_body'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['custom_footer'])) {
            $old['custom_footer'] = $_POST['custom_footer'];
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Build the old form data for the edit view from a store and its SEO meta.
     */
    private function formDataForStore(array $store, ?array $seo): array
    {
        $old = [
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'base_url' => '',
            'affiliate_url_template' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'seo_title' => '',
            'seo_description' => '',
            'canonical_url' => '',
            'robots_tag' => '',
            'og_description' => '',
            'twitter_description' => '',
            'schema_markup' => '',
            'custom_head_tags' => '',
            'custom_body' => '',
            'custom_footer' => '',
        ];

        if (isset($store['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $store['name'];
        }
        if (isset($store['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $store['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($store['description'])) {
            $old['description'] = $store['description'];
        }
        if (isset($store['base_url'])) {
            $old['base_url'] = $store['base_url'];
        }
        if (isset($store['affiliate_url_template'])) {
            $old['affiliate_url_template'] = $store['affiliate_url_template'];
        }
        if (isset($store['status'])) {
            $old['status'] = $store['status'];
        }

        if ($seo !== null) {
            if (isset($seo['seo_title'])) {
                $old['seo_title'] = $seo['seo_title'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['seo_description'])) {
                $old['seo_description'] = $seo['seo_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['canonical_url'])) {
                $old['canonical_url'] = $seo['canonical_url'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['robots_tag'])) {
                $old['robots_tag'] = $seo['robots_tag'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['og_description'])) {
                $old['og_description'] = $seo['og_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['twitter_description'])) {
                $old['twitter_description'] = $seo['twitter_description'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['schema_markup'])) {
                $old['schema_markup'] = $seo['schema_markup'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_head_tags'])) {
                $old['custom_head_tags'] = $seo['custom_head_tags'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_body'])) {
                $old['custom_body'] = $seo['custom_body'];
            }
            if (isset($seo['custom_footer'])) {
                $old['custom_footer'] = $seo['custom_footer'];
            }
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored store logo file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteLogoFile(string $logo): void
    {
        if ($logo === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($logo, '/uploads/stores/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($logo);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/stores/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate and store an uploaded store logo, returning its public path.
     */
    private function handleLogoUpload(array $file): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/stores/', 'store');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\UserModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages admin user accounts for root users.
 */
class AdminUserController extends Controller
{
    private UserModel $userModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the user model.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->userModel = new UserModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all admin users (never root).
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        $allUsers = $this->userModel->findAll('id ASC');
        $admins = [];
        foreach ($allUsers as $user) {
            if ($user['role'] === 'admin') {
                unset($user['password']);
                $admins[] = $user;
            }
        }

        $this->view('dashboard/admins/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Admins',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage admin users',
            'currentPage' => 'admins',
            'admins' => $admins,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create admin form.
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        $this->view('dashboard/admins/create', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Create Admin',
            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new admin user',
            'currentPage' => 'admins',
            'error' => '',
            'old' => [
                'phone' => '',
                'username' => '',
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new admin from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $rawPhone = '';
        if (isset($_POST['phone'])) {
            $rawPhone = $_POST['phone'];
        }
        $phone = Validator::sanitize($rawPhone, 50);

        $rawUsername = '';
        if (isset($_POST['username'])) {
            $rawUsername = $_POST['username'];
        }
        $username = Validator::sanitize($rawUsername, 50);

        $password = '';
        if (isset($_POST['password'])) {
            $password = $_POST['password'];
        }

        $confirmPassword = '';
        if (isset($_POST['confirm_password'])) {
            $confirmPassword = $_POST['confirm_password'];
        }

        $error = '';
        if ($password !== $confirmPassword) {
            $error = 'Passwords do not match';
        } else {
            $passwordCheck = Validator::passwordStrength($password);
            if (!$passwordCheck['valid']) {
                $error = implode('; ', $passwordCheck['errors']);
            }
        }

        if ($error !== '') {
            $this->view('dashboard/admins/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Admin',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new admin user',
                'currentPage' => 'admins',
                'error' => $error,
                'old' => [
                    'phone' => $phone,
                    'username' => $username,
                ],
            ]);
            return;
        }

        try {
            $newId = $this->userModel->register($phone, $password, 'admin');
            if ($username !== '') {
                $this->userModel->updateUsername($newId, $username);
            }
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Admin created successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $this->view('dashboard/admins/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Admin',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new admin user',
                'currentPage' => 'admins',
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => [
                    'phone' => $phone,
                    'username' => $username,
                ],
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit admin form.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $admin = $this->userModel->findById($id);

        if (!$admin) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Admin not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        if ($admin['role'] === 'root') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Access denied.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        unset($admin['password']);

        $this->view('dashboard/admins/edit', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Edit Admin',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit an admin user',
            'currentPage' => 'admins',
            'admin' => $admin,
            'error' => '',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing admin from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $admin = $this->userModel->findById($id);

        if (!$admin) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Admin not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        if ($admin['role'] === 'root') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Access denied.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        $rawUsername = '';
        if (isset($_POST['username'])) {
            $rawUsername = $_POST['username'];
        }
        $username = Validator::sanitize($rawUsername, 50);

        $newPassword = '';
        if (isset($_POST['new_password'])) {
            $newPassword = $_POST['new_password'];
        }

        $confirmPassword = '';
        if (isset($_POST['confirm_password'])) {
            $confirmPassword = $_POST['confirm_password'];
        }

        $error = '';
        if ($newPassword !== '') {
            if ($newPassword !== $confirmPassword) {
                $error = 'Passwords do not match';
            } else {
                $passwordCheck = Validator::passwordStrength($newPassword);
                if (!$passwordCheck['valid']) {
                    $error = implode('; ', $passwordCheck['errors']);
                }
            }
        }

        if ($error !== '') {
            unset($admin['password']);
            $this->view('dashboard/admins/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Admin',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit an admin user',
                'currentPage' => 'admins',
                'admin' => $admin,
                'error' => $error,
            ]);
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->userModel->updateUsername($id, $username);
            if ($newPassword !== '') {
                $this->userModel->resetPassword($id, $newPassword);
            }
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Admin updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            unset($admin['password']);
            $this->view('dashboard/admins/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Admin',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit an admin user',
                'currentPage' => 'admins',
                'admin' => $admin,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Mark an admin account as verified.
     */
    public function verify(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $admin = $this->userModel->findById($id);

        if (!$admin || $admin['role'] !== 'admin') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Admin not found';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->userModel->markVerified($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Admin verified successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
    }

    /**
     * Mark an admin account as unverified.
     */
    public function unverify(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $admin = $this->userModel->findById($id);

        if (!$admin || $admin['role'] !== 'admin') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Admin not found';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->userModel->update($id, ['is_verified' => 0]);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Admin unverified successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
    }

    /**
     * Delete an admin account.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireRoot();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $admin = $this->userModel->findById($id);

        if (!$admin) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Admin not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        if ($admin['role'] === 'root') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Access denied.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->userModel->delete($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Admin deleted successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/admins');
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/AdminVendorController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\OfferModel;
use App\Models\VendorModel;
use App\Models\StoreModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Manages vendors (sellers) for admins and root users.
 */
class AdminVendorController extends Controller
{
    private VendorModel $vendorModel;
    private StoreModel $storeModel;
    private OfferModel $offerModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the vendor and store models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->vendorModel = new VendorModel($pdo);
        $this->storeModel = new StoreModel($pdo);
        $this->offerModel = new OfferModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all vendors with their store names.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $vendors = $this->vendorModel->findAllWithStore();

        $this->view('dashboard/vendors/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Vendors',
            'metaDescription' => 'Manage marketplace vendors',
            'currentPage' => 'vendors',
            'vendors' => $vendors,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show the create vendor form.
     */
    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');

        $this->view('dashboard/vendors/create', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Create Vendor',
            'metaDescription' => 'Create a new marketplace vendor',
            'currentPage' => 'vendors',
            'stores' => $stores,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->emptyFormData(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new vendor from the submitted form.
     */
    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput(0);

            $this->vendorModel->insert($data);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Vendor created successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');

            $this->view('dashboard/vendors/create', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Create Vendor',
                'metaDescription' => 'Create a new marketplace vendor',
                'currentPage' => 'vendors',
                'stores' => $stores,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->emptyFormData()),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the edit vendor form.
     */
    public function edit(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $vendor = $this->vendorModel->findById($id);

        if (!$vendor) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Vendor not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');

        $this->view('dashboard/vendors/edit', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Edit Vendor',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit a marketplace vendor',
            'currentPage' => 'vendors',
            'vendor' => $vendor,
            'stores' => $stores,
            'error' => '',
            'old' => $this->formDataForVendor($vendor),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing vendor from the submitted form.
     */
    public function update(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $vendor = $this->vendorModel->findById($id);

        if (!$vendor) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Vendor not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $data = $this->collectInput($id);

            $submittedStoreId = 0;
            if (isset($data['store_id'])) {
                $submittedStoreId = (int) $data['store_id'];
            }
            $currentStoreId = 0;
            if (isset($vendor['store_id'])) {
                $currentStoreId = (int) $vendor['store_id'];
            }
            if ($submittedStoreId !== $currentStoreId && $this->offerModel->countByVendorId($id) > 0) {
                throw new Exception('Cannot change the store of a vendor that already has offers.');
            }

            $this->vendorModel->update($id, $data);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Vendor updated successfully.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $stores = $this->storeModel->findAll('name ASC');
            $this->view('dashboard/vendors/edit', [
                'pageTitle' => 'Edit Vendor',
                'metaDescription' => 'Edit a marketplace vendor',
                'currentPage' => 'vendors',
                'vendor' => $vendor,
                'stores' => $stores,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                'old' => $this->collectOldInput($this->formDataForVendor($vendor)),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete a vendor.
     */
    public function delete(string $id): void
    {
        $this->requireAdmin();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $id = (int) $id;
        $vendor = $this->vendorModel->findById($id);

        if (!$vendor) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Vendor not found.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        if ($this->offerModel->countByVendorId($id) > 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Cannot delete: offers still use this vendor.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->vendorModel->delete($id);
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Vendor deleted successfully.';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
        }
        $this->redirect('/dashboard/vendors');
    }

    /**
     * Validate submitted form fields and return vendor data.
     */
    private function collectInput(int $ignoreId): array
    {
        $rawStoreId = '';
        if (isset($_POST['store_id'])) {
            $rawStoreId = $_POST['store_id'];
        }
        if (!Validator::integer($rawStoreId, 1)) {
            throw new Exception('Store is required.');
        }
        $storeId = (int) $rawStoreId;

        $store = $this->storeModel->findById($storeId);
        if (!$store) {
            throw new Exception('Selected store does not exist.');
        }

        $rawName = '';
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $rawName = $_POST['name'];
        }
        $name = Validator::sanitize($rawName, 255);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new Exception('Vendor name is required.');
        }

        $rawSlug = '';
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $rawSlug = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        $slug = $this->generateSlug($rawSlug);
        if ($slug === '') {
            $slug = $this->generateSlug($name);
        }
        if ($slug === '') {
            throw new Exception('Vendor slug is required.');
        }

        if ($this->vendorModel->slugExists($slug, $ignoreId)) {
            throw new Exception('Slug is already in use.');
        }

        $rawRating = '';
        if (isset($_POST['rating'])) {
            $rawRating = $_POST['rating'];
        }
        $rating = null;
        if ($rawRating !== '') {
            if (!is_numeric($rawRating)) {
                throw new Exception('Rating must be a number.');
            }
            $rating = (float) $rawRating;
            if ($rating < 0 || $rating > 5) {
                throw new Exception('Rating must be between 0 and 5.');
            }
        }

        return [
            'store_id' => $storeId,
            'name' => $name,
            'slug' => $slug,
            'rating' => $rating,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower(trim($value));
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim($slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Return the blank form data used by the create form and as the base for old input.
     */
    private function emptyFormData(): array
    {
        return [
            'store_id' => '',
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'rating' => '',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Copy raw submitted POST values over the base form data for repopulation.
     */
    private function collectOldInput(array $base): array
    {
        $old = $base;

        if (isset($_POST['store_id'])) {
            $old['store_id'] = $_POST['store_id'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $_POST['name'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $_POST['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($_POST['rating'])) {
            $old['rating'] = $_POST['rating'];
        }

        return $old;
    }

    /**
     * Build the old form data for the edit view from a vendor.
     */
    private function formDataForVendor(array $vendor): array
    {
        $old = [
            'store_id' => '',
            'name' => '',
            'slug' => '',
            'rating' => '',
        ];

        if (isset($vendor['store_id'])) {
            $old['store_id'] = $vendor['store_id'];
        }
        if (isset($vendor['name'])) {
            $old['name'] = $vendor['name'];
        }
        if (isset($vendor['slug'])) {
            $old['slug'] = $vendor['slug'];
        }
        if (isset($vendor['rating'])) {
            $old['rating'] = $vendor['rating'];
        }

        return $old;
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/AuthController.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Authentication Controller
 * Handles user registration, login, logout, and rate limiting
 */
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Models\UserModel;
use App\Models\MemberModel;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\RateLimiter;
use App\Core\RateLimitException;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Core\SecurityLogger;
use Exception;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    private UserModel $model;
    private MemberModel $memberModel;
    private RateLimiter $rateLimiter;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->model       = new UserModel($pdo);
        $this->memberModel = new MemberModel($pdo);
        $this->rateLimiter = new RateLimiter($pdo);
    }

    public function showLogin(): void
    {
        $this->view('auth/login', ['pageTitle' => 'Sign In']);
    }

    /**
     * Render the public member registration form.
     */
    public function showRegister(): void
    {
        $this->view('auth/register', ['pageTitle' => 'Register']);
    }

    /**
     * Register a new public member from the submitted form.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $remoteAddress = '';
        if (isset($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'])) {
            $remoteAddress = (string) $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
        }

        try {
            $this->rateLimiter->consume($remoteAddress, 'register');
        } catch (RateLimitException $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.';
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        $rawEmail = '';
        if (isset($_POST['email'])) {
            $rawEmail = $_POST['email'];
        }
        $email = Validator::sanitize($rawEmail, 255);

        $password = '';
        if (isset($_POST['password'])) {
            $password = $_POST['password'];
        }

        $confirmPassword = '';
        if (isset($_POST['confirm_password'])) {
            $confirmPassword = $_POST['confirm_password'];
        }

        if ($password !== $confirmPassword) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Passwords do not match.';
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        if (strlen($password) < 8) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Password must be at least 8 characters.';
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        $rawWhatsapp = '';
        if (isset($_POST['whatsapp'])) {
            $rawWhatsapp = $_POST['whatsapp'];
        }
        $whatsapp = Validator::sanitize($rawWhatsapp, 30);
        $whatsapp = preg_replace('/[\s\-]/', '', $whatsapp);
        // Validate whatsapp number: must start with + or 0 and contain digits only.
        if (preg_match('/^(\+|0)[0-9]{8,18}$/', $whatsapp) !== 1) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'WhatsApp number must start with + or 0 and contain digits only.';
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->memberModel->register($email, $password, $whatsapp);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
            $this->redirect('/register');
            return;
        }

        $_SESSION['success'] = 'Registration successful. An administrator must activate your account before you can sign in.';
        $this->redirect('/login');
    }

    /**
     * Verify a member account from an emailed token.
     */
    public function verifyEmail(string $token): void
    {
        $token = Validator::sanitize($token, 64);
        $member = $this->memberModel->findByToken($token);

        if (!$member) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid or expired verification token.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $this->memberModel->activateUser((int) $member['id']);
        $_SESSION['success'] = 'Your email has been verified. You can now sign in.';
        $this->redirect('/login');
    }

    public function login(): void
    {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        // 1. Read the identifier (email for members, phone for staff)
        $rawIdentifier = '';
        if (isset($_POST['phone'])) {
            $rawIdentifier = $_POST['phone'];
        }
        $identifier = Validator::sanitize($rawIdentifier, 255);
        $password = '';
        if (isset($_POST['password'])) {
            $password = $_POST['password'];
        }

        if (empty($identifier)) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Email or phone number is required.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        // Member login (identifier contains '@')
        if (strpos($identifier, '@') !== false) {
            CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

            try {
                $this->rateLimiter->consume($identifier, 'login');
            } catch (RateLimitException $e) {
                $wait = RateLimiter::formatRetryAfter($e->getRetryAfter());
                $_SESSION['error'] = "Too many login attempts for this account. Please try again in {$wait}.";
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }

            try {
                $member = $this->memberModel->login($identifier, $password);
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                $_SESSION['error'] = $e->getMessage();
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }

            if ($member) {
                $this->rateLimiter->clear($identifier, 'login');

                $_SESSION['user_id'] = $member['id'];
                $_SESSION['role'] = 'visitor';
                $_SESSION['email'] = $identifier;
                $_SESSION['username'] = $member['email'];
                $memberAvatar = null;
                if (isset($member['avatar'])) {
                    $memberAvatar = $member['avatar'];
                }
                $_SESSION['avatar'] = $memberAvatar;
                $_SESSION['phone'] = '';

                session_regenerate_id(true);
                CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();

                $this->redirect('/member');
                return;
            }

            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid email or password.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        // Staff login (phone number)
        $phone = Validator::sanitize($rawIdentifier, 50);

        if (!Validator::phone($phone)) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid phone number format.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        // 1. CSRF protection
        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        // 2. Rate limiting: 5 attempts per 5 minutes PER PHONE NUMBER.
        // By passing $phone instead of 'login', we prevent attackers from 
        // bypassing the limit by simply rotating their IP address.
        try {
            $this->rateLimiter->consume($phone, 'login');
        } catch (RateLimitException $e) {
            $wait = RateLimiter::formatRetryAfter($e->getRetryAfter());
            $_SESSION['error'] = "Too many login attempts for this account. Please try again in {$wait}.";
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        // 3. Attempt login
        $user = $this->model->login($phone, $password);
        
        if ($user) {
            // Clear rate limit on successful login so legitimate typos don't haunt the user
            $this->rateLimiter->clear($phone, 'login');

            if (class_exists(SecurityLogger::class)) {
                $logger = new SecurityLogger();
                $logger->logAuth('login', true, ['user_id' => $user['id'], 'phone' => $phone]);
            }

            $_SESSION['user_id'] = $user['id'];
            $_SESSION['role'] = $user['role'];
            $sessionUsername = null;
            if (isset($user['username'])) {
                $sessionUsername = $user['username'];
            }
            $_SESSION['username'] = $sessionUsername;
            $sessionAvatar = null;
            if (isset($user['avatar'])) {
                $sessionAvatar = $user['avatar'];
            }
            $_SESSION['avatar'] = $sessionAvatar;
            $sessionPhone = null;
            if (isset($user['phone'])) {
                $sessionPhone = $user['phone'];
            }
            $_SESSION['phone'] = $sessionPhone;
            
            // Regenerate session ID for security (prevents session fixation)
            session_regenerate_id(true); 
            
            // Regenerate CSRF token after privilege elevation
            CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();
            
            $this->redirect('/dashboard');
        } else {
            if (class_exists(SecurityLogger::class)) {
                $logger = new SecurityLogger();
                $logger->logAuth('login', false, ['phone' => $phone, 'reason' => 'invalid_credentials']);
            }
            
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid phone number or password.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
        }
    }

    public function logout(): void
    {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/dashboard');
            return;
        }
        
        \App\Core\CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        // 1. Unset all session variables immediately
        $_SESSION = [];

        // 2. Delete the session cookie securely using ARRAY syntax
        if (ini_get("session.use_cookies")) {
            $params = session_get_cookie_params();
            
            // ✅ CORRECT: Use the array options syntax for setcookie()
            $sameSite = 'Lax';
            if (isset($params["samesite"])) {
                $sameSite = $params["samesite"];
            }
            setcookie(session_name(), '', [
                'expires'  => time() - 42000,
                'path'     => $params["path"],
                'domain'   => $params["domain"],
                'secure'   => $params["secure"],
                'httponly' => $params["httponly"],
                'samesite' => $sameSite
            ]);
        }

        // 3. Destroy the session data on the server
        session_destroy();

        // 4. Start a fresh session solely to hold the success flash message
        session_start();
        session_regenerate_id(true); // Ensure the new session gets a pristine, unpredictable ID
        
        \App\Core\CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();
        $_SESSION['success'] = 'You have been signed out.';
        
        $this->redirect('/login');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Models\UserModel;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\OfferModel;
use App\Models\MemberModel;
use App\Models\ClickModel;
use Exception;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    private UserModel $userModel;
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private OfferModel $offerModel;
    private MemberModel $memberModel;
    private ClickModel $clickModel;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->userModel = new UserModel($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->offerModel = new OfferModel($pdo);
        $this->memberModel = new MemberModel($pdo);
        $this->clickModel = new ClickModel($pdo);
    }

    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->requireLogin();

        if (isset($_SESSION['role']) && $_SESSION['role'] === 'visitor') {
            $this->redirect('/member');
            return;
        }

        $productCount = $this->productModel->countAll();
        $offerCount = $this->offerModel->countActive();
        $memberCount = $this->memberModel->countByStatus('active');

        $this->view('dashboard/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Dashboard',
            'metaDescription' => 'Admin Dashboard - Overview of your application',
            'productCount' => $productCount,
            'offerCount' => $offerCount,
            'memberCount' => $memberCount,
        ]);
    }

    public function clicks(): void
    {
        $this->requireLogin();

        if (isset($_SESSION['role']) && $_SESSION['role'] === 'visitor') {
            $this->redirect('/member');
            return;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM `offer_clicks`');
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $totalClicks = (int) $row['c'];

        $sort = 'clicks';
        if (isset($_GET['sort'])) {
            $rawSort = (string) $_GET['sort'];
            if ($rawSort === 'name' || $rawSort === 'id' || $rawSort === 'clicks') {
                $sort = $rawSort;
            }
        }

        $dir = 'desc';
        if (isset($_GET['dir'])) {
            $rawDir = (string) $_GET['dir'];
            if ($rawDir === 'asc' || $rawDir === 'desc') {
                $dir = $rawDir;
            }
        }

        $clickStats = $this->clickModel->getProductClickStats($sort, $dir);

        $this->view('dashboard/clicks', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Click Analytics',
            'metaDescription' => 'Click analytics - Affiliate click tracking overview',
            'currentPage' => 'clicks',
            'totalClicks' => $totalClicks,
            'clickStats' => $clickStats,
            'sort' => $sort,
            'dir' => $dir,
        ]);
    }

    public function profile(): void
    {
        $this->requireLogin();

        if (isset($_SESSION['role']) && $_SESSION['role'] === 'visitor') {
            $this->redirect('/member');
            return;
        }

        $userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];
        $user = $this->userModel->findById($userId);

        $error = '';
        $success = '';

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            \App\Core\CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();
            $action = '';
            if (isset($_POST['action'])) {
                $action = $_POST['action'];
            }

            try {
                if ($action === 'update_username') {
                    $rawUsername = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['username'])) {
                        $rawUsername = $_POST['username'];
                    }
                    $username = trim($rawUsername);
                    $this->userModel->updateUsername($userId, $username);
                    $sessionUsername = null;
                    if ($username) {
                        $sessionUsername = $username;
                    }
                    $_SESSION['username'] = $sessionUsername;
                    $success = 'Username updated successfully';
                    $user = $this->userModel->findById($userId);
                } elseif ($action === 'change_password') {
                    $currentPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['current_password'])) {
                        $currentPassword = $_POST['current_password'];
                    }
                    $newPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['new_password'])) {
                        $newPassword = $_POST['new_password'];
                    }
                    $confirmPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['confirm_password'])) {
                        $confirmPassword = $_POST['confirm_password'];
                    }

                    if ($newPassword !== $confirmPassword) {
                        throw new Exception('New passwords do not match');
                    }

                    $this->userModel->changePassword($userId, $currentPassword, $newPassword);
                    $success = 'Password changed successfully';
                } elseif ($action === 'update_avatar') {
                    if (isset($_FILES['avatar']) && $_FILES['avatar']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                        $oldAvatar = '';
                        if (isset($user['avatar'])) {
                            $oldAvatar = (string) $user['avatar'];
                        }

                        $avatarPath = $this->handleAvatarUpload($_FILES['avatar'], $userId);
                        $this->userModel->updateAvatar($userId, $avatarPath);
                        $this->deleteAvatarFile($oldAvatar);
                        $_SESSION['avatar'] = $avatarPath;
                        $success = 'Avatar updated successfully';
                        $user = $this->userModel->findById($userId);
                    } else {
                        throw new Exception('Please select a valid image file');
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                $error = $e->getMessage();
            }
        }

        $this->view('dashboard/profile', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Profile',
            'metaDescription' => 'User Profile',
            'user' => $user,
            'error' => $error,
            'success' => $success,
        ]);
    }

    private function handleAvatarUpload(array $file, int $userId): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/avatars/', 'avatar_' . $userId);
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored avatar file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteAvatarFile(string $avatar): void
    {
        if ($avatar === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($avatar, '/uploads/avatars/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($avatar);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/avatars/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    private BrandModel $brandModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the catalog models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->categoryModel = new CategoryModel($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Render the homepage with the latest published categories, brands, and products.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $categoryRows = $this->categoryModel->findAllPublished('sort_order ASC');
        $categories = array_slice($categoryRows, 0, 8);

        $newestProducts = $this->productModel->findNewestPublished(8);

        $categorySections = [];
        $sectionIndex = 0;
        foreach ($categoryRows as $categoryRow) {
            if ($sectionIndex >= 6) {
                break;
            }
            $sectionIndex++;

            $sectionProducts = $this->productModel->findLatestActiveByCategoryId((int) $categoryRow['id'], 8);
            if (count($sectionProducts) < 1) {
                continue;
            }

            $categorySections[] = [
                'category' => $categoryRow,
                'products' => $sectionProducts,
            ];
        }

        $brands = $this->brandModel->findPublishedWithProducts(12);

        $this->view('home/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'GudangPC - Compare PC Component Prices',
            'metaDescription' => 'Compare prices for PC components across Indonesian marketplaces.',
            'seo' => null,
            'canonicalUrl' => Seo::absoluteUrl('/'),
            'ogImage' => '',
            'categories' => $categories,
            'newestProducts' => $newestProducts,
            'categorySections' => $categorySections,
            'brands' => $brands,
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\MemberModel;
use App\Models\WishlistModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Member area for logged-in visitors.
 */
class MemberAreaController extends Controller
{
    private MemberModel $memberModel;
    private WishlistModel $wishlistModel;

    /**
     * Require a logged-in visitor and build the member model.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->memberModel = new MemberModel($pdo);
        $this->wishlistModel = new WishlistModel($pdo);

        $loggedIn = false;
        if (isset($_SESSION['user_id']) && $_SESSION['user_id'] != 0) {
            $loggedIn = true;
        }
        $role = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
            $role = $_SESSION['role'];
        }
        if (!$loggedIn || $role !== 'visitor') {
            $this->redirect('/login');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Show the member dashboard.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
        $member = $this->memberModel->findById($userId);

        if (!$member) {
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $wishlist = [];
        if (isset($_SESSION['user_id']) && $_SESSION['user_id'] != 0) {
            $wishlist = $this->wishlistModel->findAllByMember($userId);
        }

        $memberUsername = null;
        if (isset($member['username'])) {
            $memberUsername = $member['username'];
        }
        $_SESSION['username'] = $memberUsername;

        $displayName = '';
        if (isset($member['email'])) {
            $displayName = $member['email'];
        }
        if ($memberUsername !== null && $memberUsername !== '') {
            $displayName = $memberUsername;
        }

        unset($member['password']);

        $this->view('member/dashboard', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Member Area',
            'metaDescription' => 'Your member area',
            'member' => $member,
            'displayName' => $displayName,
            'wishlist' => $wishlist,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show and handle the member profile form.
     */
    public function profile(): void
    {
        $userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
        $member = $this->memberModel->findById($userId);

        if (!$member) {
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $memberUsername = null;
        if (isset($member['username'])) {
            $memberUsername = $member['username'];
        }
        $_SESSION['username'] = $memberUsername;

        $error = '';
        $success = '';

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

            $action = '';
            if (isset($_POST['action'])) {
                $action = $_POST['action'];
            }

            try {
                if ($action === 'update_profile') {
                    $username = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['username'])) {
                        $username = Validator::sanitize($_POST['username'], 50);
                    }

                    $this->memberModel->updateUsername($userId, $username);

                    $sessionUsername = null;
                    if ($username !== '') {
                        $sessionUsername = $username;
                    }
                    $_SESSION['username'] = $sessionUsername;

                    if (isset($_FILES['avatar']) && $_FILES['avatar']['error'] === UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
                        $oldAvatar = '';
                        if (isset($member['avatar'])) {
                            $oldAvatar = (string) $member['avatar'];
                        }

                        try {
                            $avatarPath = $this->handleAvatarUpload($_FILES['avatar'], $userId);
                        } catch (Exception $e) {
                            throw new Exception('Failed to upload avatar: ' . $e->getMessage());
                        }
                        $this->memberModel->updateAvatar($userId, $avatarPath);
                        $this->deleteAvatarFile($oldAvatar);
                        $_SESSION['avatar'] = $avatarPath;
                    }

                    $success = 'Profile updated successfully';
                } elseif ($action === 'change_password') {
                    $currentPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['current_password'])) {
                        $currentPassword = $_POST['current_password'];
                    }
                    $newPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['new_password'])) {
                        $newPassword = $_POST['new_password'];
                    }
                    $confirmPassword = '';
                    if (isset($_POST['confirm_password'])) {
                        $confirmPassword = $_POST['confirm_password'];
                    }

                    if (!password_verify($currentPassword, $member['password'])) {
                        throw new Exception('Current password is incorrect');
                    }
                    if ($newPassword !== $confirmPassword) {
                        throw new Exception('New passwords do not match');
                    }
                    if (strlen($newPassword) < 8) {
                        throw new Exception('Password must be at least 8 characters');
                    }

                    $this->memberModel->updatePassword($userId, $newPassword);
                    $success = 'Password changed successfully';
                }
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                $error = $e->getMessage();
            }

            $member = $this->memberModel->findById($userId);
            if (!$member) {
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }

            $memberUsername = null;
            if (isset($member['username'])) {
                $memberUsername = $member['username'];
            }
            $_SESSION['username'] = $memberUsername;
        }

        unset($member['password']);

        $this->view('member/profile', [
            'pageTitle' => 'My Profile',
            'metaDescription' => 'Edit your member profile',
            'user' => $member,
            'error' => $error,
            'success' => $success,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Validate and store an uploaded avatar, returning its public path.
     */
    private function handleAvatarUpload(array $file, int $userId): string
    {
        return $this->processAndSaveImage($file, 'uploads/avatars/', 'avatar_' . $userId);
    }

    /**
     * Delete a stored avatar file if it exists.
     */
    private function deleteAvatarFile(string $avatar): void
    {
        if ($avatar === '') {
            return;
        }
        if (strpos($avatar, '/uploads/avatars/') !== 0) {
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($avatar);
        $path = __DIR__ . '/../../public/uploads/avatars/' . $filename;
        if (is_file($path)) {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/PublicBrandController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\Seo;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\BrandModel;
use App\Models\CategoryModel;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;

/**
 * Serves public brand pages.
 */
class PublicBrandController extends Controller
{
    private BrandModel $brandModel;
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private CategoryModel $categoryModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the brand, product and category models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->categoryModel = new CategoryModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * List all published brands.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $brands = $this->brandModel->findAllPublished();

        $this->view('public/brands/index', [
            'pageTitle' => 'Brands',
            'metaDescription' => 'Browse all product brands',
            'brands' => $brands,
            'seo' => null,
            'canonicalUrl' => Seo::absoluteUrl('/brands'),
            'ogImage' => '',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Show a single published brand by slug.
     */
    public function show(string $slug): void
    {
        $brand = $this->brandModel->findBySlug($slug);

        if (!$brand) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        if ($brand['status'] !== 'published') {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $sort = 'newest';
        if (isset($_GET['sort'])) {
            $rawSort = (string) $_GET['sort'];
            if (Validator::inArray($rawSort, ['newest', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'])) {
                $sort = $rawSort;
            }
        }

        $page = 1;
        if (isset($_GET['page'])) {
            if (Validator::integer($_GET['page'], 1)) {
                $page = (int) $_GET['page'];
            }
        }

        $perPage = 20;
        $total = $this->productModel->countByBrandSlug($slug);
        $totalPages = (int) ceil($total / $perPage);
        if ($totalPages < 1) {
            $totalPages = 1;
        }
        if ($page > $totalPages && $page > 1) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
        $products = $this->productModel->findAllByBrandSlug($slug, $perPage, $offset, $sort);

        $fallbackDescription = '';
        $fallbackImage = '';
        foreach ($products as $product) {
            if (!isset($product['category_id'])) {
                continue;
            }

            $category = $this->categoryModel->findById((int) $product['category_id']);
            if (!$category) {
```
