### app/Controllers/PublicProductController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\Seo;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\OfferModel;
use App\Models\SeoMetaModel;
use App\Models\BrandModel;
use App\Models\ClickModel;
use App\Models\WishlistModel;

/**
 * Serves the public product detail page and tracked affiliate redirects.
 */
class PublicProductController extends Controller
{
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private OfferModel $offerModel;
    private SeoMetaModel $seoMetaModel;
    private BrandModel $brandModel;
    private ClickModel $clickModel;
    private WishlistModel $wishlistModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build all required models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->offerModel = new OfferModel($pdo);
        $this->seoMetaModel = new SeoMetaModel($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
        $this->clickModel = new ClickModel($pdo);
        $this->wishlistModel = new WishlistModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Show a single published product by its category and product slugs.
     */
    public function show(string $categorySlug, string $productSlug): void
    {
        $product = $this->productModel->findBySlug($productSlug);

        if (!$product) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        if ($product['status'] !== 'published') {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $productId = (int) $product['id'];
        $full = $this->productModel->findByIdWithRelations($productId);

        if ($full === null) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $categoryStatus = '';
        if (isset($full['category_status'])) {
            $categoryStatus = (string) $full['category_status'];
        }
        if ($categoryStatus !== 'published') {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        if ($full['category_slug'] !== $categorySlug) {
            $correctCategorySlug = '';
            if (isset($full['category_slug'])) {
                $correctCategorySlug = (string) $full['category_slug'];
            }
            $correctProductSlug = '';
            if (isset($full['slug'])) {
                $correctProductSlug = (string) $full['slug'];
            }
            $base = '';
            if (isset($GLOBALS['base'])) {
                $base = $GLOBALS['base'];
            }
            header('Location: ' . $base . '/' . $correctCategorySlug . '/' . $correctProductSlug, true, 301);
            exit;
        }

        $seo = $this->seoMetaModel->findByMeta('product', $productId);

        $brandName = '';
        if (isset($product['brand_id']) && $product['brand_id'] !== null) {
            $brand = $this->brandModel->findById((int) $product['brand_id']);
            if ($brand) {
                if (isset($brand['name'])) {
                    $brandName = (string) $brand['name'];
                }
            }
        }

        $offers = $this->offerModel->findPublicByProductId($productId);

        $related = $this->productModel->findRelated((int) $product['category_id'], $productId, 4);

        $inWishlist = false;
        if (!empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
            $wishlistRole = '';
            if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
                $wishlistRole = (string) $_SESSION['role'];
            }
            if ($wishlistRole === 'visitor') {
                $inWishlist = $this->wishlistModel->exists((int) $_SESSION['user_id'], $productId);
            }
        }

        $productName = '';
        if (isset($product['name'])) {
            $productName = (string) $product['name'];
        }

$pageTitle = '';
if (isset($seo['seo_title']) && $seo['seo_title'] !== '') {
    $pageTitle = (string) $seo['seo_title'];
} elseif ($productName !== '') {
    $pageTitle = $productName . ' - Price Comparison | GudangPC';
}

$metaDescription = '';
if (isset($product['short_description']) && $product['short_description'] !== '') {
    $metaDescription = (string) $product['short_description'];
}
if ($metaDescription === '') {
    $metaDescription = Seo::plainText('Compare prices for ' . $productName . '.', 155);
}
if (isset($seo['seo_description']) && $seo['seo_description'] !== '') {
    $metaDescription = (string) $seo['seo_description'];
}

        $ogImage = '';
        $productImage = '';
        if (isset($product['image'])) {
            $productImage = (string) $product['image'];
        }
        if ($productImage !== '') {
            $ogImage = Seo::absoluteUrl($productImage);
        }

        $canonicalCategorySlug = '';
        if (isset($full['category_slug'])) {
            $canonicalCategorySlug = (string) $full['category_slug'];
        }
        $canonicalProductSlug = '';
        if (isset($product['slug'])) {
            $canonicalProductSlug = (string) $product['slug'];
        }

        $canonicalUrl = Seo::absoluteUrl('/' . $canonicalCategorySlug . '/' . $canonicalProductSlug);
        if ($seo !== null) {
            if (isset($seo['canonical_url']) && $seo['canonical_url'] !== '') {
                if (strpos((string) $seo['canonical_url'], 'http') === 0) {
                    $canonicalUrl = (string) $seo['canonical_url'];
                }
            }
        }

        $basePath = '';
        if (isset($GLOBALS['base'])) {
            $basePath = (string) $GLOBALS['base'];
        }

        $categoryNameValue = '';
        if (isset($full['category_name'])) {
            $categoryNameValue = (string) $full['category_name'];
        }

        $breadcrumbs = [
            ['label' => 'Home', 'url' => $basePath . '/'],
            ['label' => $categoryNameValue, 'url' => $basePath . '/' . $canonicalCategorySlug],
            ['label' => $productName, 'url' => ''],
        ];

        $crumbs = [
            ['label' => 'Home', 'path' => '/'],
            ['label' => $categoryNameValue, 'path' => '/' . $canonicalCategorySlug],
            ['label' => $productName, 'path' => ''],
        ];

        $jsonLd = [];

        $productJsonLd = Seo::productJsonLd($product, $brandName, $offers, '/' . $canonicalCategorySlug . '/' . $canonicalProductSlug, $productImage);
        if ($productJsonLd !== '') {
            $jsonLd[] = $productJsonLd;
        }

        $breadcrumbJsonLd = Seo::breadcrumbJsonLd($crumbs);
        if ($breadcrumbJsonLd !== '') {
            $jsonLd[] = $breadcrumbJsonLd;
        }

        $this->view('public/products/show', [
            'pageTitle' => $pageTitle,
            'metaDescription' => $metaDescription,
            'product' => $product,
            'brandName' => $brandName,
            'offers' => $offers,
            'related' => $related,
            'inWishlist' => $inWishlist,
            'seo' => $seo,
            'canonicalUrl' => $canonicalUrl,
            'ogImage' => $ogImage,
            'ogType' => 'product',
            'breadcrumbs' => $breadcrumbs,
            'jsonLd' => $jsonLd,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log the click and redirect to the offer's affiliate URL.
     */
    public function go(string $offerId): void
    {
        $offerId = (int) $offerId;
        $offer = $this->offerModel->findActiveById($offerId);

        if ($offer === null) {
            $existingOffer = $this->offerModel->findById($offerId);

            if ($existingOffer) {
                $product = $this->productModel->findByIdWithRelations((int) $existingOffer['product_id']);

                if ($product !== null && $product['status'] === 'published') {
                    $_SESSION['error'] = 'That offer is no longer available.';
                    $categorySlug = '';
                    if (isset($product['category_slug'])) {
                        $categorySlug = (string) $product['category_slug'];
                    }
                    $productSlug = '';
                    if (isset($product['slug'])) {
                        $productSlug = (string) $product['slug'];
                    }
                    $this->redirect('/' . $categorySlug . '/' . $productSlug);
                    return;
                }
            }

            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $product = $this->productModel->findByIdWithRelations((int) $offer['product_id']);

        if ($product === null) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $productStatus = '';
        if (isset($product['status'])) {
            $productStatus = (string) $product['status'];
        }
        if ($productStatus !== 'published') {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $categoryStatus = '';
        if (isset($product['category_status'])) {
            $categoryStatus = (string) $product['category_status'];
        }
        if ($categoryStatus !== 'published') {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $affiliateUrl = '';
        if (isset($offer['affiliate_url'])) {
            $affiliateUrl = (string) $offer['affiliate_url'];
        }

        if (preg_match('~^https?://~i', $affiliateUrl) !== 1) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        $remoteAddress = '';
        if (isset($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'])) {
            $remoteAddress = (string) $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
        }
        $ipHash = hash('sha256', $remoteAddress . \App\Core\Dotenv::get('APP_SALT', 'change-me'));

        $userAgentRaw = '';
        if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'])) {
            $userAgentRaw = substr((string) $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'], 0, 255);
        }

        $userAgent = null;
        if ($userAgentRaw !== '') {
            $userAgent = $userAgentRaw;
        }

        $referer = null;
        if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'])) {
            $referer = substr((string) $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], 0, 255);
        }

        header('X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow');
        header('Cache-Control: no-store');

        if (!$this->isBot($userAgentRaw)) {
            $this->clickModel->logClick($offerId, $ipHash, $userAgent, $referer);
        }

        $this->redirect($affiliateUrl);
    }

    /**
     * Return true when the user agent looks like a crawler or a script.
     */
    private function isBot(string $userAgent): bool
    {
        if ($userAgent === '') {
            return true;
        }

        $needles = ['bot', 'crawl', 'spider', 'slurp', 'preview', 'facebookexternalhit', 'curl', 'wget', 'python-requests', 'headless'];
        $lowercase = strtolower($userAgent);

        foreach ($needles as $needle) {
            if (strpos($lowercase, $needle) !== false) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Render the 404 page.
     */
    private function showNotFound(): void
    {
        http_response_code(404);
        $this->view('errors/404', [
            'pageTitle' => '404 Not Found',
            'metaDescription' => 'The requested page could not be found.',
        ]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\Validator;
use App\Models\ProductModel;

/**
 * Serves the public product search page.
 */
class PublicSearchController extends Controller
{
    private ProductModel $productModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the product model.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Show the published products matching the submitted query.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $query = '';
        if (isset($_GET['q'])) {
            $query = Validator::sanitize($_GET['q'], 100);
        }

        $sort = 'newest';
        if (isset($_GET['sort'])) {
            $rawSort = (string) $_GET['sort'];
            if (Validator::inArray($rawSort, ['newest', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'])) {
                $sort = $rawSort;
            }
        }

        $page = 1;
        if (isset($_GET['page'])) {
            if (Validator::integer($_GET['page'], 1)) {
                $page = (int) $_GET['page'];
            }
        }

        $perPage = 20;
        $total = 0;
        $products = [];
        if ($query !== '') {
            $total = $this->productModel->countSearch($query);
        }

        $totalPages = (int) ceil($total / $perPage);
        if ($totalPages < 1) {
            $totalPages = 1;
        }
        if ($page > $totalPages && $page > 1) {
            $this->showNotFound();
            return;
        }

        if ($query !== '') {
            $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
            $products = $this->productModel->search($query, $perPage, $offset, $sort);
        }

        $pageTitle = 'Search';
        if ($query !== '') {
            $pageTitle = 'Search results for ' . $query;
        }

        $this->view('public/search/index', [
            'pageTitle' => $pageTitle,
            'metaDescription' => 'Search products',
            'query' => $query,
            'products' => $products,
            'page' => $page,
            'totalPages' => $totalPages,
            'sort' => $sort,
            'total' => $total,
            'pagePath' => '/search',
            'pageParams' => ['q' => $query, 'sort' => $sort],
            'robotsOverride' => 'noindex, follow',
            'canonicalUrl' => '',
        ]);
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/SitemapController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\Dotenv;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use App\Models\CategoryModel;
use App\Models\BrandModel;

/**
 * Outputs the XML sitemap for the public catalog.
 */
class SitemapController extends Controller
{
    private ProductModel $productModel;
    private CategoryModel $categoryModel;
    private BrandModel $brandModel;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and build the catalog models.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->productModel = new ProductModel($pdo);
        $this->categoryModel = new CategoryModel($pdo);
        $this->brandModel = new BrandModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Print the sitemap with every public catalog URL.
     */
    public function index(): void
    {
        $base = Dotenv::get('APP_URL', '');
        $base = rtrim((string) $base, '/');

        if ($base === '') {
            http_response_code(500);
            header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8');
            echo 'APP_URL is not set';
            return;
        }

        $urls = [];
        $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/', 'lastmod' => ''];
        $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/categories', 'lastmod' => ''];
        $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/brands', 'lastmod' => ''];

        foreach ($this->categoryModel->findAllPublished() as $category) {
            $slug = '';
            if (isset($category['slug'])) {
                $slug = (string) $category['slug'];
            }
            $lastmod = '';
            if (isset($category['updated_at']) && $category['updated_at'] !== null) {
                $lastmod = str_replace(' ', 'T', (string) $category['updated_at']);
            }
            $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/' . $slug, 'lastmod' => $lastmod];
        }

        foreach ($this->brandModel->findAllPublished() as $brand) {
            $slug = '';
            if (isset($brand['slug'])) {
                $slug = (string) $brand['slug'];
            }
            $lastmod = '';
            if (isset($brand['updated_at']) && $brand['updated_at'] !== null) {
                $lastmod = str_replace(' ', 'T', (string) $brand['updated_at']);
            }
            $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/brand/' . $slug, 'lastmod' => $lastmod];
        }

        foreach ($this->productModel->findAllPublishedWithActiveOffers() as $product) {
            $categorySlug = '';
            if (isset($product['category_slug'])) {
                $categorySlug = (string) $product['category_slug'];
            }
            $productSlug = '';
            if (isset($product['slug'])) {
                $productSlug = (string) $product['slug'];
            }
            $lastmod = '';
            if (isset($product['updated_at']) && $product['updated_at'] !== null) {
                $lastmod = str_replace(' ', 'T', (string) $product['updated_at']);
            }
            $urls[] = ['loc' => $base . '/' . $categorySlug . '/' . $productSlug, 'lastmod' => $lastmod];
        }

        header('Content-Type: application/xml; charset=UTF-8');

        echo '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
        echo '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">' . "\n";

        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            echo '    <url>' . "\n";
            echo '        <loc>' . htmlspecialchars($url['loc'], ENT_QUOTES | ENT_XML1, 'UTF-8') . '</loc>' . "\n";
            if ($url['lastmod'] !== '') {
                echo '        <lastmod>' . htmlspecialchars($url['lastmod'], ENT_QUOTES | ENT_XML1, 'UTF-8') . '</lastmod>' . "\n";
            }
            echo '    </url>' . "\n";
        }

        echo '</urlset>';
    }
}
```

### app/Controllers/SocialAuthController.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Models\MemberModel;
use Exception;

class SocialAuthController extends Controller
{
    private MemberModel $memberModel;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->memberModel = new MemberModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Build an absolute redirect URI from the configured APP_URL.
     */
    private function redirectUri(string $path): string
    {
        $base = rtrim((string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('APP_URL', ''), '/');
        return $base . $path;
    }

    /**
     * Validate the OAuth state parameter and clear it from the session.
     */
    private function verifyOAuthState(): bool
    {
        $providedState = '';
        if (isset($_GET['state'])) {
            $providedState = (string) $_GET['state'];
        }
        $sessionState = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['oauth_state'])) {
            $sessionState = (string) $_SESSION['oauth_state'];
        }

        unset($_SESSION['oauth_state']);

        if ($sessionState === '' || $providedState === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals($sessionState, $providedState);
    }

    /**
     * Perform an HTTP request and return the decoded JSON response as an array.
     */
    private function httpRequest(string $url, array $postFields, array $headers): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 10);

        if (!empty($postFields)) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, http_build_query($postFields));
        }

        if (!empty($headers)) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        }

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if (!is_string($response)) {
            return [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode($response, true);
        if (is_array($decoded)) {
            return $decoded;
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * Complete social login by linking, creating, or signing in the member.
     */
    private function finishSocialLogin(string $provider, string $providerId, string $email): void
    {
        $member = null;
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT user_id FROM user_social_accounts WHERE provider = ? AND provider_id = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$provider, $providerId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($row && isset($row['user_id'])) {
            $member = $this->memberModel->findById((int) $row['user_id']);
        }

        if (!$member) {
            $member = $this->memberModel->findByEmail($email);
            if ($member) {
                try {
                    $this->memberModel->linkSocialAccount((int) $member['id'], $provider, $providerId);
                } catch (Exception $e) {
                    $_SESSION['error'] = 'Could not link this account.';
                    $this->redirect('/login');
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                try {
                    $memberId = $this->memberModel->register($email, bin2hex(random_bytes(16)), '');
                    $this->memberModel->linkSocialAccount($memberId, $provider, $providerId);
                } catch (Exception $e) {
                    $_SESSION['error'] = 'Could not link this account.';
                    $this->redirect('/login');
                    return;
                }
                $_SESSION['success'] = 'Account created. An administrator must activate it before you can sign in.';
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }
        }

        $status = '';
        if (isset($member['status'])) {
            $status = (string) $member['status'];
        }

        if ($status === 'banned') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Your account has been banned.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        if ($status === 'pending') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Your account is waiting for activation by an administrator.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $_SESSION['user_id'] = $member['id'];
        $_SESSION['role'] = 'visitor';
        $_SESSION['email'] = $email;
        $_SESSION['username'] = $member['email'];
        $memberAvatar = null;
        if (isset($member['avatar'])) {
            $memberAvatar = $member['avatar'];
        }
        $_SESSION['avatar'] = $memberAvatar;
        $_SESSION['phone'] = '';

        session_regenerate_id(true);
        CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();

        $_SESSION['success'] = 'Logged in.';
        $this->redirect('/member');
    }

    /**
     * Build the absolute Google redirect URI, or an empty string when APP_URL is missing.
     */
    private function googleRedirectUri(): string
    {
        $appUrl = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('APP_URL', '');
        if ($appUrl === '') {
            return '';
        }
        return $appUrl . '/auth/google/callback';
    }

    /**
     * Fetch the Google user profile for the given access token.
     */
    private function fetchGoogleUserInfo(string $accessToken): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init();
        if ($ch === false) {
            return [];
        }

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, 'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo');
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, 5);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 10);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $accessToken,
        ]);

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $curlError = curl_errno($ch);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($curlError !== 0 || !is_string($response)) {
            return [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode($response, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return [];
        }

        $providerId = '';
        if (isset($decoded['id'])) {
            $providerId = (string) $decoded['id'];
        }
        if ($providerId === '') {
            return [];
        }

        return $decoded;
    }

    /**
     * Complete Google login by linking, activating, creating, or signing in the member.
     */
    private function finishGoogleLogin(string $providerId, string $email): void
    {
        try {
            $member = null;
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT user_id FROM user_social_accounts WHERE provider = ? AND provider_id = ?');
            $stmt->execute(['google', $providerId]);
            $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            $needsLink = false;
            if ($row && isset($row['user_id'])) {
                $member = $this->memberModel->findById((int) $row['user_id']);
            }

            if (!$member) {
                $member = $this->memberModel->findByEmail($email);
                if ($member) {
                    $needsLink = true;
                } else {
                    $newMemberId = $this->memberModel->registerFromSocial($email);
                    $this->memberModel->linkSocialAccount($newMemberId, 'google', $providerId);
                    $member = $this->memberModel->findById($newMemberId);
                }
            }

            if (!$member) {
                $_SESSION['error'] = 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.';
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }

            $status = '';
            if (isset($member['status'])) {
                $status = (string) $member['status'];
            }

            if ($status === 'banned') {
                $_SESSION['error'] = 'Your account has been banned.';
                $this->redirect('/login');
                return;
            }

            if ($status === 'pending') {
                $this->memberModel->activateUser((int) $member['id']);
                $this->memberModel->updatePassword((int) $member['id'], bin2hex(random_bytes(16)));
            }

            if ($needsLink) {
                $this->memberModel->linkSocialAccount((int) $member['id'], 'google', $providerId);
            }

            $_SESSION['user_id'] = $member['id'];
            $_SESSION['role'] = 'visitor';
            $_SESSION['email'] = $email;
            $_SESSION['username'] = $member['email'];
            $memberAvatar = null;
            if (isset($member['avatar'])) {
                $memberAvatar = $member['avatar'];
            }
            $_SESSION['avatar'] = $memberAvatar;
            $_SESSION['phone'] = '';

            session_regenerate_id(true);
            CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();

            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Logged in.';
            $this->redirect('/member');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Redirect the user to Google's OAuth consent screen.
     */
    public function redirectToGoogle(): void
    {
        $redirectUri = $this->googleRedirectUri();
        if ($redirectUri === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Social login is not configured.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $clientId = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID', '');
        if ($clientId === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Social login is not configured.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $state = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $_SESSION['oauth_state'] = $state;

        $params = [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri,
            'response_type' => 'code',
            'scope' => 'openid email profile',
            'state' => $state,
        ];

        $url = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?' . http_build_query($params);
        $this->redirect($url);
    }

    /**
     * Handle the OAuth callback from Google.
     */
    public function handleGoogleCallback(): void
    {
        $providedState = '';
        if (isset($_GET['state'])) {
            $providedState = (string) $_GET['state'];
        }
        $sessionState = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['oauth_state'])) {
            $sessionState = (string) $_SESSION['oauth_state'];
        }
        unset($_SESSION['oauth_state']);

        $stateMatches = false;
        if ($sessionState !== '' && $providedState !== '') {
            $stateMatches = hash_equals($sessionState, $providedState);
        }
        if (!$stateMatches) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid OAuth state parameter.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        if (isset($_GET['error'])) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Login was cancelled.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $code = '';
        if (isset($_GET['code'])) {
            $code = (string) $_GET['code'];
        }
        if ($code === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Login was cancelled.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $redirectUri = $this->googleRedirectUri();
        if ($redirectUri === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Social login is not configured.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $clientId = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID', '');
        $clientSecret = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET', '');

        $tokenData = $this->httpRequest('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'client_secret' => $clientSecret,
            'code' => $code,
            'redirect_uri' => $redirectUri,
            'grant_type' => 'authorization_code',
        ], []);

        $accessToken = '';
        if (isset($tokenData['access_token'])) {
            $accessToken = (string) $tokenData['access_token'];
        }
        if ($accessToken === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $userInfo = $this->fetchGoogleUserInfo($accessToken);

        $providerId = '';
        if (isset($userInfo['id'])) {
            $providerId = (string) $userInfo['id'];
        }
        $email = '';
        if (isset($userInfo['email'])) {
            $email = (string) $userInfo['email'];
        }
        $verifiedEmail = false;
        if (isset($userInfo['verified_email']) && $userInfo['verified_email'] === true) {
            $verifiedEmail = true;
        }

        if ($providerId === '' || $email === '' || $verifiedEmail !== true) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $this->finishGoogleLogin($providerId, $email);
    }

    /**
     * Redirect the user to Facebook's OAuth consent screen.
     */
    public function redirectToFacebook(): void
    {
        $clientId = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID', '');
        if ($clientId === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Social login is not configured.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $state = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $_SESSION['oauth_state'] = $state;

        $params = [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'redirect_uri' => $this->redirectUri('/auth/facebook/callback'),
            'response_type' => 'code',
            'scope' => 'email',
            'state' => $state,
        ];

        $url = 'https://www.facebook.com/v19.0/dialog/oauth?' . http_build_query($params);
        $this->redirect($url);
    }

    /**
     * Handle the OAuth callback from Facebook.
     */
    public function handleFacebookCallback(): void
    {
        if (!$this->verifyOAuthState()) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Invalid OAuth state parameter.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        if (isset($_GET['error'])) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Login was cancelled.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $code = '';
        if (isset($_GET['code'])) {
            $code = (string) $_GET['code'];
        }
        if ($code === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Login was cancelled.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $clientId = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID', '');
        $clientSecret = (string) \App\Core\Dotenv::get('FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET', '');

        $tokenParams = [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'client_secret' => $clientSecret,
            'redirect_uri' => $this->redirectUri('/auth/facebook/callback'),
            'code' => $code,
        ];
        $tokenUrl = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/oauth/access_token?' . http_build_query($tokenParams);
        $tokenData = $this->httpRequest($tokenUrl, [], []);

        $accessToken = '';
        if (isset($tokenData['access_token'])) {
            $accessToken = (string) $tokenData['access_token'];
        }
        if ($accessToken === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Failed to obtain Facebook access token.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $userInfo = $this->httpRequest('https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/me?fields=id,email,name', [], [
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $accessToken,
        ]);

        $providerId = '';
        if (isset($userInfo['id'])) {
            $providerId = (string) $userInfo['id'];
        }
        $email = '';
        if (isset($userInfo['email'])) {
            $email = (string) $userInfo['email'];
        }

        if ($providerId === '' || $email === '') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Facebook did not provide an email address.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $this->finishSocialLogin('facebook', $providerId, $email);
    }
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Controllers;

use PDO;
use App\Core\Controller;
use App\Core\CsrfProtection;
use App\Models\WishlistModel;
use App\Models\ProductModel;
use Exception;

/**
 * Wishlist handling for logged-in members.
 */
class WishlistController extends Controller
{
    private WishlistModel $wishlistModel;
    private ProductModel $productModel;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        parent::__construct($pdo);
        $this->wishlistModel = new WishlistModel($pdo);
        $this->productModel  = new ProductModel($pdo);
    }

    /**
     * Add a published product to the member's wishlist.
     */
    public function add(string $productId): void
    {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/');
            return;
        }

        if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || $_SESSION['user_id'] == 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Please log in to save to your wishlist.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $role = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
            $role = $_SESSION['role'];
        }
        if ($role !== 'visitor') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Only members can use the wishlist.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $productIdInt = (int) $productId;
        $product = $this->productModel->findByIdWithRelations($productIdInt);
        if (!$product || $product['status'] !== 'published') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Product not found.';
            $this->redirect('/');
            return;
        }

        $userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
        if ($this->wishlistModel->exists($userId, $productIdInt)) {
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product is already in your wishlist.';
        } else {
            try {
                if ($this->wishlistModel->add($userId, $productIdInt)) {
                    $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product saved to your wishlist.';
                } else {
                    $_SESSION['error'] = 'Failed to save product.';
                }
            } catch (Exception $e) {
                $_SESSION['error'] = 'Failed to save product.';
            }
        }

        $this->redirect('/' . $product['category_slug'] . '/' . $product['slug']);
    }

    /**
     * Remove a product from the member's wishlist.
     */
    public function remove(string $productId): void
    {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->redirect('/');
            return;
        }

        if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id']) || $_SESSION['user_id'] == 0) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Please log in to remove from your wishlist.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
            return;
        }

        $role = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
            $role = $_SESSION['role'];
        }
        if ($role !== 'visitor') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Only members can use the wishlist.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard');
            return;
        }

        CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();

        $userId = (int) $_SESSION['user_id'];
        if ($this->wishlistModel->remove($userId, (int) $productId)) {
            $_SESSION['success'] = 'Product removed from your wishlist.';
        } else {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Failed to remove product.';
        }

        $this->redirect('/member');
    }
}
```

### app/Core/Autoloader.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * PSR-4 Compliant Autoloader
 * No Composer required - pure PHP implementation
 */
namespace App\Core;

class Autoloader
{
    private static array $prefixes = [];

    public static function register(): void
    {
        spl_autoload_register([self::class, 'loadClass']);
    }

    public static function addNamespace(string $prefix, string $baseDir): void
    {
        $prefix = trim($prefix, '\\') . '\\';
        $baseDir = rtrim($baseDir, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        self::$prefixes[$prefix][] = $baseDir;
    }

    public static function loadClass(string $class): void
    {
        foreach (self::$prefixes as $prefix => $dirs) {
            if (str_starts_with($class, $prefix)) {
                $relativeClass = substr($class, strlen($prefix));
                $file = str_replace('\\', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $relativeClass) . '.php';

                foreach ($dirs as $dir) {
                    $fullPath = $dir . $file;
                    if (file_exists($fullPath)) {
                        require_once $fullPath;
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### app/Core/Controller.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Base Controller Class
 * Provides common functionality for all controllers
 */
namespace App\Core;

use PDO;
use Exception;

/**
 * Abstract base controller providing view rendering, redirection, and auth helpers
 */
abstract class Controller
{
    /** @var PDO Database connection */
    protected PDO $pdo;

    /**
     * Constructor - injects database connection
     * 
     * @param PDO $pdo Database connection instance
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
    }

    /**
     * Render a view file with optional data
     * 
     * @param string $path View path relative to views/ directory
     * @param array $data Data to extract into view scope
     * @throws Exception If view file not found
     */
    protected function view(string $path, array $data = []): void
    {
        $file = __DIR__ . "/../../views/{$path}.php";

        if (!file_exists($file)) {
            throw new Exception("View not found: {$path}");
        }

        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        require $file;
    }

    /**
     * Redirect to a URL
     * Prepends base URL if not an absolute URL
     * 
     * @param string $url Target URL (relative or absolute)
     * @return never
     */
    protected function redirect(string $url): void
    {
        // Prepend base URL if not absolute
        if (!preg_match('~^https?://~', $url)) {
            $base = '';
            if (isset($GLOBALS['base'])) {
                $base = $GLOBALS['base'];
            }
            $url = $base . '/' . ltrim($url, '/');
        }
        header("Location: {$url}");
        exit();
    }

    /**
     * Return JSON response with status code
     * 
     * @param array $data Response data
     * @param int $statusCode HTTP status code
     * @return never
     */
    protected function json(array $data, int $statusCode = 200): void
    {
        http_response_code($statusCode);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode($data);
        exit();
    }

    /**
     * Require user to be logged in
     * Redirects to login if not authenticated
     * 
     * @return never if not logged in
     */
    protected function requireLogin(): void
    {
        if (empty($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Please login first.';
            $this->redirect('/login');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Require admin/root role
     * Redirects to home if not authorized
     * 
     * @return never if not admin
     */
    protected function requireAdmin(): void
    {
        $this->requireLogin();

        $role = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
            $role = $_SESSION['role'];
        }
        if (!in_array($role, ['admin', 'root'], true)) {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Access denied. Admin privileges required.';
            $this->redirect('/');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Require root role
     * Redirects to the dashboard if not root
     *
     * @return never if not root
     */
    protected function requireRoot(): void
    {
        $this->requireLogin();

        $role = '';
        if (isset($_SESSION['role'])) {
            $role = $_SESSION['role'];
        }
        if ($role !== 'root') {
            $_SESSION['error'] = 'Access denied. Root privileges required.';
            $this->redirect('/dashboard');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate an uploaded image, convert it to WebP, and store it under public/.
     */
    protected function processAndSaveImage(array $file, string $uploadDir, string $prefix): string
    {
        $allowedMimes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'];
        $maxSize = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

        if ($file['size'] > $maxSize) {
            throw new Exception('File size must be less than 2MB');
        }

        $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $file['tmp_name']);
        finfo_close($finfo);

        if (!in_array($mime, $allowedMimes, true)) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid file type. Allowed: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP');
        }

        $source = null;
        if ($mime === 'image/jpeg') {
            $source = imagecreatefromjpeg($file['tmp_name']);
        } elseif ($mime === 'image/png') {
            $source = imagecreatefrompng($file['tmp_name']);
        } elseif ($mime === 'image/gif') {
            $source = imagecreatefromgif($file['tmp_name']);
        } elseif ($mime === 'image/webp') {
            $source = imagecreatefromwebp($file['tmp_name']);
        }

        if (!$source) {
            throw new Exception('Failed to read image');
        }

        if (!imagepalettetotruecolor($source)) {
            imagedestroy($source);
            throw new Exception('Failed to process image');
        }

        imagealphablending($source, true);
        imagesavealpha($source, true);

        $filename = $prefix . '_' . time() . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.webp';

        $relativeDir = trim($uploadDir, '/\\');
        $absoluteDir = __DIR__ . '/../../public/' . $relativeDir . '/';
        if (!is_dir($absoluteDir)) {
            mkdir($absoluteDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $destination = $absoluteDir . $filename;
        $saved = imagewebp($source, $destination, 85);
        imagedestroy($source);

        if (!$saved) {
            throw new Exception('Failed to save image');
        }

        return '/' . $relativeDir . '/' . $filename;
    }
}
```

### app/Core/CsrfProtection.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Enhanced CSRF Protection
 * Provides secure token generation, validation, and management
 */
namespace App\Core;

class CsrfProtection {
    private static $tokenName = 'csrf_token';
    private static $tokenLifetime = 3600; // 1 hour
    
    /**
     * Generate CSRF token with expiration
     */
    public static function generateToken(): string {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }

        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $expiry = time() + self::$tokenLifetime;
        
        $_SESSION[self::$tokenName] = [
            'token' => $token,
            'expiry' => $expiry,
            'created' => time()
        ];

        return $token;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate CSRF token
     */
    public static function validateToken(string $token): bool {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }

        if (!isset($_SESSION[self::$tokenName])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $storedData = $_SESSION[self::$tokenName];
        
        // Check if token has expired
        if (time() > $storedData['expiry']) {
            unset($_SESSION[self::$tokenName]);
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate token using timing-safe comparison
        return hash_equals($storedData['token'], $token);
    }
    
    /**
     * Get current token or generate new one
     */
    public static function getToken(): string {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }
        
        // Check if current token is valid and not expired
        if (isset($_SESSION[self::$tokenName])) {
            $storedData = $_SESSION[self::$tokenName];
            if (time() <= $storedData['expiry']) {
                return $storedData['token'];
            }
        }
        
        // Generate new token if none exists or expired
        return self::generateToken();
    }
    
    /**
     * Invalidate current token
     */
    public static function invalidateToken(): void {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }
        
        unset($_SESSION[self::$tokenName]);
    }
    
    /**
     * Check and validate CSRF token from the request.
     * Only accepts the token from the POST body or the X-CSRF-Token header.
     * GET-based tokens are rejected because they leak via Referer, history,
     * bookmarks, and access logs.
     */
    public static function checkRequest(): bool {
        $token = '';

        // 1. Prefer the token submitted in a form body.
        if (isset($_POST['csrf_token'])) {
            $token = $_POST['csrf_token'];
        } elseif (isset($_POST['csrf'])) {
            $token = $_POST['csrf'];
        }

        // 2. Fall back to the header used by AJAX/fetch calls.
        elseif (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
            $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'];
        }

        // No token supplied through an allowed channel.
        if (empty($token)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate against the stored session token.
        return self::validateToken($token);
    }
    
    /**
     * Require valid CSRF token or die
     */
    public static function requireValidToken(): void {
        if (!self::checkRequest()) {
            // Re-read the submitted token for logging — POST body or header only.
            $token = '';
            if (isset($_POST['csrf_token'])) {
                $token = $_POST['csrf_token'];
            } elseif (isset($_POST['csrf'])) {
                $token = $_POST['csrf'];
            } elseif (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
                $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'];
            }
            $sessionToken = null;
            if (isset($_SESSION[self::$tokenName])) {
                $sessionToken = $_SESSION[self::$tokenName];
            }
            
            $submittedStatus = 'missing';
            if ($token) {
                $submittedStatus = 'present';
            }
            $sessionStatus = 'missing';
            if ($sessionToken) {
                $sessionStatus = 'present';
            }
            $errorDetails = [
                'submitted_token' => $submittedStatus,
                'session_token' => $sessionStatus,
                'token_expired' => false,
                'referer' => 'none',
                'user_agent' => 'none'
            ];
            
            if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'])) {
                $errorDetails['referer'] = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
            }
            if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'])) {
                $errorDetails['user_agent'] = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'];
            }
            
            if ($sessionToken && isset($sessionToken['expiry'])) {
                $errorDetails['token_expired'] = time() > $sessionToken['expiry'];
                $created = 0;
                if (isset($sessionToken['created'])) {
                    $created = $sessionToken['created'];
                }
                $errorDetails['token_age'] = time() - $created;
            }
            
            // Log CSRF failure with details
            if (class_exists(\App\Core\SecurityLogger::class)) {
                $logger = new \App\Core\SecurityLogger();
                $logger->logSuspicious('csrf_token_invalid', 'Invalid or missing CSRF token', $errorDetails);
            }
            
            //http_response_code(419);
            //die('CSRF token validation failed');

            http_response_code(419);
            // Instead of die(), render your 404/500 view or a specific 419 view
            $file = __DIR__ . '/../../views/errors/419.php'; 
            if (file_exists($file)) {
                $pageTitle = '419 - Page Expired';
                require $file;
            } else {
                echo '<h1>419 - Page Expired</h1><p>Your session expired. Please go back and try again.</p>';
            }
            exit;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate HTML input field for CSRF token
     */
    public static function getHiddenInput(): string {
        $token = self::getToken();
        return '<input type="hidden" name="csrf" value="' . htmlspecialchars($token) . '">';
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate meta tag for CSRF token (for AJAX)
     */
    public static function getMetaTag(): string {
        $token = self::getToken();
        return '<meta name="csrf-token" content="' . htmlspecialchars($token) . '">';
    }
}

// Legacy functions for backward compatibility
function generateCsrfToken(): string {
    return CsrfProtection::getToken();
}

function validateCsrfToken(string $token): bool {
    return CsrfProtection::validateToken($token);
}

function checkCsrf(): void {
    CsrfProtection::requireValidToken();
}

function unsetCsrfToken(): void {
    CsrfProtection::invalidateToken();
}
?>
```

### app/Core/Dotenv.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Simple Dotenv Loader
 * Lightweight .env file parser - no dependencies required
 */
namespace App\Core;
use RuntimeException;

class Dotenv
{
    /**
     * Load environment variables from .env file
     */
    public static function load($path = null) {
        // 1. If no path is provided, calculate it relative to THIS file (Dotenv.php)
        // __DIR__ is 'domain_folder/app/core'
        // dirname(__DIR__, 1) goes up to 'domain_folder'
        if ($path === null) {
            $path = dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/.env';
        }

        // 2. If the file doesn't exist, check a fallback (just in case)
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            $docRoot = '';
            if (isset($_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'])) {
                $docRoot = $_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'];
            }
            $path = $docRoot . '/../.env';
        }

        // 3. If it still doesn't exist, exit early
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return;
        }
        
        $lines = file($path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);
        
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $line = trim($line);
            
            // Skip comments and empty lines
            if (empty($line) || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Parse key=value
            if (strpos($line, '=') !== false) {
                [$key, $value] = explode('=', $line, 2);
                $key = trim($key);
                $value = trim($value);
                
                // Remove surrounding quotes if present
                if (preg_match('/^["\'](.*)["\']$/', $value, $matches)) {
                    $value = $matches[1];
                }
                
                // Only set if not already set in environment
                if (!array_key_exists($key, $_SERVER) && !array_key_exists($key, $_ENV)) {
                    $_ENV[$key] = $value;
                    $_SERVER[$key] = $value;
                    putenv("$key=$value");
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Get environment variable with fallback
     */
    public static function get(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        $value = null;
        if (isset($_ENV[$key])) {
            $value = $_ENV[$key];
        } elseif (isset($_SERVER[$key])) {
            $value = $_SERVER[$key];
        } elseif (getenv($key) !== false) {
            $value = getenv($key);
        } else {
            $value = $default;
        }
        return $value;
    }
    
    /**
     * Get required environment variable (throws if not set)
     */
    public static function required(string $key)
    {
        $value = self::get($key);
        if ($value === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Required environment variable '$key' is not set");
        }
        return $value;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * One Build - Security Headers & Configuration
 * Version: 1.0
 * Author: Awan
 *
 * This file sends all important HTTP headers for security & caching,
 * replacing .htaccess rules when using Nginx shared hosting.
 */

// Determine environment early
$appEnv = 'production';
if (isset($_ENV['APP_ENV'])) {
    $appEnv = $_ENV['APP_ENV'];
}
$isProduction = ($appEnv === 'production');

// Global error handler - prevent stack traces in production
if ($isProduction) {
    error_reporting(E_ALL & ~E_DEPRECATED & ~E_STRICT);
    ini_set('display_errors', '0');
    ini_set('log_errors', '1');
    ini_set('error_log', __DIR__ . '/../../storage/logs/php_errors.log');

    set_error_handler(function ($severity, $message, $file, $line) {
        if (!(error_reporting() & $severity)) {
            return false;
        }
        error_log("PHP Error [$severity]: $message in $file:$line");
        return true;
    });

    register_shutdown_function(function () {
        $error = error_get_last();
        if ($error && in_array($error['type'], [E_ERROR, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR, E_PARSE])) {
            error_log("Fatal Error: {$error['message']} in {$error['file']}:{$error['line']}");
        }
    });
} else {
    error_reporting(E_ALL);
    ini_set('display_errors', '1');
}

// Session cookie hardening (before session_start)
if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    $cookieParams = session_get_cookie_params();
    $secure = (isset($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off');
    
    $cookiePath = '/';
    if (isset($cookieParams['path'])) {
        $cookiePath = $cookieParams['path'];
    }
    $cookieDomain = '';
    if (isset($cookieParams['domain'])) {
        $cookieDomain = $cookieParams['domain'];
    }
    session_set_cookie_params([
        'lifetime' => 3600,
        'path' => $cookiePath,
        'domain' => $cookieDomain,
        'secure' => $secure,
        'httponly' => true,
        'samesite' => 'Lax',
    ]);
    
    ini_set('session.use_strict_mode', '1');
    ini_set('session.use_only_cookies', '1');
    ini_set('session.cookie_httponly', '1');
    $secureFlag = '0';
    if ($secure) {
        $secureFlag = '1';
    }
    ini_set('session.cookie_secure', $secureFlag);
    ini_set('session.cookie_samesite', 'Lax');
    ini_set('session.gc_maxlifetime', '3600');
    ini_set('session.sid_length', '32');
    ini_set('session.sid_bits_per_character', '6');
}

// Generate CSP nonce
if (!isset($GLOBALS['csp_nonce'])) {
    $GLOBALS['csp_nonce'] = base64_encode(random_bytes(16));
}

// Load security configuration early so $isLocalhost is available below
$securityConfig = require __DIR__ . '/../../config/security.php';

// Utility: check if a header already exists (case-insensitive)
if (!function_exists('header_exists')) {
    function header_exists($name) {
        $name = trim($name);
        foreach (headers_list() as $header) {
            if (stripos($header, $name . ':') === 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

// Add header only if not already set
if (!function_exists('safe_header')) {
    function safe_header($string) {
        [$name] = explode(":", $string, 2);
        if (!header_exists(trim($name))) {
            header($string);
        }
    }
}

// Detect the raw HTTP host (used for base URL and HTTPS redirect)
$httpHost = '';
if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'])) {
    $httpHost = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'];
}
if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9.\-:\[\]]+$/', $httpHost)) {
    $httpHost = 'localhost';
}

// Localhost detection comes from config/security.php — single source of truth
$isLocalhost = $securityConfig['is_localhost'];

// Detect HTTPS (direct or via reverse proxy)
$isHttps = !empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off';
if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO']) && $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] === 'https') {
    $isHttps = true;
}
// ------------------------------------------------------------------

// Force HTTPS redirect (only in production, not localhost, not already HTTPS)
if ($isProduction && !$isLocalhost && !$isHttps) {
    if (!headers_sent()) {
        $redirectURL = 'https://' . $httpHost . $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'];
        header("Location: $redirectURL", true, 301);
        exit();
    }
}

// Security headers
safe_header("X-Powered-By: ");
safe_header("Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0");
safe_header("Pragma: no-cache");
safe_header("Expires: 0");
safe_header("X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff");
safe_header("X-Frame-Options: DENY");
safe_header("Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin");
safe_header("X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none");
safe_header("Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), payment=(), usb=()");

// COOP only on HTTPS
if ($isHttps) {
    safe_header("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin");
}

// HSTS only on HTTPS
if ($isHttps) {
    safe_header("Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload");
}

// Content Security Policy (CSP)
$nonce = $GLOBALS['csp_nonce'];
$csp = "default-src 'self'; "
     . "base-uri 'self'; "
     . "object-src 'none'; "
     . "frame-ancestors 'self'; "

// Script sources - Nonce-based only

$baseImg = $base . '/uploads/media/';
$baseImgThumb = $base . '/uploads/media/thumbs/thumb_';

// Set as globals

$GLOBALS['baseImg'] = $baseImg;
$GLOBALS['baseImgThumb'] = $baseImgThumb;
$GLOBALS['is_localhost'] = $isLocalhost;
$GLOBALS['is_https'] = $isHttps;
$GLOBALS['is_production'] = $isProduction;
$GLOBALS['app_env'] = $appEnv;

// Unified exception handler (loads views/errors/500.php cleanly)

        require $file;
    } else {

             . '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">'
             . '<style>body{font-family:sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:50px auto;padding:20px;text-align:center}'
```

### app/Core/Model.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Base Model Class
 * Provides common database operations for all models
 */
namespace App\Core;

use PDO;
use Exception;

class Model
{
    protected PDO $pdo;
    protected string $table = '';
    protected bool $timestamps = true;

// Whitelist of allowed table names for security
    // Empty array means allow any valid table name (alphanumeric + underscore)
    protected static array $allowedTables = [];

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        if (!$pdo) {
            throw new Exception('PDO connection is required.');
        }
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        
        // Validate table name on construction
        if ($this->table && !self::isValidTable($this->table)) {
            throw new Exception("Invalid table name: {$this->table}");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate table name against whitelist (if configured)
     */
    protected static function isValidTable(string $table): bool
    {
        // If whitelist is empty, allow any valid table name format
        if (empty(self::$allowedTables)) {
            return true;
        }
        return in_array($table, self::$allowedTables, true);
    }

    /**
     * Validate and sanitize table name for use in queries
     * Only allows alphanumeric and underscore
     */
    protected function validateTable(string $table): string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', $table)) {
            throw new Exception("Invalid table name format: $table");
        }
        if (!self::isValidTable($table)) {
            throw new Exception("Table not in allowed list: $table");
        }
        return $table;
    }

    /**
     * Find all records
     */
    public function findAll(string $orderBy = 'id ASC'): array
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (ASC|DESC)$/i', $orderBy)) {
            $orderBy = 'id ASC';
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$table} ORDER BY {$orderBy}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Find all published records
     */
    public function findAllPublished(string $orderBy = 'id ASC'): array
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (ASC|DESC)$/i', $orderBy)) {
            $orderBy = 'id ASC';
        }

        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY {$orderBy}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Find record by ID
     */
    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($result) {
            return $result;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Find record by slug
     */
    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE slug = :slug LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['slug' => $slug]);
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($result) {
            return $result;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Insert new record
     * Column names are validated before being interpolated into SQL,
     * so callers can safely build the data array dynamically.
     */
    public function insert(array $data): int
    {
        // GUARD CLAUSE: Prevent "INSERT INTO table () VALUES ()" syntax errors
        if (empty($data)) {
            throw new Exception("Cannot insert empty data array into {$this->table}.");
        }

        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);

        // Auto-fill created_at / updated_at when timestamps are enabled.
        if ($this->timestamps) {
            $createdAt = 'created_at';
            $updatedAt = 'updated_at';
            if (!isset($data[$createdAt])) {
                $data[$createdAt] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
            }
            if (!isset($data[$updatedAt])) {
                $data[$updatedAt] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
            }
        }

        // Reject any column name that is not a plain identifier.
        // This prevents SQL injection through attacker-controlled keys.
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', $key)) {
                throw new Exception("Invalid column name: $key");
            }
        }

        // Build the INSERT statement from the validated column names.
        $columns      = array_keys($data);
        $placeholders = array_map(fn($c) => ':' . $c, $columns);

        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} (" . implode(',', $columns) . ")
                VALUES (" . implode(',', $placeholders) . ")";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($data);

        return (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * Update record by ID
     */
    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        
        // Remove 'id' from data to prevent it from being updated or causing issues
        unset($data['id']);

        // GUARD CLAUSE: Prevent "UPDATE table SET WHERE id = :id" syntax errors
        if (empty($data)) {
            throw new Exception("Cannot update record. No valid columns provided.");
        }

        if ($this->timestamps) {
            $data['updated_at'] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        }

        $set = [];
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            // Validate column names
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', $key)) {
                throw new Exception("Invalid column name: $key");
            }
            $set[] = "{$key} = :{$key}";
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE {$table} SET " . implode(', ', $set) . " WHERE id = :id";
        $data['id'] = $id;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($data);
    }

    /**
     * Delete record by ID
     */
    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $table = $this->validateTable($this->table);
        $sql = "DELETE FROM {$table} WHERE id = :id";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute(['id' => $id]);
    }

    /**
     * Execute custom query (returns multiple rows)
     * Table names in custom queries must be validated by caller
     */
    public function query(string $sql, array $params = []): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Execute custom query (returns single row)
     * Table names in custom queries must be validated by caller
     */
    public function queryOne(string $sql, array $params = []): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($result) {
            return $result;
        }
        return null;
    }
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * CSV importer for products and offers.
 *
 * Shared by the command line script bin/import_products.php and by the
 * dashboard upload page. Categories, brands and stores are never created here;
 * sellers are created from vendor_name when vendor_slug is empty. A row that
 * cannot be validated is rejected and nothing is written for it.
 */
namespace App\Core;

use PDO;
use Exception;
use App\Models\PriceHistoryModel;

class ProductImporter
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $dryRun;

    /**
     * Inject the database connection and the dry run flag.
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo, bool $dryRun = false)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->dryRun = $dryRun;
    }

    /**
     * Import a CSV file and return the report of the run.
     */
    public function importFile(string $csvPath): array
    {
        if (!is_file($csvPath) || !is_readable($csvPath)) {
            throw new Exception('CSV file cannot be read: ' . $csvPath);
        }

        $handle = fopen($csvPath, 'r');
        if ($handle === false) {
            throw new Exception('CSV file cannot be read: ' . $csvPath);
        }

        // Skip the byte order mark of a file that was saved by Excel.
        $bom = fread($handle, 3);
        if ($bom !== "\xEF\xBB\xBF") {
            rewind($handle);
        }

        try {
            $columns = $this->readHeader($handle, $csvPath);
            $report = $this->importRows($handle, $columns);
        } finally {
            fclose($handle);
        }

        return $report;
    }

    /**
     * Read the header row and return the map of column names to column indexes.
     */
    public function readHeader($handle, string $csvPath = ''): array
    {
        $header = fgetcsv($handle);
        if ($header === false) {
            throw new Exception('CSV file has no header row' . $this->pathSuffix($csvPath));
        }

        $columns = [];
        foreach ($header as $columnIndex => $columnName) {
            $columnName = trim((string) $columnName);
            if ($columnIndex === 0) {
                $columnName = preg_replace('/^\xEF\xBB\xBF/', '', $columnName);
            }
            if ($columnName === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!isset($columns[$columnName])) {
                $columns[$columnName] = $columnIndex;
            }
        }

        if (!isset($columns['product_slug'])) {
            throw new Exception('CSV header must contain a product_slug column' . $this->pathSuffix($csvPath));
        }

        return $columns;
    }

    /**
     * Return the file path suffix used in the error messages.
     */
    private function pathSuffix(string $csvPath): string
    {
        if ($csvPath === '') {
            return '';
        }

        return ': ' . $csvPath;
    }

    /**
     * Import every data row of an open CSV file and return the report of the run.
     */
    public function importRows($handle, array $columns): array
    {
        $transactionStarted = false;
        if (!$this->dryRun) {
            $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            $transactionStarted = true;
        }

        try {
            $report = $this->importRowsInTransaction($handle, $columns);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($transactionStarted) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }

        if ($transactionStarted) {
            $this->pdo->commit();
        }

        return $report;
    }

    /**
     * Run the row loop. Called inside a transaction for a real import.
     */
    private function importRowsInTransaction($handle, array $columns): array
    {
        $totalRows = 0;
        $createdProducts = 0;
        $createdOffers = 0;
        $updatedOffers = 0;
        $createdVendors = 0;
        $skippedIdenticalOffers = 0;
        $skippedExistingProducts = 0;
        $rejections = [];
        $warnings = [];
        $warnedMarketplaces = [];

        $knownProductIds = [];
        $knownOffers = [];
        $knownOffersByExternal = [];
        $knownVendors = [];
        $pseudoProductId = 0;
        $pseudoVendorId = 0;

        $priceHistory = null;
        if (!$this->dryRun) {
            $priceHistory = new PriceHistoryModel($this->pdo);

            $isEmptyRow = true;
            foreach ($row as $cell) {

                    $isEmptyRow = false;
                    break;

            }
            if ($isEmptyRow) {

            }

            $totalRows++;
            $rowNumber = $totalRows;

            $productSlug = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'product_slug');
            $name = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'name');
            $categorySlug = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'category_slug');
            $brandSlug = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'brand_slug');
            $marketplace = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'marketplace');
            $vendorSlug = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'vendor_slug');
            $priceRaw = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'price_idr');
            $affiliateUrl = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'affiliate_url');
            $sellerTitle = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'seller_title');
            $productRatingRaw = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'product_rating');
            $soldCountRaw = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'sold_count');
            $storeRatingRaw = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'store_rating');
            $shortDescription = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'short_description');
            $description = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'description');
            $sourceUrl = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'source_url');
            $vendorName = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'vendor_name');
            $externalIdRaw = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'external_id');
            $notes = $this->cellValue($row, $columns, 'notes');

            $externalId = '';
            if ($externalIdRaw !== '') {
                $externalId = $this->truncateText($externalIdRaw, 100);
            }

            if ($notes !== '' && strtolower($notes) !== 'ok') {
                $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'scraper note: ' . $notes, $productSlug);
                continue;
            }

            $vendorProvided = false;
            if ($vendorSlug !== '' || $vendorName !== '') {
                $vendorProvided = true;
            }
            $linkProvided = false;
            if ($affiliateUrl !== '' || $sourceUrl !== '') {
                $linkProvided = true;
            }

            $offerFieldsFilled = 0;

                $offerFieldsFilled++;

                $offerFieldsFilled++;
            }
            if ($priceRaw !== '') {
                $offerFieldsFilled++;

            if ($linkProvided) {

            if ($offerFieldsFilled === 0) {
                if ($productSlug === '') {

                if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9-]+$/', $productSlug)) {

                }

                $existingProductId = null;

                    if ($existingProductId !== null) {

                if ($existingProductId !== null) {

                if ($name === '') {

                if ($categorySlug === '') {

                if ($brandSlug === '') {
                    $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'missing brand_slug', $productSlug);
                    continue;
                }

                $categoryId = $this->findCategoryId($categorySlug);
                if ($categoryId === null) {
                    $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'unknown category: ' . $categorySlug, $productSlug);
                    continue;
                }
                $brandId = $this->findBrandId($brandSlug);
                if ($brandId === null) {
                    $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'unknown brand: ' . $brandSlug, $productSlug);
                    continue;
                }

                $productData = [
                    'name' => $this->truncateText($name, 200),
                    'slug' => $productSlug,
                    'category_id' => $categoryId,
                    'brand_id' => $brandId,
                    'status' => 'draft',
                ];
                if ($shortDescription !== '') {
                    $productData['short_description'] = $this->truncateText($shortDescription, 500);
                }
                if ($description !== '') {
                    $productData['description'] = RichText::clean($description);
                }

                $newProductId = 0;
                if ($this->dryRun) {
                    $pseudoProductId--;
                    $newProductId = $pseudoProductId;
                } else {
                    $newProductId = $this->insertProduct($productData);
                }

                $knownProductIds[$productSlug] = $newProductId;
                $createdProducts++;
                continue;
            }

            if ($offerFieldsFilled !== 4) {
                $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'incomplete offer data', $productSlug);
                continue;
            }
            if ($productSlug === '') {
                $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'missing product_slug', '');

            }
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9-]+$/', $productSlug)) {
                $this->addRejection($rejections, $rowNumber, 'invalid product_slug', $productSlug);
                continue;
            }

            $storeId = $this->findStoreId($marketplace);
            if ($storeId === null) {

            }

            if ($externalId !== '') {

                        continue;

                    $knownOffersByExternal[$storeId . ':' . $externalId] = $externalOffer;

                if ($template !== null && $template !== '') {

                $productData = [

            if ($existingOffer === null) {
```
