```php
                    'price_idr' => $priceIdr,
                    'affiliate_url' => $resolvedAffiliateUrl,

                if ($productRatingValue !== null) {

                }

                    'seller_title' => $sellerTitleValue,
                    'external_id' => $externalId,
                    'source_url' => $sourceUrl,
                ];
                if ($externalId !== '') {
                    $knownOffersByExternal[$storeId . ':' . $externalId] = $knownOffers[$offerKey];
                }
                $createdOffers++;
                continue;
            }

            $storedPriceIdr = (int) $existingOffer['price_idr'];
            $storedAffiliateUrl = (string) $existingOffer['affiliate_url'];
            $storedSellerTitle = null;
            if (isset($existingOffer['seller_title'])) {
                if ($existingOffer['seller_title'] !== null && $existingOffer['seller_title'] !== '') {
                    $storedSellerTitle = (string) $existingOffer['seller_title'];
                }
            }
            $storedProductRating = null;
            if (isset($existingOffer['product_rating']) && $existingOffer['product_rating'] !== null) {
                $storedProductRating = (float) $existingOffer['product_rating'];
            }
            $storedSoldCount = null;
            if (isset($existingOffer['sold_count']) && $existingOffer['sold_count'] !== null) {
                $storedSoldCount = (int) $existingOffer['sold_count'];
            }
            $storedExternalId = '';
            if (isset($existingOffer['external_id']) && $existingOffer['external_id'] !== null) {
                $storedExternalId = (string) $existingOffer['external_id'];
            }
            $storedSourceUrl = '';
            if (isset($existingOffer['source_url']) && $existingOffer['source_url'] !== null) {
                $storedSourceUrl = (string) $existingOffer['source_url'];
            }

            $newExternalId = $storedExternalId;
            if ($storedExternalId === '' && $externalId !== '') {
                $newExternalId = $externalId;
            }
            $newSourceUrl = $storedSourceUrl;
            if ($storedSourceUrl === '' && $sourceUrl !== '') {
                $newSourceUrl = $sourceUrl;
            }

            if ($storedPriceIdr !== $priceIdr) {
                $priceDifference = abs($priceIdr - $storedPriceIdr);
                if ($storedPriceIdr > 0 && ($priceDifference / $storedPriceIdr) > 0.5) {
                    $warnings[] = 'large price change: ' . $productSlug . ' ' . $storedPriceIdr . ' -> ' . $priceIdr;
                }
            }

            $offerChanged = false;
            if ($storedPriceIdr !== $priceIdr) {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($storedAffiliateUrl !== $resolvedAffiliateUrl) {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($storedSellerTitle !== $sellerTitleValue) {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($productRatingValue !== null && $storedProductRating !== $productRatingValue) {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($soldCountValue !== null && $storedSoldCount !== $soldCountValue) {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($storedExternalId === '' && $externalId !== '') {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }
            if ($storedSourceUrl === '' && $sourceUrl !== '') {
                $offerChanged = true;
            }

            if ($offerChanged) {
                if (!$this->dryRun) {
                    $externalToStore = null;
                    if ($newExternalId !== '') {
                        $externalToStore = $newExternalId;
                    }
                    $sourceToStore = null;
                    if ($newSourceUrl !== '') {
                        $sourceToStore = $newSourceUrl;
                    }
                    $this->updateOffer((int) $existingOffer['id'], $priceIdr, $resolvedAffiliateUrl, $sellerTitleValue, $productRatingValue, $soldCountValue, $externalToStore, $sourceToStore);
                    if ($storedPriceIdr !== $priceIdr) {
                        $priceHistory->record((int) $existingOffer['id'], $priceIdr);
                    }
                }

                $knownOffers[$offerKey] = [
                    'id' => $existingOffer['id'],
                    'product_id' => $productId,
                    'store_id' => $storeId,
                    'price_idr' => $priceIdr,
                    'affiliate_url' => $resolvedAffiliateUrl,
                    'seller_title' => $sellerTitleValue,
                    'external_id' => $newExternalId,
                    'source_url' => $newSourceUrl,
                ];
                if ($newExternalId !== '') {
                    $knownOffersByExternal[$storeId . ':' . $newExternalId] = $knownOffers[$offerKey];
                }
                $updatedOffers++;
                continue;
            }

            if (!$this->dryRun) {
                $this->touchOffer((int) $existingOffer['id']);
            }

            $skippedIdenticalOffers++;
        }

        return [
            'total_rows' => $totalRows,
            'created_products' => $createdProducts,
            'created_offers' => $createdOffers,
            'updated_offers' => $updatedOffers,
            'created_vendors' => $createdVendors,
            'warnings' => $warnings,
            'skipped_identical_offers' => $skippedIdenticalOffers,
            'skipped_existing_products' => $skippedExistingProducts,
            'rejections' => $rejections,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Read one cell of a CSV row using the header column map.
     */
    private function cellValue(array $row, array $columns, string $name): string
    {
        if (!isset($columns[$name])) {
            return '';
        }

        $index = $columns[$name];
        if (!isset($row[$index])) {
            return '';
        }

        return trim((string) $row[$index]);
    }

    /**
     * Truncate a text value to the given number of characters.
     */
    private function truncateText(string $value, int $limit): string
    {
        if (mb_strlen($value) > $limit) {
            return mb_substr($value, 0, $limit);
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Store a rejected row for the report of the run.
     */
    private function addRejection(array &$rejections, int $rowNumber, string $reason, string $slug): void
    {
        $rejections[] = [
            'row' => $rowNumber,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'slug' => $slug,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Look up a category id by slug.
     */
    private function findCategoryId(string $slug): ?int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM `categories` WHERE `slug` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $id = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        if ($id === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $id;
    }

    /**
     * Look up a brand id by slug.
     */
    private function findBrandId(string $slug): ?int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM `brands` WHERE `slug` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $id = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        if ($id === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $id;
    }

    /**
     * Look up a store id by slug.
     */
    private function findStoreId(string $slug): ?int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM `stores` WHERE `slug` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $id = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        if ($id === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $id;
    }

    /**
     * Look up a vendor by slug and return its id and its store id.
     */
    private function findVendor(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id, store_id FROM `vendors` WHERE `slug` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$row) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'id' => (int) $row['id'],
            'store_id' => (int) $row['store_id'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Look up a product id by slug.
     */
    private function findProductId(string $slug): ?int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM `products` WHERE `slug` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $id = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        if ($id === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $id;
    }

    /**
     * Look up the offer of a product for one vendor.
     */
    private function findOffer(int $productId, int $vendorId): ?array
    {
        if ($productId <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        $sql = 'SELECT id, product_id, store_id, price_idr, affiliate_url, seller_title, product_rating, sold_count, external_id, source_url
                FROM `offers`
                WHERE `product_id` = ? AND `vendor_id` = ?
                LIMIT 1';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$productId, $vendorId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$row) {
            return null;
        }

        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * Look up an offer by its marketplace listing identity.
     */
    private function findOfferByExternalId(int $storeId, string $externalId): ?array
    {
        $sql = 'SELECT id, product_id, store_id, price_idr, affiliate_url, seller_title, product_rating, sold_count, external_id, source_url
                FROM `offers`
                WHERE `store_id` = ? AND `external_id` = ?
                LIMIT 1';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$storeId, $externalId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$row) {
            return null;
        }

        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * Return the affiliate URL template of a store, when set.
     */
    private function findStoreAffiliateTemplate(int $storeId): ?string
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT `affiliate_url_template` FROM `stores` WHERE `id` = ? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$storeId]);
        $value = $stmt->fetchColumn();

        if ($value === false || $value === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return (string) $value;
    }

    /**
     * Insert a product row with prepared statements and return the new id.
     */
    private function insertProduct(array $data): int
    {
        $columns = [];
        foreach (array_keys($data) as $column) {
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', (string) $column)) {
                throw new Exception('Invalid column name: ' . $column);
            }
            $columns[] = $column;
        }

        $placeholders = array_fill(0, count($columns), '?');
        $sql = 'INSERT INTO `products` (`' . implode('`, `', $columns) . '`) VALUES (' . implode(', ', $placeholders) . ')';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(array_values($data));

        return (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * Insert an offer row with prepared statements and return the new id.
     */
    private function insertOffer(array $data): int
    {
        $columns = [];
        foreach (array_keys($data) as $column) {
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/', (string) $column)) {
                throw new Exception('Invalid column name: ' . $column);
            }
            $columns[] = $column;
        }

        $placeholders = array_fill(0, count($columns), '?');
        $sql = 'INSERT INTO `offers` (`' . implode('`, `', $columns) . '`) VALUES (' . implode(', ', $placeholders) . ')';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(array_values($data));

        return (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * Insert a vendor with prepared statements and return the new id.
     */
    private function insertVendor(int $storeId, string $name, string $slug, ?float $storeRating): int
    {
        if ($storeRating === null) {
            $sql = 'INSERT INTO `vendors` (`store_id`, `name`, `slug`, `status`) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)';
            $params = [$storeId, $name, $slug, 'active'];
        } else {
            $sql = 'INSERT INTO `vendors` (`store_id`, `name`, `slug`, `status`, `store_rating`) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)';
            $params = [$storeId, $name, $slug, 'active', $storeRating];
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    /**
     * Turn free text into a lowercase dash-separated slug.
     */
    private function generateSlug(string $value): string
    {
        $slug = strtolower($value);
        $slug = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', $slug);
        $slug = trim((string) $slug, '-');

        return $slug;
    }

    /**
     * Update the price, the affiliate url, the seller title and the check time of an offer.
     */
    private function updateOffer(int $offerId, int $priceIdr, string $affiliateUrl, ?string $sellerTitle, ?float $productRating, ?int $soldCount, ?string $externalId, ?string $sourceUrl): void
    {
        $sql = 'UPDATE `offers` SET `price_idr` = ?, `affiliate_url` = ?, `seller_title` = ?, `last_checked_at` = ?, `in_stock` = 1';
        $params = [$priceIdr, $affiliateUrl, $sellerTitle, date('Y-m-d H:i:s')];

        if ($productRating !== null) {
            $sql .= ', `product_rating` = ?';
            $params[] = $productRating;
        }
        if ($soldCount !== null) {
            $sql .= ', `sold_count` = ?';
            $params[] = $soldCount;
        }

        $sql .= ', `external_id` = ?, `source_url` = ?';
        $params[] = $externalId;
        $params[] = $sourceUrl;

        $sql .= ' WHERE `id` = ?';
        $params[] = $offerId;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    /**
     * Mark an offer as confirmed and in stock without changing its data.
     */
    private function touchOffer(int $offerId): void
    {
        $sql = 'UPDATE `offers` SET `last_checked_at` = ?, `in_stock` = 1 WHERE `id` = ?';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $offerId]);
    }

    /**
     * Update the store rating of a vendor.
     */
    private function updateVendorStoreRating(int $vendorId, float $storeRating): void
    {
        $sql = 'UPDATE `vendors` SET `store_rating` = ? WHERE `id` = ?';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$storeRating, $vendorId]);
    }
}
```

### app/Core/RateLimiter.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Rate Limiter
 * Provides rate limiting for sensitive endpoints.
 * Storage is the `rate_limits` database table, not the session, so the
 * limiter cannot be bypassed by dropping the session cookie.
 */
namespace App\Core;

use PDO;
use Exception;

class RateLimiter
{
    /** @var PDO Database connection */
    private PDO $pdo;

    /**
     * Attempt budgets per action.
     * Each entry is: max attempts, window length in seconds.
     */
    private static array $limits = [
        'login'          => ['max' => 5, 'window' => 300],
        'register'       => ['max' => 3, 'window' => 3600],
        'password_reset' => ['max' => 3, 'window' => 3600],
        'api'            => ['max' => 60, 'window' => 60],
    ];

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
    }

    public function check(string $key, string $action = 'login'): array
    {
        $config = ['max' => 10, 'window' => 60];
        if (isset(self::$limits[$action])) {
            $config = self::$limits[$action];
        }
        $maxAttempts = $config['max'];
        $window      = $config['window'];

        $bucket = $this->getIdentifier($key);
        $row = $this->fetchRow($bucket, $action);

        if ($row === null) {
            return ['allowed' => true, 'remaining' => $maxAttempts, 'retry_after' => null];
        }

        $now = time();
        $windowStart = (int) $row['window_start'];
        if ($now - $windowStart >= $window) {
            return ['allowed' => true, 'remaining' => $maxAttempts, 'retry_after' => null];
        }

        $used      = (int) $row['attempt_count'];
        $remaining = max(0, $maxAttempts - $used);
        $allowed   = $used < $maxAttempts;

        $retryAfter = null;
        if (!$allowed) {
            $retryAfter = $window - ($now - $windowStart);
            if ($retryAfter < 0) $retryAfter = 0;
        }

        return ['allowed' => $allowed, 'remaining' => $remaining, 'retry_after' => $retryAfter];
    }

    public function record(string $key, string $action = 'login'): void
    {
        $config = ['max' => 10, 'window' => 60];
        if (isset(self::$limits[$action])) {
            $config = self::$limits[$action];
        }
        $window = $config['window'];
        $bucket = $this->getIdentifier($key);
        $row = $this->fetchRow($bucket, $action);

        if ($row === null) {
            $sql = "INSERT INTO rate_limits (bucket, action, attempt_count, window_start, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (:bucket, :action, 1, :window_start, NOW(), NOW())";
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute(['bucket' => $bucket, 'action' => $action, 'window_start' => time()]);
            return;
        }

        $now = time();
        $windowStart = (int) $row['window_start'];
        if ($now - $windowStart >= $window) {
            $sql = "UPDATE rate_limits SET attempt_count = 1, window_start = :window_start, updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE bucket = :bucket AND action = :action";
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            $stmt->execute(['window_start' => $now, 'bucket' => $bucket, 'action' => $action]);
            return;
        }

        $sql = "UPDATE rate_limits SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE bucket = :bucket AND action = :action";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['bucket' => $bucket, 'action' => $action]);
    }

    public function consume(string $key, string $action = 'login'): void
    {
        $result = $this->check($key, $action);

        if (!$result['allowed']) {
            $retryAfter = 60;
            if (isset($result['retry_after'])) {
                $retryAfter = $result['retry_after'];
            }

            if (class_exists(SecurityLogger::class)) {
                $logger = new SecurityLogger();
                $logger->logSuspicious('rate_limit_exceeded', "Rate limit exceeded for {$action}", [
                    'action'      => $action,
                    'identifier'  => $this->getIdentifier($key),
                    'retry_after' => $retryAfter,
                ]);
            }

            throw new RateLimitException($action, (int) $retryAfter);
        }

        $this->record($key, $action);
    }

    public function clear(string $key, string $action = 'login'): void
    {
        $bucket = $this->getIdentifier($key);
        $sql = "DELETE FROM rate_limits WHERE bucket = :bucket AND action = :action";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['bucket' => $bucket, 'action' => $action]);
    }

    public static function formatRetryAfter(int $seconds): string
    {
        if ($seconds < 60) return $seconds . ' seconds';
        if ($seconds < 3600) return ((int) ceil($seconds / 60)) . ' minutes';
        return ((int) ceil($seconds / 3600)) . ' hours';
    }

    private function fetchRow(string $bucket, string $action): ?array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT attempt_count, window_start FROM rate_limits WHERE bucket = :bucket AND action = :action LIMIT 1";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute(['bucket' => $bucket, 'action' => $action]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row === false) {
            return null;
        }
        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * SECURE BY DEFAULT: 
     * 1. If a specific target key (like a phone number) is provided, it becomes the primary identifier.
     *    This prevents attackers from bypassing the limit by rotating their IP address.
     * 2. Otherwise, it falls back to the direct REMOTE_ADDR to prevent HTTP header spoofing.
     */
    private function getIdentifier(string $key): string
    {
        $genericActions = ['login', 'register', 'password_reset', 'api', 'contact'];
        
        // If the key is NOT a generic action name, treat it as a specific target (e.g., a phone number).
        // Hash it to keep the database bucket length consistent and obscure the PII.
        if (!in_array($key, $genericActions, true)) {
            return hash('sha256', 'target:' . $key);
        }

        // For generic actions, use IP + User Agent.
        // SECURE DEFAULT: Only trust REMOTE_ADDR to prevent header spoofing.
        $ip = 'unknown';
        if (isset($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'])) {
            $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
        }
        
        /* 
         * OPTIONAL: If you are strictly behind a trusted reverse proxy (like Cloudflare), 
         * you can uncomment the block below. NEVER enable this if your server is directly 
         * exposed to the internet, as attackers can easily spoof the X-Forwarded-For header.
         * 
         * if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'])) {
         *     $ips = explode(',', $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR']);
         *     $ip = trim($ips[0]); 
         * }
         */

        $ua = 'unknown';
        if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'])) {
            $ua = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'];
        }
        return hash('sha256', 'ip:' . $ip . '|' . $ua);
    }
}
```

### app/Core/RateLimitException.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * RateLimitException
 * Thrown by RateLimiter::consume() when a caller has exceeded the
 * configured attempt budget for an action.
 */
namespace App\Core;

use Exception;

class RateLimitException extends Exception
{
    /** @var int Seconds the caller must wait before trying again */
    private int $retryAfter;

    /** @var string Action that was rate limited (login, register, ...) */
    private string $action;

    /**
     * Constructor
     *
     * @param string $action     The rate-limited action name
     * @param int    $retryAfter Seconds until the caller can retry
     */
    public function __construct(string $action, int $retryAfter)
    {
        // Store the details for the controller to read.
        $this->action     = $action;
        $this->retryAfter = $retryAfter;

        // Build a human-readable message for logs and debugging.
        $message = "Rate limit exceeded for {$action}. Retry after {$retryAfter} seconds.";

        // Call the parent Exception constructor.
        parent::__construct($message);
    }

    /**
     * Seconds the caller must wait.
     */
    public function getRetryAfter(): int
    {
        return $this->retryAfter;
    }

    /**
     * The action name that was rate limited.
     */
    public function getAction(): string
    {
        return $this->action;
    }
}
```

### app/Core/RichText.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Core;

use DOMDocument;
use DOMXPath;

/**
 * Cleans rich text HTML before it is printed in a public view.
 */
class RichText
{
    /**
     * Clean rich text HTML by stripping disallowed tags and attributes.
     */
    public static function clean(string $html): string
    {
        if ($html === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $allowedTags = '<p><br><strong><b><em><i><u><ul><ol><li><h2><h3><h4><blockquote><table><thead><tbody><tr><th><td><a>';
        $html = strip_tags($html, $allowedTags);

        $document = new DOMDocument();
        libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $document->loadHTML('<?xml encoding="UTF-8"><div>' . $html . '</div>');
        libxml_clear_errors();
        $xpath = new DOMXPath($document);
        foreach ($xpath->query('//*') as $element) {
            $isAnchor = $element->nodeName === 'a';
            $attributeNames = [];
            foreach ($element->attributes as $attribute) {
                $attributeNames[] = $attribute->nodeName;
            }
            foreach ($attributeNames as $attributeName) {
                if ($isAnchor && $attributeName === 'href') {
                    if (preg_match('~^https?://~i', $element->getAttribute('href')) !== 1) {
                        $element->removeAttribute($attributeName);
                    }
                } elseif (!$isAnchor || $attributeName !== 'href') {
                    $element->removeAttribute($attributeName);
                }
            }
            if ($isAnchor) {
                $element->setAttribute('rel', 'nofollow noopener');
            }
        }

        $rootDiv = $document->getElementsByTagName('div')->item(0);
        $innerHtml = '';
        foreach ($rootDiv->childNodes as $childNode) {
            $innerHtml .= $document->saveHTML($childNode);
        }

        return $innerHtml;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Router Class
 * Handles URL routing and dispatching to controllers
 */
namespace App\Core;

use PDO;

/**
 * Simple regex-based router with dependency injection
 */
class Router
{
    /** @var array Registered routes */
    protected array $routes = [];
    
    /** @var string Base path of the application */
    protected string $basePath;
    
    /** @var PDO Database connection */
    protected PDO $pdo;

    /**
     * Constructor
     * 
     * @param PDO $pdo Database connection for controller injection
     */
    public function __construct(PDO $pdo)
    {
        $this->basePath = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
    }

    /**
     * Register a route
     * 
     * @param string $route Route pattern (regex supported)
     * @param string $controller Controller class name (without namespace)
     * @param string $method Controller method name
     * @return void
     */
    public function addRoute(string $route, string $controller, string $method): void
    {
        $this->routes[$route] = [
            'controller' => $controller,
            'method' => $method
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Dispatch request to matching route
     * 
     * @param string $uri Request URI
     * @return void
     */
    public function dispatch(string $uri): void
    {
        $uri = $this->sanitizeUri($uri);

        foreach ($this->routes as $routePattern => $routeInfo) {
            $pattern = "~^" . $routePattern . "$~";
            if (preg_match($pattern, $uri, $matches)) {
                array_shift($matches);

                $controller = $routeInfo['controller'];
                $method = $routeInfo['method'];
                $controllerClass = "App\\Controllers\\{$controller}";

                if (class_exists($controllerClass)) {
                    $controllerInstance = new $controllerClass($this->pdo);
                    if (method_exists($controllerInstance, $method)) {
                        $controllerInstance->$method(...$matches);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        $this->show404();
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize URI by removing query string and trimming
     * 
     * @param string $uri Raw URI
     * @return string Clean URI
     */
    protected function sanitizeUri(string $uri): string
    {
        if (($pos = strpos($uri, '?')) !== false) {
            $uri = substr($uri, 0, $pos);
        }
        return trim($uri, '/');
    }

    /**
     * Display 404 page
     * 
     * @return never
     */
    protected function show404(): void
    {
        http_response_code(404);
        $file = $this->basePath . '/views/errors/404.php';
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $pageTitle = '404 Not Found';
            require $file;
        } else {
            echo '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>404 Not Found</title></head><body>
            <h1>404 - Page Not Found</h1><p>The requested URL was not found on this server.</p></body></html>';
        }
        exit();
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Security Logger
 * Logs security events for audit and monitoring
 */
namespace App\Core;

class SecurityLogger {
    private string $logDir;
    private string $logFile;
    private int $maxFileSize = 10485760; // 10MB

    public function __construct() {
        $baseDir = __DIR__ . '/../../storage/logs/security';
        $this->logDir = $baseDir;
        $this->logFile = $this->logDir . '/security.log';
        
        if (!is_dir($this->logDir)) {
            mkdir($this->logDir, 0750, true);
        }
        
        // Protect log directory
        $htaccessPath = $this->logDir . '/.htaccess';
        if (!file_exists($htaccessPath)) {
            file_put_contents($htaccessPath, "Deny from all\n");
        }
    }

    public function log(string $level, string $event, array $details = []): void {
        $userAgent = 'unknown';
        if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'])) {
            $userAgent = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'];
        }
        $userId = null;
        if (isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
            $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'];
        }
        $requestUri = '';
        if (isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])) {
            $requestUri = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'];
        }
        $method = '';
        if (isset($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'])) {
            $method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
        }
        $entry = [
            'timestamp' => date('c'),
            'level' => strtoupper($level),
            'event' => $event,
            'ip' => $this->getClientIp(),
            'user_agent' => $userAgent,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'session_id' => session_id(),
            'details' => $details,
            'request_uri' => $requestUri,
            'method' => $method,
        ];

        $json = json_encode($entry, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
        
        // Rotate log if too large
        if (file_exists($this->logFile) && filesize($this->logFile) > $this->maxFileSize) {
            $rotated = $this->logDir . '/security_' . date('Y-m-d_H-i-s') . '.log';
            rename($this->logFile, $rotated);
            @chmod($rotated, 0640);
        }
        
        file_put_contents($this->logFile, $json, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
        @chmod($this->logFile, 0640);
    }

    public function logSuspicious(string $event, string $message, array $details = []): void {
        $details['message'] = $message;
        $this->log('warning', $event, $details);
    }

    public function logInfo(string $event, array $details = []): void {
        $this->log('info', $event, $details);
    }

    public function logError(string $event, string $message, array $details = []): void {
        $details['message'] = $message;
        $this->log('error', $event, $details);
    }

    public function logAuth(string $event, bool $success, array $details = []): void {
        $details['success'] = $success;
        $logLevel = 'warning';
        if ($success) {
            $logLevel = 'info';
        }
        $this->log($logLevel, 'auth_' . $event, $details);
    }

    private function getClientIp(): string {
        $headers = ['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR', 'HTTP_X_REAL_IP', 'HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
        foreach ($headers as $header) {
            if (!empty($_SERVER[$header])) {
                $ips = explode(',', $_SERVER[$header]);
                return trim($ips[0]);
            }
        }
        if (isset($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'])) {
            return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
        }
        return 'unknown';
    }
}
```

### app/Core/Seo.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Core;

/**
 * Small helpers that build SEO output for the public layouts.
 */
class Seo
{
    /**
     * Turn a site-relative path into an absolute URL using APP_URL.
     */
    public static function absoluteUrl(string $path): string
    {
        $base = Dotenv::get('APP_URL', '');
        $base = rtrim((string) $base, '/');

        if ($base === '') {
            return '';
        }

        return $base . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    /**
     * Convert stored HTML into a short plain-text description.
     */
    public static function plainText(string $html, int $max): string
    {
        $text = strip_tags($html);
        $text = html_entity_decode($text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
        $text = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $text);
        $text = trim((string) $text);

        if ($max > 0 && mb_strlen($text) > $max) {
            $text = mb_substr($text, 0, $max);
            $lastSpace = mb_strrpos($text, ' ');
            if ($lastSpace !== false) {
                $text = mb_substr($text, 0, $lastSpace);
            }
            $text = trim($text);
        }

        return $text;
    }

    /**
     * Validate and re-encode a JSON-LD snippet, returning '' when it is invalid.
     */
    public static function cleanJsonLd(string $raw): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($raw);

        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $decoded = json_decode($trimmed, true);

        if ($decoded === null) {
            return '';
        }

        $encoded = json_encode($decoded, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($encoded === false) {
            return '';
        }

        return $encoded;
    }

    /**
     * Build a BreadcrumbList JSON-LD string from labelled paths.
     */
    public static function breadcrumbJsonLd(array $crumbs): string
    {
        $base = Dotenv::get('APP_URL', '');
        $base = rtrim((string) $base, '/');

        if ($base === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $items = [];
        $position = 1;

        foreach ($crumbs as $crumb) {
            $label = '';
            if (isset($crumb['label'])) {
                $label = (string) $crumb['label'];
            }
            $path = '';
            if (isset($crumb['path'])) {
                $path = (string) $crumb['path'];
            }

            $item = [
                '@type' => 'ListItem',
                'position' => $position,
                'name' => $label,
            ];

            if ($path !== '') {
                $item['item'] = self::absoluteUrl($path);
            }

            $items[] = $item;
            $position++;
        }

        $data = [
            '@context' => 'https://schema.org',
            '@type' => 'BreadcrumbList',
            'itemListElement' => $items,
        ];

        $encoded = json_encode($data, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($encoded === false) {
            return '';
        }

        return $encoded;
    }

    /**
     * Build a Product JSON-LD string with an AggregateOffer for active offers.
     */
    public static function productJsonLd(array $product, string $brandName, array $offers, string $path, string $imagePath): string
    {
        if (empty($offers)) {
            return '';
        }

        $lowPrice = 0;
        $highPrice = 0;
        $first = true;

        foreach ($offers as $offer) {
            if (!isset($offer['price_idr'])) {
                continue;
            }

            $price = (int) $offer['price_idr'];

            if ($first) {
                $lowPrice = $price;
                $highPrice = $price;
                $first = false;
            } else {
                if ($price < $lowPrice) {
                    $lowPrice = $price;
                }
                if ($price > $highPrice) {
                    $highPrice = $price;
                }
            }
        }

        $name = '';
        if (isset($product['name'])) {
            $name = (string) $product['name'];
        }

        $shortDescription = '';
        if (isset($product['short_description'])) {
            $shortDescription = (string) $product['short_description'];
        }

        $longDescription = '';
        if (isset($product['description'])) {
            $longDescription = (string) $product['description'];
        }

        $description = '';
        if ($shortDescription !== '') {
            $description = self::plainText($shortDescription, 300);
        } else {
            $description = self::plainText($longDescription, 300);
        }

        $data = [
            '@context' => 'https://schema.org',
            '@type' => 'Product',
            'name' => $name,
        ];

        if ($description !== '') {
            $data['description'] = $description;
        }

        if ($imagePath !== '') {
            $data['image'] = self::absoluteUrl($imagePath);
        }

        if ($brandName !== '') {
            $data['brand'] = [
                '@type' => 'Brand',
                'name' => $brandName,
            ];
        }

        $mpn = '';
        if (isset($product['model_number'])) {
            $mpn = (string) $product['model_number'];
        }
        if ($mpn !== '') {
            $data['mpn'] = $mpn;
        }

        $data['url'] = self::absoluteUrl($path);
        $data['offers'] = [
            '@type' => 'AggregateOffer',
            'priceCurrency' => 'IDR',
            'lowPrice' => $lowPrice,
            'highPrice' => $highPrice,
            'offerCount' => count($offers),
            'availability' => 'https://schema.org/InStock',
        ];

        $encoded = json_encode($data, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

        if ($encoded === false) {
            return '';
        }

        return $encoded;
    }
}
```

### app/Core/Validator.php

```php
<?php
/**
 * Input Validator & Sanitizer
 * Provides validation and sanitization for user inputs
 */
namespace App\Core;

class Validator {
    /**
     * Sanitize string input
     */
    public static function sanitize(string $input, int $maxLength = 255, bool $allowHtml = false): string {
        $input = trim($input);
        
        if (!$allowHtml) {
            $input = strip_tags($input);
        }
        
        // Remove null bytes
        $input = str_replace("\0", '', $input);
        
        // Limit length
        if (strlen($input) > $maxLength) {
            $input = substr($input, 0, $maxLength);
        }
        
        return $input;
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize for HTML output (prevents XSS)
     */
    public static function escape(string $input): string {
        return htmlspecialchars($input, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize for SQL (use prepared statements instead, but useful for debugging)
     */
    public static function escapeSql(string $input): string {
        // This is for logging/debugging only - use prepared statements for queries
        return addslashes($input);
    }

    /**
     * Validate email
     */
    public static function email(string $email): bool {
        $email = trim($email);
        return filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false;
    }

    /**
     * Validate phone number (E.164 format)
     */
    public static function phone(string $phone): bool {
        $phone = trim($phone);
        // E.164 format: + followed by 8-15 digits
        return preg_match('/^\+\d{8,15}$/', $phone) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * Validate URL
     */
    public static function url(string $url): bool {
        $url = trim($url);
        return filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) !== false;
    }

    /**
     * Validate integer
     * Accepts int or numeric string. Correctly allows 0.
     */
    public static function integer(mixed $value, ?int $min = null, ?int $max = null): bool {
        // Reject anything that is not a valid integer representation.
        // filter_var returns false for non-integers and int(0) for "0" or 0.
        // We must use strict === false so that 0 is treated as valid.
        $filtered = filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if ($filtered === false) {
            return false;
        }

        // Cast to int now that we know it is a valid integer value.
        $int = (int) $filtered;

        // Enforce optional minimum bound.
        if ($min !== null && $int < $min) {
            return false;
        }

        // Enforce optional maximum bound.
        if ($max !== null && $int > $max) {
            return false;
        }

        // Value passed all checks.
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Validate string length
     */
    public static function length(string $value, int $min = 0, int $max = 255): bool {
        $len = strlen($value);
        return $len >= $min && $len <= $max;
    }

    /**
     * Validate required field
     */
    public static function required(mixed $value): bool {
        if (is_string($value)) {
            return trim($value) !== '';
        }
        return $value !== null && $value !== '';
    }

    /**
     * Validate against allowed values
     */
    public static function inArray(mixed $value, array $allowed): bool {
        return in_array($value, $allowed, true);
    }

    /**
     * Validate alphanumeric (with optional spaces, dashes, underscores)
     */
    public static function alphanumeric(string $value, bool $allowSpaces = true, bool $allowDash = true, bool $allowUnderscore = true): bool {
        $pattern = '/^[a-zA-Z0-9';
        if ($allowSpaces) $pattern .= '\s';
        if ($allowDash) $pattern .= '-';
        if ($allowUnderscore) $pattern .= '_';
        $pattern .= ']+$/';
        return preg_match($pattern, $value) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * Validate password strength
     */
    public static function passwordStrength(string $password): array {
        $errors = [];
        
        if (strlen($password) < 8) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must be at least 8 characters';
        }
        if (strlen($password) > 128) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must not exceed 128 characters';
        }
        if (!preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $password)) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must contain at least one uppercase letter';
        }
        if (!preg_match('/[a-z]/', $password)) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must contain at least one lowercase letter';
        }
        if (!preg_match('/\d/', $password)) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must contain at least one number';
        }
        if (!preg_match('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', $password)) {
            $errors[] = 'Password must contain at least one special character';
        }
        
        return [
            'valid' => empty($errors),
            'errors' => $errors,
            'score' => self::calculatePasswordScore($password),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Calculate password entropy score (0-4)
     */
    private static function calculatePasswordScore(string $password): int {
        $score = 0;
        $length = strlen($password);
        
        // Length scoring
        if ($length >= 12) $score++;
        if ($length >= 16) $score++;
        
        // Character variety
        $variety = 0;
        if (preg_match('/[a-z]/', $password)) $variety++;
        if (preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $password)) $variety++;
        if (preg_match('/\d/', $password)) $variety++;
        if (preg_match('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', $password)) $variety++;
        
        $score += min($variety, 2);
        
        return min($score, 4);
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize file name
     */
    public static function sanitizeFileName(string $filename): string {
        // Remove path components
        $filename = basename($filename);
        
        // Remove special characters except alphanumeric, dot, dash, underscore
        $filename = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '', $filename);
        
        // Prevent multiple dots
        $filename = preg_replace('/\.+/', '.', $filename);
        
        // Limit length
        if (strlen($filename) > 255) {
            $ext = pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
            $name = pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
            $filename = substr($name, 0, 255 - strlen($ext) - 1) . '.' . $ext;
        }
        
        return $filename;
    }

    /**
     * Validate file upload
     */
    public static function validateFileUpload(array $file, array $allowedMimes = [], int $maxSize = 5242880): array {
        $errors = [];
        
        if ($file['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            $errors[] = 'File upload error: ' . $file['error'];
            return ['valid' => false, 'errors' => $errors];
        }
        
        if ($file['size'] > $maxSize) {
            $errors[] = 'File size exceeds maximum allowed (' . ($maxSize / 1024 / 1024) . 'MB)';
        }
        
        // Check MIME type
        if (!empty($allowedMimes)) {
            $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
            $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $file['tmp_name']);
            finfo_close($finfo);
            
            if (!in_array($mime, $allowedMimes, true)) {
                $errors[] = 'File type not allowed';
            }
        }
        
        // Check extension
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($file['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        $allowedExts = ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp', 'pdf', 'doc', 'docx'];
        if (!in_array($ext, $allowedExts, true)) {
            $errors[] = 'File extension not allowed';
        }
        
        $mimeValue = null;
        if (isset($mime)) {
            $mimeValue = $mime;
        }
        return [
            'valid' => empty($errors),
            'errors' => $errors,
            'mime' => $mimeValue,
            'extension' => $ext,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate array of inputs against rules
     * Rules format: ['field' => ['rule' => value, ...]]
     */
    public static function validate(array $data, array $rules): array {
        $errors = [];
        $validated = [];
        
        foreach ($rules as $field => $fieldRules) {
            $value = null;
            if (isset($data[$field])) {
                $value = $data[$field];
            }
            $required = false;
            if (isset($fieldRules['required'])) {
                $required = $fieldRules['required'];
            }
            
            if ($required && !self::required($value)) {
                $errors[$field] = ucfirst($field) . ' is required';
                continue;
            }
            
            if (!self::required($value)) {
                $validated[$field] = $value;
                continue;
            }
            
            // Type-specific validation
            if (isset($fieldRules['type'])) {
                switch ($fieldRules['type']) {
                    case 'email':
                        if (!self::email($value)) {
                            $errors[$field] = 'Invalid email format';
                        }
                        break;
                    case 'phone':
                        if (!self::phone($value)) {
                            $errors[$field] = 'Invalid phone number format (use E.164: +628123456789)';
                        }
                        break;
                    case 'url':
                        if (!self::url($value)) {
                            $errors[$field] = 'Invalid URL format';
                        }
                        break;
                    case 'int':
                        $min = null;
                        if (isset($fieldRules['min'])) {
                            $min = $fieldRules['min'];
                        }
                        $max = null;
                        if (isset($fieldRules['max'])) {
                            $max = $fieldRules['max'];
                        }
                        if (!self::integer($value, $min, $max)) {
                            $minText = '';
                            if ($min !== null) {
                                $minText = " >= $min";
                            }
                            $maxText = '';
                            if ($max !== null) {
                                $maxText = " <= $max";
                            }
                            $errors[$field] = 'Must be a valid integer' . $minText . $maxText;
                        }
                        break;
                    case 'string':
                        $min = 0;
                        if (isset($fieldRules['min'])) {
                            $min = $fieldRules['min'];
                        }
                        $max = 255;
                        if (isset($fieldRules['max'])) {
                            $max = $fieldRules['max'];
                        }
                        if (!self::length($value, $min, $max)) {
                            $errors[$field] = "Must be between $min and $max characters";
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
            
            // Custom validation callback
            if (isset($fieldRules['callback']) && is_callable($fieldRules['callback'])) {
                $result = $fieldRules['callback']($value);
                if ($result !== true) {
                    $errorMessage = 'Validation failed';
                    if (is_string($result)) {
                        $errorMessage = $result;
                    }
                    $errors[$field] = $errorMessage;
                }
            }
            
            // Allowed values
            if (isset($fieldRules['in'])) {
                if (!self::inArray($value, $fieldRules['in'])) {
                    $errors[$field] = 'Invalid value';
                }
            }
            
            // Sanitize
            $sanitizeMax = 255;
            if (isset($fieldRules['max'])) {
                $sanitizeMax = $fieldRules['max'];
            }
            $sanitizeAllowHtml = false;
            if (isset($fieldRules['allow_html'])) {
                $sanitizeAllowHtml = $fieldRules['allow_html'];
            }
            $validated[$field] = self::sanitize($value, $sanitizeMax, $sanitizeAllowHtml);
        }
        
        return [
            'valid' => empty($errors),
            'errors' => $errors,
            'data' => $validated,
        ];
    }
}
```

### app/Models/BrandModel.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;

/**
 * Brand model for the catalog base module.
 */
class BrandModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'brands';

    /**
     * Return all published brands ordered by the given column.
     */
    public function findAllPublished(string $orderBy = 'name ASC'): array
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (ASC|DESC)$/i', $orderBy)) {
            $orderBy = 'name ASC';
        }

        return $this->query(
            "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE status = ? ORDER BY {$orderBy}",
            ['published']
        );
    }

    /**
     * Return published brands that own at least one published product.
     */
    public function findPublishedWithProducts(int $limit): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT b.* FROM {$this->table} b
                WHERE b.status = 'published'
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.brand_id = b.id AND p.status = 'published')
                ORDER BY b.name ASC
                LIMIT ?";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bindValue(1, $limit, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Check whether a slug is already used by another brand.
     */
    public function slugExists(string $slug, int $ignoreId = 0): bool
    {
        $brand = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?",
            [$slug, $ignoreId]
        );

        if ($brand) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
```

```php
            ['published']
        );
    }

    /**
     * Check whether a slug is already used by another category.
     */
    public function slugExists(string $slug, int $ignoreId = 0): bool
    {
        $category = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?",
            [$slug, $ignoreId]
        );

        if ($category) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;

/**
 * Click model for affiliate offer click tracking.
 */
class ClickModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'offer_clicks';
    protected bool $timestamps = false;

    /**
     * Record a single offer click.
     */
    public function logClick(int $offerId, string $ipHash, ?string $userAgent, ?string $referer): bool
    {
        $newId = $this->insert([
            'offer_id' => $offerId,
            'clicked_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            'ip_hash' => $ipHash,
            'user_agent' => $userAgent,
            'referer' => $referer,
        ]);

        if ($newId > 0) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Count the recorded clicks of one offer.
     */
    public function countByOfferId(int $offerId): int
    {
        $sql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM `offer_clicks` WHERE `offer_id` = ?';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$offerId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count the recorded clicks across all offers of one product.
     */
    public function countByProductId(int $productId): int
    {
        $sql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM `offer_clicks` oc
                INNER JOIN `offers` o ON o.id = oc.offer_id
                WHERE o.product_id = ?';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$productId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Return click totals per product for dashboard analytics.
     */
    public function getProductClickStats(string $sort, string $dir): array
    {
        $direction = 'DESC';
        if ($dir === 'asc') {
            $direction = 'ASC';
        }

        $orderBy = 'clicks DESC, p.id ASC';
        if ($sort === 'clicks') {
            $secondary = 'ASC';
            if ($direction === 'DESC') {
                $secondary = 'ASC';
            }
            $orderBy = 'clicks ' . $direction . ', p.id ASC';
        } elseif ($sort === 'name') {
            $orderBy = 'p.name ' . $direction . ', clicks DESC';
        } elseif ($sort === 'id') {
            $orderBy = 'p.id ' . $direction . ', clicks DESC';
        }

        $sql = "SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(oc.id) AS clicks
                FROM products p
                LEFT JOIN offers o ON o.product_id = p.id
                LEFT JOIN offer_clicks oc ON oc.offer_id = o.id
                GROUP BY p.id, p.name
                ORDER BY " . $orderBy;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
}
```

### app/Models/MemberModel.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;
use PDO;
use Exception;

class MemberModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'members';

    /**
     * Return the preferred Argon2id algorithm, falling back to the default.
     */
    private function passwordAlgorithm(): string
    {
        if (defined('PASSWORD_ARGON2ID')) {
            return PASSWORD_ARGON2ID;
        }
        return PASSWORD_DEFAULT;
    }

    /**
     * Register a new member and return the new ID.
     */
    public function register(string $email, string $plainPassword, string $whatsapp = ''): int
    {
        if (!\App\Core\Validator::email($email)) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid email address');
        }

        if ($this->findByEmail($email)) {
            throw new Exception('Email address already registered');
        }

        $hash = password_hash($plainPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
        $verificationToken = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));

        return $this->insert([
            'email' => $email,
            'password' => $hash,
            'status' => 'pending',
            'verification_token' => $verificationToken,
            'whatsapp' => $whatsapp,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Register an active member from a verified social sign-in and return the new ID.
     */
    public function registerFromSocial(string $email): int
    {
        $hash = password_hash(bin2hex(random_bytes(16)), $this->passwordAlgorithm());

        return $this->insert([
            'email' => $email,
            'password' => $hash,
            'status' => 'active',
            'verification_token' => null,
            'whatsapp' => '',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Authenticate a member with timing-attack protection.
     */
    public function login(string $email, string $plainPassword): ?array
    {
        $user = $this->findByEmail($email);

        // SECURITY: Prevent Timing Attacks (User Enumeration)
        // If the user doesn't exist, we still run password_verify against a dummy hash.
        $hashToVerify = '$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=4,p=1$ZmFrZQ$ZmFrZQ';
        if ($user) {
            $hashToVerify = $user['password'];
        }

        // Execute password_verify unconditionally so timing does not reveal existence.
        $isPasswordCorrect = password_verify($plainPassword, $hashToVerify);

        if ($user && $isPasswordCorrect) {
            if ($user['status'] === 'banned') {
                throw new Exception('Your account has been banned.');
            }
            if ($user['status'] === 'pending') {
                throw new Exception('Your account is waiting for activation by an administrator.');
            }

            unset($user['password']);
            return $user;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Find a member by email address.
     */
    public function findByEmail(string $email): ?array
    {
        return $this->queryOne("SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE email = ?", [$email]);
    }

    /**
     * Find a member by verification token.
     */
    public function findByToken(string $token): ?array
    {
        return $this->queryOne("SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE verification_token = ?", [$token]);
    }

    /**
     * Return members for the dashboard list without secrets.
     */
    public function findAllMembersForList(): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT id, email, username, status, created_at FROM {$this->table} ORDER BY id ASC";
        return $this->query($sql);
    }

    /**
     * Activate a member and clear the verification token.
     */
    public function activateUser(int $id): bool
    {
        return $this->update($id, [
            'status' => 'active',
            'verification_token' => null,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update a member's status after validating the whitelist.
     */
    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowedStatuses = ['active', 'banned'];
        if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid status');
        }

        return $this->update($id, ['status' => $status]);
    }

    /**
     * Hash and update a member's password.
     */
    public function updatePassword(int $id, string $newPassword): bool
    {
        $hash = password_hash($newPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
        return $this->update($id, ['password' => $hash]);
    }

    /**
     * Update a member's avatar path.
     */
    public function updateAvatar(int $id, string $avatarPath): bool
    {
        return $this->update($id, ['avatar' => $avatarPath]);
    }

    /**
     * Link a social account to an existing member.
     */
    public function linkSocialAccount(int $memberId, string $provider, string $providerId): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO user_social_accounts (user_id, provider, provider_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
        );
        return $stmt->execute([$memberId, $provider, $providerId]);
    }

    /**
     * Set or clear a member's unique username.
     */
    public function updateUsername(int $id, string $username): bool
    {
        $username = trim($username);

        if ($username === '') {
            return $this->update($id, ['username' => null]);
        }

        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,50}$/', $username) !== 1) {
            throw new Exception('Username must be 3-50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores');
        }

        $existing = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE username = ? AND id != ?",
            [$username, $id]
        );
        if ($existing) {
            throw new Exception('Username is already taken');
        }

        return $this->update($id, ['username' => $username]);
    }

    /**
     * Count members that have the given status.
     */
    public function countByStatus(string $status): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE status = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$status]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return (int) $row['c'];
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;

/**
 * Offer model for the products and offers module.
 */
class OfferModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'offers';

    /**
     * Return all offers for a product with their store names.
     */
    public function findByProductId(int $productId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT o.*, s.name AS store_name, v.name AS vendor_name, v.rating AS vendor_rating
                FROM {$this->table} o
                LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                WHERE o.product_id = ?
                ORDER BY o.price_idr ASC";

        return $this->query($sql, [$productId]);
    }

    /**
     * Return the SQL fragment that defines a publicly active offer.
     */
    public static function activeCondition(): string
    {
        return "o.status = 'published' AND o.in_stock = 1 AND s.status = 'published' AND (v.id IS NULL OR v.status = 'active') AND (o.last_checked_at IS NULL OR o.last_checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY))";
    }

    /**
     * Return all active offers for a product with their store names.
     */
    public function findPublicByProductId(int $productId): array
    {
        $activeCondition = self::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT o.*, s.name AS store_name, v.name AS vendor_name, v.rating AS vendor_rating, v.store_rating AS vendor_store_rating
                FROM {$this->table} o
                LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                WHERE o.product_id = ? AND " . $activeCondition . "
                ORDER BY o.price_idr ASC";

        return $this->query($sql, [$productId]);
    }

    /**
     * Return one active offer by id, or null when it is not publicly available.
     */
    public function findActiveById(int $offerId): ?array
    {
        $activeCondition = self::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT o.*, s.name AS store_name, v.name AS vendor_name, v.rating AS vendor_rating, v.store_rating AS vendor_store_rating
                FROM {$this->table} o
                LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                WHERE o.id = ? AND " . $activeCondition . "
                LIMIT 1";

        $result = $this->queryOne($sql, [$offerId]);

        if ($result) {
            return $result;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Count the offers that are publicly active.
     */
    public function countActive(): int
    {
        $activeCondition = self::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} o
                INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                WHERE " . $activeCondition;

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count published, in-stock offers whose last check is older than 14 days.
     */
    public function countStale(): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} o
                WHERE o.status = 'published' AND o.in_stock = 1
                    AND o.last_checked_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count how many offers reference a store.
     */
    public function countByStoreId(int $storeId): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE store_id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$storeId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count how many offers reference a vendor.
     */
    public function countByVendorId(int $vendorId): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE vendor_id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$vendorId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }
}
```
