### app/Models/ProductModel.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;
use App\Core\Validator;

/**
 * Product model for the products and offers module.
 */
class ProductModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'products';

    /**
     * Check whether a slug is already used by another product.
     */
    public function slugExists(string $slug, int $ignoreId = 0): bool
    {
        $product = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?",
            [$slug, $ignoreId]
        );

        if ($product) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Return all published products with category and brand names.
     */
    public function getAllWithRelations(): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                ORDER BY p.id DESC";

        return $this->query($sql);
    }

    public function countAll(): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    public function getAllWithRelationsPaginated(int $offset, int $limit, string $search = '', string $status = ''): array
    {
        $conditions = [];
        $params = [];

        if ($search !== '') {
            $conditions[] = "(p.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.short_description LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\')";
            $params[] = "%$search%";
            $params[] = "%$search%";
        }

        if ($status !== '') {
            $conditions[] = "p.status = ?";
            $params[] = $status;
        }

        $where = '';
        if ($conditions !== []) {
            $where = 'WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $conditions);
        }

        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                $where
                ORDER BY p.id DESC
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";

        $params[] = $limit;
        $params[] = $offset;

        return $this->query($sql, $params);
    }

    /**
     * Return all published products with category and brand names.
     */
    public function getPublishedWithRelations(): array
    {
        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.status = 'published'
                ORDER BY p.id DESC";

        return $this->query($sql);
    }

    /**
     * Return the most recently created published products.
     */
    public function findNewestPublished(int $limit): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1) {
            $limit = 8;
        }

        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.status = 'published'
                ORDER BY p.id DESC
                LIMIT ?";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bindValue(1, $limit, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Return the latest published products in a category that have an active offer.
     */
    public function findLatestActiveByCategoryId(int $categoryId, int $limit): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1) {
            $limit = 8;
        }

        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.category_id = ? AND p.status = 'published'
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ")
                ORDER BY p.id DESC
                LIMIT ?";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bindValue(1, $categoryId, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(2, $limit, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Return published products in the same category that have an active offer.
     */
    public function findRelated(int $categoryId, int $excludeId, int $limit): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1) {
            $limit = 4;
        }

        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.category_id = ? AND p.id != ? AND p.status = 'published'
                    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ")
                ORDER BY p.id DESC
                LIMIT ?";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bindValue(1, $categoryId, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(2, $excludeId, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(3, $limit, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Return published products that have at least one publicly active offer.
     */
    public function findAllPublishedWithActiveOffers(): array
    {
        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.slug, p.updated_at, c.slug AS category_slug
                FROM {$this->table} p
                INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                INNER JOIN offers o ON o.product_id = p.id
                INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                WHERE p.status = 'published' AND c.status = 'published' AND " . $activeCondition . "
                ORDER BY p.id DESC";

        return $this->query($sql);
    }

    /**
     * Return a single published product with category and brand names by ID.
     */
    public function findByIdWithRelations(int $id): ?array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, c.status AS category_status, b.name AS brand_name
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.id = ?
                LIMIT 1";

        $result = $this->queryOne($sql, [$id]);

        if ($result) {
            return $result;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Return all published products that belong to the given category slug.
     */
    public function findAllByCategorySlug(string $slug, int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0, string $sort = 'newest'): array
    {
        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $orderBy = $this->sortClause($sort);
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE c.slug = ? AND p.status = ?
                ORDER BY " . $orderBy . "
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";

        return $this->queryPaginated($sql, [$slug, 'published'], $limit, $offset);
    }

    /**
     * Return all published products that belong to the given brand slug.
     */
    public function findAllByBrandSlug(string $slug, int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0, string $sort = 'newest'): array
    {
        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $orderBy = $this->sortClause($sort);
        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE b.slug = ? AND p.status = ?
                ORDER BY " . $orderBy . "
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";

        return $this->queryPaginated($sql, [$slug, 'published'], $limit, $offset);
    }

    /**
     * Count published products in a category slug.
     */
    public function countByCategorySlug(string $slug): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} p
                INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                WHERE c.slug = ? AND p.status = 'published'";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count published products in a brand slug.
     */
    public function countByBrandSlug(string $slug): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} p
                INNER JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE b.slug = ? AND p.status = 'published'";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Count how many products belong to a category.
     */
    public function countByCategoryId(int $categoryId): int
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE category_id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$categoryId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Find published products whose name, short description or search tags match the query.
     */
    public function search(string $query, int $limit = 20, int $offset = 0, string $sort = 'newest'): array
    {
        $patterns = $this->searchPatterns($query);
        if (empty($patterns)) {
            return [];
        }

        $activeCondition = OfferModel::activeCondition();
        $orderBy = $this->sortClause($sort);

        $conditions = [];
        $params = [];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $conditions[] = "(p.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.model_number LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.search_tags LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR b.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.short_description LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\')";
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, b.name AS brand_name,
                    (SELECT MIN(o.price_idr) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS lowest_price,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o
                        INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = o.vendor_id
                        WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND " . $activeCondition . ") AS offer_count
                FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.status = 'published'
                    AND " . implode(' AND ', $conditions) . "
                ORDER BY " . $orderBy . "
                LIMIT ? OFFSET ?";

        return $this->queryPaginated($sql, $params, $limit, $offset);
    }

    /**
     * Count published products matching the search query.
     */
    public function countSearch(string $query): int
    {
        $patterns = $this->searchPatterns($query);
        if (empty($patterns)) {
            return 0;
        }

        $conditions = [];
        $params = [];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $conditions[] = "(p.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.model_number LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.search_tags LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR b.name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\' OR p.short_description LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\\\')";
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
            $params[] = $pattern;
        }

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} p
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                WHERE p.status = 'published'
                    AND " . implode(' AND ', $conditions);

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Split a search query into escaped LIKE patterns (max 6 tokens).
     */
    private function searchPatterns(string $query): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($query);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return [];
        }

        $tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $trimmed);
        if (!is_array($tokens)) {
            return [];
        }
        $tokens = array_slice($tokens, 0, 6);

        $patterns = [];
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            $escaped = str_replace(["\\", "%", "_"], ["\\\\", "\\%", "\\_"], $token);
            $patterns[] = '%' . $escaped . '%';
        }

        return $patterns;
    }

    /**
     * Map a whitelisted sort value to a fixed ORDER BY clause.
     */
    private function sortClause(string $sort): string
    {
        if (!Validator::inArray($sort, ['newest', 'price_asc', 'price_desc'])) {
            $sort = 'newest';
        }

        switch ($sort) {
            case 'price_asc':
                return 'lowest_price IS NULL, lowest_price ASC, p.id DESC';
            case 'price_desc':
                return 'lowest_price IS NULL, lowest_price DESC, p.id DESC';
        }

        return 'p.id DESC';
    }

    /**
     * Run a paginated query with integer LIMIT and OFFSET bindings.
     */
    private function queryPaginated(string $sql, array $params, int $limit, int $offset): array
    {
        if ($limit < 1) {
            $limit = 20;
        }
        if ($offset < 0) {
            $offset = 0;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $position = 1;
        foreach ($params as $param) {
            $stmt->bindValue($position, $param);
            $position++;
        }
        $stmt->bindValue($position, $limit, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $position++;
        $stmt->bindValue($position, $offset, \PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();

        return $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;

/**
 * Stores the parsed intent of a search query so the same query is not parsed twice.
 */
class SearchCacheModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'search_cache';
    protected bool $timestamps = false;

    /**
     * Return the cached intent for a query hash, or null when the query is not cached.
     */
    public function getIntent(string $queryHash): ?array
    {
        return $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE `query_hash` = ? LIMIT 1",
            [$queryHash]
        );
    }

    /**
     * Store the parsed intent of a query.
     */
    public function saveIntent(string $queryHash, string $originalQuery, string $parsedIntent): void
    {
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (`query_hash`, `original_query`, `parsed_intent`, `created_at`)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `parsed_intent` = VALUES(`parsed_intent`)";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([
            $queryHash,
            $originalQuery,
            $parsedIntent,
            date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        ]);
    }
}
```

### app/Models/SeoMetaModel.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;

/**
 * SEO meta model for storing per-entity SEO fields.
 */
class SeoMetaModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'seo_meta';

    /**
     * Insert or update the SEO meta row for an entity.
     */
    public function saveMeta(string $metaType, int $metaId, array $data): bool
    {
        $filtered = $this->filterAllowed($data);
        $existing = $this->findByMeta($metaType, $metaId);

        if ($existing) {
            if (empty($filtered)) {
                return true;
            }

            return $this->update((int) $existing['id'], $filtered);
        }

        $filtered['meta_type'] = $metaType;
        $filtered['meta_id'] = $metaId;

        $newId = $this->insert($filtered);

        if ($newId > 0) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Find the SEO meta row for an entity.
     */
    public function findByMeta(string $metaType, int $metaId): ?array
    {
        return $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE meta_type = ? AND meta_id = ? LIMIT 1",
            [$metaType, $metaId]
        );
    }

    /**
     * Keep only the SEO columns that may be saved.
     */
    private function filterAllowed(array $data): array
    {
        $allowed = [
            'seo_title',
            'seo_description',
            'canonical_url',
            'robots_tag',
            'og_title',
            'og_description',
            'og_image',
            'twitter_title',
            'twitter_description',
            'schema_markup',
            'custom_head_tags',
            'custom_body',
            'custom_footer',
        ];

        $filtered = [];
        foreach ($allowed as $key) {
            if (isset($data[$key])) {
                $filtered[$key] = $data[$key];
            }
        }

        return $filtered;
    }
}
```

```php
     * Return the stored value for a setting key, or an empty string when missing.

    public function getValue(string $key): string
    {
        $row = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT setting_value FROM {$this->table} WHERE setting_key = ? LIMIT 1",
            [$key]
        );

        $value = '';
        if ($row !== null && isset($row['setting_value'])) {
            $value = (string) $row['setting_value'];
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Insert a setting when it does not exist, otherwise update its value.
     */
    public function saveSetting(string $key, string $value): bool
    {
        $existing = $this->queryOne(
            "SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE setting_key = ? LIMIT 1",
            [$key]
        );

        if ($existing !== null) {
            return $this->update((int) $existing['id'], ['setting_value' => $value]);
        }

        $newId = $this->insert([
            'setting_key' => $key,
            'setting_value' => $value,
        ]);

        if ($newId > 0) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
```

### app/Models/UserModel.php

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;

use App\Core\Model;
use PDO;
use Exception;

class UserModel extends Model {
    protected string $table = 'users';

    private function passwordAlgorithm(): string {
        if (defined('PASSWORD_ARGON2ID')) {
            return PASSWORD_ARGON2ID;
        }
        return PASSWORD_DEFAULT;
    }
    
    /**
     * Normalize phone number to E.164 format (+628123456789)
     */
    private function normalizePhone(string $phone): string {
        $phone = trim($phone);
        
        // Remove all non-digit characters except +
        $phone = preg_replace('/[^\d+]/', '', $phone);
        
        // If starts with 0, replace with country code (assuming Indonesia +62)
        if (str_starts_with($phone, '0')) {
            $phone = '+62' . substr($phone, 1);
        }
        
        // If doesn't start with +, assume it's missing country code
        if (!str_starts_with($phone, '+')) {
            throw new Exception('Phone number must include country code (e.g., +628123456789)');
        }
        
        // Validate length (E.164 max 15 digits)
        $digitsOnly = substr($phone, 1);
        if (strlen($digitsOnly) < 8 || strlen($digitsOnly) > 15) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid phone number length');
        }
        
        return $phone;
    }

        public function register(string $phone, string $plainPassword, string $role = 'user'): int {
        // Validate password
        if (strlen($plainPassword) < 8) {
            throw new Exception('Password must be at least 8 characters');
        }

        // Validate and normalize phone
        try {
            $phone = $this->normalizePhone($phone);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid phone number: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Check duplicate
        if ($this->findByPhone($phone)) {
            throw new Exception('Phone number already registered');
        }

        // Whitelist role
        $allowedRoles = ['root', 'admin', 'user'];
        if (!in_array($role, $allowedRoles, true)) {
            $role = 'user';
        }

        // Hash & store
        $hash = password_hash($plainPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
        return $this->insert([
            'phone' => $phone,
            'password' => $hash,
            'role' => $role,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Secure login with Timing Attack Prevention
     */
    public function login(string $phone, string $plainPassword): ?array 
    {
        // Normalize phone for lookup
        try {
            $phone = $this->normalizePhone($phone);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            // Fail securely: use a dummy hash to prevent timing attacks
            password_verify($plainPassword, '$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=4,p=1$ZmFrZQ$ZmFrZQ');
            return null;
        }

        $user = $this->queryOne("SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE phone = ?", [$phone]);
        
        // SECURITY: Prevent Timing Attacks (User Enumeration)
        // If the user doesn't exist, we still run password_verify against a dummy hash.
        $hashToVerify = '$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=4,p=1$ZmFrZQ$ZmFrZQ';
        if ($user) {
            $hashToVerify = $user['password'];
        }
        
        // CRITICAL FIX: Execute password_verify FIRST. 
        // If we put it inside `if ($user && ...)`, PHP's short-circuit evaluation 
        // will SKIP it when $user is null, defeating the timing attack prevention!
        $isPasswordCorrect = password_verify($plainPassword, $hashToVerify);
        
        if ($user && $isPasswordCorrect) {
            $passwordHash = $user['password'];
            unset($user['password']);
            
            // Rehash if the algorithm or cost has changed
            if (password_needs_rehash($passwordHash, $this->passwordAlgorithm())) {
                $newHash = password_hash($plainPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
                $this->update($user['id'], ['password' => $newHash]);
            }
            
            // Update the last login timestamp
            $this->update($user['id'], ['last_login_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')]);
            
            return $user;
        }
        
        return null;
    }

    public function findByPhone(string $phone): ?array {
        return $this->queryOne("SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE phone = ?", [$phone]);
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array {
        return $this->queryOne("SELECT * FROM {$this->table} WHERE id = ?", [$id]);
    }

    public function updateUsername(int $id, string $username): bool {
        $username = trim($username);

        if ($username === '') {
            return $this->update($id, ['username' => null]);
        }

        $valid = preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,50}$/', $username);
        if (!$valid) {
            throw new Exception('Username must be 3-50 characters, using only letters, numbers, and underscores');
        }

        $existing = $this->queryOne("SELECT id FROM {$this->table} WHERE username = ? AND id != ?", [$username, $id]);
        if ($existing) {
            throw new Exception('Username already taken');
        }

        return $this->update($id, ['username' => $username]);
    }

    /**
     * Change a user's password after verifying the current one.
     * Enforces the same strength policy as registration so the two paths
     * cannot diverge.
     */
    public function changePassword(int $id, string $currentPassword, string $newPassword): bool {
        // Load the current row and verify the old password.
        $user = $this->findById($id);
        if (!$user || !password_verify($currentPassword, $user['password'])) {
            throw new Exception('Current password is incorrect');
        }

        // Enforce the shared password strength policy.
        $pwCheck = \App\Core\Validator::passwordStrength($newPassword);
        if (!$pwCheck['valid']) {
            throw new Exception(implode('; ', $pwCheck['errors']));
        }

        // Hash with Argon2id and persist the new hash.
        $hash = password_hash($newPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
        return $this->update($id, ['password' => $hash]);
    }

    /**
     * Reset a user's password without requiring the current password.
     */
    public function resetPassword(int $id, string $newPassword): bool
    {
        $check = \App\Core\Validator::passwordStrength($newPassword);
        if (!$check['valid']) {
            throw new Exception(implode('; ', $check['errors']));
        }

        $hash = password_hash($newPassword, $this->passwordAlgorithm());
        return $this->update($id, ['password' => $hash]);
    }

    public function updateAvatar(int $id, string $avatarPath): bool {
        return $this->update($id, ['avatar' => $avatarPath]);
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // New methods for Phase 3 (Multi-Auth)
    // =====================================================================

    /**
     * Update a user's role.
     * Only intended to be called by Root admins.
     */
    public function updateRole(int $id, string $role): bool {
        $allowedRoles = ['root', 'admin', 'user'];

        // Reject any role not in the whitelist.
        if (!in_array($role, $allowedRoles, true)) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid role');
        }

        return $this->update($id, ['role' => $role]);
    }

    /**
     * Mark a user as verified (useful for Phase 5 WhatsApp verification).
     */
    public function markVerified(int $id): bool {
        return $this->update($id, ['is_verified' => 1]);
    }

    /**
     * Count how many users have a specific role.
     * Useful for dashboard statistics.
     */
    public function countByRole(string $role): int {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE role = ?";
        $row = $this->queryOne($sql, [$role]);
        return (int) $row['c'];
    }

    /**
     * Return all users for the management list.
     */
    public function findAllUsers(string $orderBy = 'id ASC'): array {
        return $this->findAll($orderBy);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php
namespace App\Models;
```

```php
use PDO;

class WishlistModel extends Model
{
    protected string $table = 'wishlists';

    public function add(int $memberId, int $productId): bool
    {
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$this->table} (member_id, product_id) VALUES (?, ?)";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute([$memberId, $productId]);
    }

    public function remove(int $memberId, int $productId): bool
    {
        $sql = "DELETE FROM {$this->table} WHERE member_id = ? AND product_id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute([$memberId, $productId]);
    }

    /**
     * Check whether a member already saved a product to the wishlist.
     */
    public function exists(int $memberId, int $productId): bool
    {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM {$this->table} WHERE member_id = ? AND product_id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$memberId, $productId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return (int) $row['c'] > 0;
    }

    public function findAllByMember(int $memberId): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT w.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.slug AS product_slug, p.image, 
                        b.name AS brand_name, c.slug AS category_slug
                FROM {$this->table} w
                JOIN products p ON p.id = w.product_id
                LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id
                LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
                WHERE w.member_id = ? AND p.status = 'published'
                ORDER BY w.created_at DESC";
        return $this->query($sql, [$memberId]);
    }
}
```

### bin/scraper/command-line-installing-tools.md

```markdown
============================ WINDOWS 10+ USER ============================

# 1. Go to the new folder
cd /d C:\xampp\htdocs\gudangpc\bin\scraper

# 2. Delete the old virtual environment and profiles (safe to ignore errors if they don't exist)
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .profiles -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# 3. Re-create the environment and install
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

# 4. Run the scraper
python scrape.py --targets sample_targets.csv --out products


============================ LINUX DEBIAN USER ============================

# 1. Install system dependencies for Playwright (requires sudo)
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y python3-venv python3-pip libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libatspi2.0-0

# 2. Go to the new folder
cd ~/path/to/gudangpc/bin/scraper

# 3. Delete the old virtual environment and profiles
rm -rf .venv .profiles

# 4. Re-create the environment and install
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

# 5. Run the scraper
python scrape.py --targets sample_targets.csv --out products
```

### bin/scraper/README.md

```markdown
# GudangPC Product Scraper

## What this tool does

This tool opens a list of marketplace product links (Tokopedia, Lazada, Shopee) in a real
Chromium browser window that you can see, one link after the other. It copies the product title,
the price, the shop name, the shop rating, the product rating and the number of sold items of
each page into a spreadsheet. The long product description is not collected any more. The
spreadsheet has exactly the same columns as the GudangPC import file, and the tool never touches
the database.

You still have to do a little work by hand: five columns (product_slug, name, category_slug,
brand_slug, vendor_slug) are left empty on purpose, because only a human knows that the
"MacBook Pro 14 inch case" of one shop and the "Case-Cover MacBook Pro M4" of another shop are
the same product.

Because the browser window is visible, you can solve a captcha or log in while the tool waits.
The tool waits up to 45 seconds for a page and then pauses 5 more seconds before it reads the
values, so you have time to click in the window.

## Install (only needed once)

Open a terminal (press the Windows key, type "cmd", press Enter) and run these four commands:

```
cd /d C:\xampp\htdocs\gudangpc\bin\scraper
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium
```

```
If you run it in LMDE :

# 1. system packages (once)
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y python3-venv python3-full php-cli php-mysql

# 2. venv + python deps
cd ~/path/to/gudangpc/bin/scraper
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. chromium + its system libs
playwright install chromium
sudo .venv/bin/playwright install-deps chromium

# 4. one-time Shopee login (must be run from a desktop session)
python scrape.py --login shopee

# 5. run the scraper
python scrape.py --targets sample_targets.csv --out products

```

The last command downloads the Chromium browser that Playwright drives. It takes a few minutes.
When you are done with the terminal you can leave the virtual environment with `deactivate`.

## Captchas and logins

The browser window is visible, so you can always act in it while the tool waits:

- A captcha appears: click through it in the window. The tool keeps reading the page afterwards.
- Tokopedia or Shopee asks you to log in: log in in the window. The next pages of that shop are
  then loaded with the same login.
- Tokopedia keeps the login in `bin\scraper\.profiles\tokopedia_browser` and Shopee in
  `bin\scraper\.profiles\shopee`, so the next run starts with the login still there.

The old one time login commands still work and use the same folders:

```
python scrape.py --login tokopedia
python scrape.py --login shopee
```

A browser window opens on the shop home page. Log in there, go back to the terminal and press
Enter. The login is saved in the profile folder and is reused on every later run.

## How to run

```
python scrape.py --targets sample_targets.csv --out products
```

This writes two files in the folder where you run the command (the current folder, not a hidden
temp folder). The date of today is added to the name, so a run never overwrites the file of
yesterday:

- `products_2026-11-13.csv` - the file you feed to the importer
- `products_2026-11-13.xlsx` - the same data in Excel, with the header row frozen

The date comes from the computer, so it is the date of the day you run the tool. If you want
another name, give another prefix: `--out myprices` writes `myprices_2026-11-13.csv` and
`myprices_2026-11-13.xlsx`.

The input file may be a `.csv` or an `.xlsx` file. It needs a column named `url` and it may have
a column named `affiliate_url`. If `affiliate_url` is empty, the original link is stored as the
affiliate link. The order of the rows is kept.

To use a spreadsheet instead of the CSV: open `sample_targets.csv` in Excel, choose
File > Save As > Excel Workbook (.xlsx), and then run:

```
python scrape.py --targets sample_targets.xlsx --out products
```

## What the notes column means

| notes | meaning | what to do |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | the title and the price were found | nothing, just fill the five empty columns |
| `partial` | the page opened but the title or the price is missing | open the link in your own browser and copy the missing value |
| `blocked_captcha` | a security check or captcha appeared | open the link in your own browser and copy the values by hand |
| `blocked_login` | the marketplace wants a login | log in in the browser window that is open, the tool continues |
| `timeout` | the page took more than 45 seconds | try again later, or copy the values by hand |
| `error:...` | something technical went wrong, the reason is after the colon | copy the link into the report for the developer |

Two error reasons you will probably see: `error:region_not_available` means the marketplace does not
sell that product in the country the computer is in, and `error:page_goto:...` means the page could
not be opened at all (a network problem).

## What the columns mean

The tool fills these columns for you:

| column | what it is | example |
|---|---|---|
| `marketplace` | the shop the link belongs to | `lazada` |
| `vendor_name` | the name of the shop | `I-Shop Jakarta` |
| `price_idr` | the price in rupiah, digits only | `1299000` |
| `affiliate_url` | the link you put in the target file | `https://www.lazada.co.id/...` |
| `seller_title` | the product title exactly as the shop wrote it | `Case Macbook Pro 14 inch ...` |
| `product_rating` | the rating of the product, from 0 to 5 | `4.9` |
| `store_rating` | the rating of the shop, from 0 to 5 | `4.8` |
| `sold_count` | how many items were sold | `8` |
| `image_url` | the link of the product picture | `https://img.lazcdn.com/...` |
| `notes` | what happened on that link | `ok` |

`short_description` and `description` stay empty on purpose. If you ever want to fill them, the
importer writes them into the product when the product is created.

A metric that is not on the page stays empty. The importer ignores an empty metric, so a row with
an empty `sold_count` does not erase the sold count that is already in the database.

## Honest expectations

Lazada is the most reliable of the three and usually returns a complete row. Tokopedia works about
half of the time: it is slow and it often shows a captcha, but you can click through it in the
visible window. Shopee changes its layout often and it shows a captcha to strangers, so log in in
the window when it appears. There is no promise of 100% and blank cells are normal. The tool never
guesses: if it cannot read a value, it leaves the cell empty so that you fill it in.

## Filling the file for the importer

Open the file of today, for example `products_2026-11-13.csv` or `products_2026-11-13.xlsx`, and
fill these five columns for every row you want to import:

| column | example | rule |
|---|---|---|
| `product_slug` | `macbook-pro-14-case-hard` | lowercase letters, digits and dashes only (`a-z`, `0-9`, `-`) |
| `name` | `Case MacBook Pro 14 inch hard` | the product name, max 200 characters |
| `category_slug` | `peripherals` | an existing category slug, see below |
| `brand_slug` | `apple` | an existing brand slug, see below |
| `vendor_slug` | `techzone-id` | an existing vendor of the same marketplace, see below |

The `marketplace` column is filled by the tool and must not be changed: `shopee`, `tokopedia` or
`lazada`. The importer rejects a row when the vendor does not belong to that marketplace.

Category slugs that already exist: `laptops`, `smartphones`, `monitors`, `cpu`, `gpu`,
`motherboard`, `ram`, `ssd`, `psu`, `case`, `cpu-cooler`, `monitor`, `peripherals`.

Brand slugs that already exist: `apple`, `samsung`, `asus`, `amd`, `intel`, `nvidia`, `msi`,
`gigabyte`, `corsair`, `kingston`, `logitech`, `seasonic`, `nzxt`.

Vendor slugs that already exist, with the marketplace they belong to:

| marketplace | vendor slugs |
|---|---|
| shopee | `ibox-official-store`, `random-gadget-store`, `techzone-id`, `enter-komputer` |
| tokopedia | `tokopedia-official`, `nanokomputer`, `gadget-store-id` |
| lazada | `lazada-official`, `digital-store` |
| blibli | `blibli-official`, `audiostream` |
| official | `amd-official` |

When the file is ready, save it as CSV and run the importer from the project root. Use the name
with today's date, otherwise the importer cannot find it:

```
cd /d C:\xampp\htdocs\gudangpc
php bin/import_products.php bin/scraper/products_2026-11-13.csv --dry-run
```

The dry run prints what would happen and writes nothing. When you are happy with the report, run
it without `--dry-run` to write the products and offers into the database, then look at
`/dashboard/products` in the browser.

Rows that the importer rejects are listed in the report with the reason, for example
`row 3: unknown vendor: shopee-id (macbook-pro-14-case)`. Fix the row in the CSV and run the
importer again.
```
